title: Director, Employee Experience M&A
description:
The Opportunity

The Director, Employee Experience M&A leads the end-to-end people strategy for Adobe's transactions—from early diligence through close and post-close integration. This is a senior, high-ownership individual-contributor role for someone who can run deals independently, from beginning to end, rather than support or coordinate a single workstream. You will serve as the people lead on assigned deals, translating deal rationale into an actionable EX integration strategy and owning the outcome.

The role demands broad HR expertise, solid commercial insight, and the judgment to operate independently in complex, ambiguous, and often global environments. It requires making informed decisions while knowing when to bring up issues for validation. You will be a trusted advisor to senior leadership and the connective tissue between deal strategy and the lived employee experience. As with the rest of our team, this is a utility role. Between deals, and as we drive transformation across EX and the business, you will flex to lead high-priority initiatives beyond M&A.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full people lifecycle for assigned deals, independently leading EX diligence, integration planning, and post-close execution.
  • Translate deal rationale and value drivers into a concrete, measurable integration strategy and plan.
  • Provide the early voice on people-integration risks, complexity, and cost during diligence, and shape how those insights inform the integration approach (and vice versa).
  • Define and drive integration priorities, workstreams, and timelines across all phases; assemble and direct cross-functional effort without formal authority.
  • Lead organizational transition, cultural assimilation, onboarding, and leadership/manager/team empowerment for acquired organizations, including complex and groundbreaking deals.
  • Partner with Corporate Development / Integration, Legal, Finance, ATS/Systems, HRBPs, and business and target-company leaders to align on org design, operating model, and people plans.
  • Advise senior leadership—including as needed the CHRO and business executives—with clear recommendations grounded in diligence findings and integration realities.
  • Build and continuously improve the EX M&A playbook in partnership with the team, raising the team's ability to run more deals concurrently at consistent quality.
  • Between and across deals, lead select transformation priorities—operating as a senior utility player deployable to a range of work beyond M&A.

What You Need to Succeed

Required

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in HR, organizational strategy, or a related field, ideally within global enterprise environments.
  • Demonstrated expertise across the full M&A deal lifecycle, with a track record of independently leading deals end-to-end.
  • Broad HR knowledge across multiple fields: change management, culture and organization design, onboarding and leadership enablement, talent and workforce planning, and HR operations.
  • Strong working knowledge of compensation/benefits harmonization and retention levers
  • Proven ability to make high-impact decisions independently, influence senior partners, and lead cross-functionally without direct authority.
  • Excellent facilitation, communication, and change-leadership skills, including experience advising executive leadership.

Preferred

  • Consulting background (management, HR, or M&A advisory), bringing fungible skills that flex across the group's transformation work.
  • Experience with complex-structured, stock, or asset deals and with global or multi-country employee footprints.
  • Experience navigating labor relations, works councils, and local labor law consultation requirements in global deals, particularly across EMEA.
  • Experience standing up or scaling M&A playbooks, processes, and tooling.
  • Breadth and adaptability to perform in a senior multi-faceted role across M&A and broader transformation priorities.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.


Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

The Opportunity

At Adobe, our mission is to empower creatives, marketers, and IT professionals with application-based products that transform their daily work and accelerate progress towards their business goals. Our Technical Pre-Sales (TPS) organization plays a critical role in preparing customers to purchase Adobe’s integrated solutions by understanding their business needs, defining and validating their technical requirements, and demonstrating their ideal future state with Adobe technology.

The Enterprise Architecture (EA) team is within the TPS group. This role will be supporting the Enterprise Architecture (EA) team as an intern in TPS.

Learn More about Enterprise Architecture

Adobe’s Enterprise Architecture team sits within the TPS organization and works directly with Adobe customers to understand their current technology architecture and usage, evaluate its effectiveness as it relates to their larger business objectives, and create a future-state technology architecture to best support their long-term marketing vision.

As an Enterprise Architecture Intern, you will be learning from the best as you support experienced Enterprise Architects in their engagements with Adobe customers. You will collaborate on projects with Adobe’s top customers to provide guidance on strategies and technology to support digital experience growth and transformation.

You will learn how the team runs, how they interact with customers, real-world customer problems mapped to Adobe software solutions, and what key results they are responsible for building all while supporting and influencing the growing team’s operational strategy.

  • Learn to build custom architecture diagrams and phased implementations that showcase how Adobe technology can best support our customers’ objectives

  • Create presentations to best communicate technical information and architecture mapping to our customers’ business needs

title: Senior Staff Engineer
description:
Adobe Risk Platform (ARP) is Adobe's centralized, adaptive system for detecting, preventing, and mitigating fraud and abuse across products and services, delivering robust security without degrading customer experience. It protects surfaces like Commerce, Stock, and Firefly with real-time risk decisions.
As a Sr Staff Engineer on ARP, you'll set the architectural direction for risk mitigation across Adobe. You'll define the standards, patterns, and long-term technical strategy that let ARP and Adobe stay ahead of fraud and abuse as it evolves.

What you'll do

  • Architect systems built for the next three to five years of risk mitigation, while delivering impact iteratively and solving today's most important priorities along the way.
  • Push the platform to the forefront of AI and ML to strengthen fraud and abuse detection.
  • Lay the foundational building blocks of the Risk Platform that future risk-mitigation capability builds on, including the platform's shift toward event-driven, continuously-reasoning risk intelligence.
  • Set architectural standards for risk-decisioning services that other teams across Adobe adopt.
  • Share architectural thinking broadly, through design docs that become org-wide standards, white papers, tech talks, or cross-org design reviews.
  • Simplify complex, interlinked systems into designs other teams can build on with confidence.
  • Mentor senior and staff engineers across teams, growing the next generation of technical leaders.

What you need to succeed
  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience; Master's preferred.
  • 12+ years architecting high-scale, highly performant platforms, and leading the technical teams that build them.
  • Deep understanding of AI and ML, both to strengthen fraud detection and to counter AI-powered attacks.
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems and databases, including SQL, NoSQL, and DynamoDB-class stores.
  • Track record architecting systems with multi-year relevancy, not just solving today's scaling or reliability problem.
  • Experience with data lakes and large-scale data platforms like Databricks or Spark.
  • Proven ability to influence engineering direction across teams and Business Units without formal authority.
  • A track record of publishing or presenting technical work that shaped how others build.

Nice to have

  • Experience with graph databases or identity/relationship graphs applied to fraud or abuse detection (e.g., detecting rings, relay networks, or coordinated account abuse via graph traversal).
  • Device fingerprinting or AI agent design experience.
  • A payments, commerce, or fraud background.
  • Familiarity with regulatory and compliance constraints relevant to payments and fraud decisioning (e.g., PCI, regional payment regulations).

About the role

We are looking for a driven, structured, and technically adept Technical Project Manager to oversee the end-to-end delivery of modern CMS implementations and AI-powered software applications. In this role, you will bridge the gap between business objectives, complex technical architectures, and client expectations. You will manage scope, timelines, resources, and client communications while actively contributing to high-level technical solutioning, technical documentation, and LLM/AI integration strategy.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of digital projects across CMS platforms (e.g., AEM, Sitecore, Directus, Contentful) and AI application workflows.

  • Create detailed project plans, roadmaps, sprint schedules, and resource allocation models using agile/scrum methodologies.

  • Track project progress, budget utilisation, risks, and dependencies, making proactive adjustments to ensure on-time delivery.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and internal executive stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Conduct regular project status updates, steering committee meetings, and sprint reviews, translating complex technical challenges into clear business language.

  • Manage scope change requests, setting clear expectations while defending project boundaries and deliverables.

  • Partner with tech leads, and engineers to define technical scope, system architecture, and API integration flows.

  • Oversee the integration of Large Language Models (LLMs), vector databases, RAG pipelines, and AI coding assistants/agents into CMS platforms and custom web applications.

  • Author and maintain comprehensive project documentation, including Functional Requirement Specifications (FRS), System Architecture Diagrams, API mapping docs, and user training guides.

  • Provide timely and effective reports to management team

About you

  • 3–4 years of proven hands-on experience as a Project Manager or Scrum Master leading web development, CMS implementations, and software engineering projects.

  • Direct experience delivering enterprise or enterprise CMS solutions (both traditional and headless architectures).

  • Practical understanding of AI software development concepts—including prompt engineering, LLM API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI coding tools.

  • Ability to write technical documentation, map data models/APIs, and converse fluently with full-stack engineers and ML developers.

  • Demonstrated success managing external client relationships, navigating stakeholder conflicts, and coordinating multi-disciplinary teams (designers, developers, QA).

  • Experience with project management and documentation tools such as Jira, Confluence, Asana, Notion, or Azure DevOps.

title: Part Time Floor Leader - Mandalay Bay
description:
Position: Part Time Floor Leader

Weekly: 20-29 hours

Interview Plan

Floor Leader

As a Floor Leader, you'll play a vital role in supporting the Store Management Team across all areas of the business. This includes everything from driving sales and opening/closing the store to analyzing sales results and leading training sessions. Together with your fellow leaders, you'll work to ensure that every aspect of the store is firing on all cylinders, creating an exceptional customer experience, a happy and motivated staff, and operational excellence that would make even the most detail-oriented among us proud.

Your day-to-day will be spent on the shop floor, where you'll lead and inspire a team of sales associates to achieve and surpass their goals. By fostering a culture of passion and positivity, you'll help create a work environment that's both productive and fun, resulting in happy customers and happy employees. The Floor Leader role is all about making the world a better place one soap at a time!

Responsibilities:

Sales & Customer Experience:

  • Driving Sales: Utilize the StoreForce dashboard results to provide effective coaching and feedback to the sales team, and make necessary adjustments to the shop floor structure to meet and exceed sales goals. Take ownership for your results and actively work to grow the contribution of your segments to the store’s overall sales. Celebrate sales achievements with your team!
  • Customer Experience: Lead by example in delivering a world-class customer experience on the shop floor, including product demonstrations. Observe and listen to consultations, collaborate with your team, and strive to exceed daily sales goals. By fostering a culture of excellence in customer service, you'll drive sales, create a loyal customer base, and build a positive reputation for your store.
  • Building the Brand: Educate customers on Lush brand values, and articulate our position on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging in the shop and through community engagement, hosting store parties, and other traffic-driving initiatives.
  • Product Passion: increase the depth of your product knowledge through constant learning and consistently make informed product recommendations for every need.

Team Involvement:

  • Development: Train and coach Sales Ambassadors and peers on effective sales techniques and product knowledge to improve their performance, support the growth of your team, and to increase sales. Lead by example, take ownership of your development, assess your performance, and actively seek feedback, resources, and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge and abilities.
  • Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging: Encourage open communication and actively listen to team members perspectives related to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). Foster a sense of belonging by promoting teamwork, encouraging collaboration, and recognizing and valuing each employee's unique contributions.

Operational Excellence:

  • Cash Handling and Store Opening/Closing: Manage cash handling, including customer transactions, opening/closing the register, reconciling cash drawers, preparing nightly deposits, and securing the store at the end of each day. As required at your store location, take deposits to the bank.
  • Time and Attendance: Lead by example in terms of attendance and punctuality, and encourage the same from all employees. Monitor employee breaks to ensure they are taking their scheduled breaks, promoting a healthy work environment and improving employee wellbeing. Review daily communications, including store updates and task lists, to ensure that team members are informed and prepared for their shifts, promoting a culture of preparedness and organization.
  • Visuals and Merchandising: Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store to enhance the customer's shopping experience and drive sales.
  • Stock and Inventory: Train your team on inventory best practices and fresh standards, and support management with inventory tasks. Utilize Visual Merchandising guidelines to make real-time adjustments to product displays based on sales and improve the customer experience.
  • Policies and Procedures: Support your management team to keep your store compliant and ensure your staff are practicing company standards for opening and closing, product integrity, respectful workplace, and health and safety.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in:
    • customer service and sales
    • cash handling and opening/closing procedures
    • supervisory experience involving coaching, feedback, and training
    • problem-solving issues related to customer service in day-to-day operations
    • a fast-paced team environment
  • Knowledge and passion for skincare, natural beauty, and ethical business
  • Flexible schedule to accommodate store needs, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

Preferred:

  • Experience with consultation-based customer service models
  • Experience analyzing sales metrics
  • Experience working in skincare or cosmetics
  • Experience in cross cultural collaboration and DEIB or social justice training
  • Fluency in Spanish, French or other languages

$16.50—$16.50 USD

title: CNC Programmer
description:
Job Title: CNC Programmer

Status: Exempt

Pay: $80,000 - $95,000 DOE

Schedule: Monday – Thursday 6:00am to 4:30pm


Company Perks:

  • Medical, dental, and life insurance – API pays 100% of the premiums for all employees
  • Employer-funded Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA)
  • 401(k) plan with company-funded Safe Harbor contribution
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Monthly production bonus program
  • Monthly lunch allowance provided
  • On-the-job training and skill development opportunities
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Employee perks and discount programs
  • Voluntary supplemental insurance options, including AFLAC and vision

PRIMARY PURPOSE:

The CNC Programmer role here at API is expected to have a comprehensive understanding of all CNC machining and programming operations. This role is tasked with working in close with machinists, leads, engineering/estimating teams, quality team and upper management to increase productivity and optimize machining programs and procedures. Machine operation and tooling management are also part of the focus of programming.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of experience using Mastercam (version 2020 or newer)
  • Hands-on experience as a CNC mill machinist
  • Proven ability to program ferrous metals, non-ferrous metals, and plastics
  • Ability to plan, program, and troubleshoot complex parts from blueprints
  • Strong understanding of tolerances, GD&T, and precision machining requirements
  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred
  • Experience with HEM (High-Efficiency Machining) preferred
  • Experience with SolidCAM preferred
  • Experience programming and operating multi-axis CNC mills

REQUIRED PERSONAL SKILLS:

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Strong communication skills and willingness to collaborate with others
  • Excellent work ethic, reliability, and consistent attendance
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Program CNC parts for vertical, horizontal, 5-axis mills, and machining cells.
  • Create, modify, and optimize CNC programs using Mastercam (2025) and related CAD/CAM tools.
  • Interpret and review blueprints, models, and technical drawings to determine machining requirements and sequence of operations.
  • Select appropriate tooling, speeds, and feeds for each job and machine.
  • Design and document fixtures required for CNC mill operations.
  • Produce and maintain setup sheets, tool lists, and supporting documentation with proper revision control.
  • Verify programs using CAM and make adjustments to ensure accuracy, quality, and safety.
  • Collaborate daily with CAD, machinists, quality control, and management to support production needs and resolve machining challenges.
  • Request materials and confirm material size and availability through Purchasing.
  • Troubleshoot returned or nonconforming parts and update programs and documentation as needed.
  • Support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance processes, reduce cycle times, and improve quality.
  • Assist with machine setup or machining tasks as needed.
  • Support sales/quoting by providing setup time, run time, and manufacturability input.
  • Perform other necessary duties and tasks as requested.

title: Digital Video Producer
description:
**About the FRONT ROW Group:**

At Front Row, we partner with leading brands to accelerate their ecommerce growth. We leverage our capabilities and proprietary technology to design, market, distribute and accelerate brands on a global scale.

We’re continually cultivating functional areas of expertise and retaining the highest calibre of talent — while sharing knowledge and data, creating efficiencies, and looking at every aspect of our client’s business from a 360 perspective.

We work effectively to give every client the hands-on support, niche knowledge, and first-access they need to win in the world’s most competitive commerce markets and make each of our six capabilities the first to act on the next big things.

We live for the exchange of energy between brands and audiences, you should too, and we’ve made it our mission to expand every brand’s market share and heart share. Because we believe every transaction has the potential to be transformational.

**About the team this role lives within:**

At the intersection of strategy and aesthetics, we partner with visionary founders and teams to create category-defining brands that foster real connections. Our approach goes beyond the obvious, leveraging a diverse collective of creatives to bring fresh, varied perspectives to the art and science of branding. Through emotional narratives, captivating brand identities, holistic design, and immersive retail experiences, we drive meaningful change in an ever-evolving world.

With a broad view of the digital landscape, we are uniquely positioned to expand and elevate our clients' online presence. From performance and social marketing to influencer and CRM strategies, we ensure consistency across every touchpoint. Leading with instinct and validating with data, we challenge assumptions, seek clarity, and redefine the role of brands in the global marketplace—adding value for all.

Our San Diego office has its own 5,000 square foot studio for shoots, which is a key part of our client offering, developing ongoing social content, email marketing assets, social and streaming ads, photography and video for everything from evergreen messages to product launches.

**Job Description Overview:**

The Front Row team is seeking a skilled Digital Video Producer to join our creative team. This position is for someone who excels both in the art of visual storytelling and the technical mastery of cinematography. Your day-to-day responsibilities will consist of shooting social content autonomously to the potential of leading the direction of models while on set for larger productions—and everything in between.

**Key Responsibilities**

- 3+ years of professional experience in video production.

- Proven ability to shoot autonomously for smaller-scale productions (e.g. social retainers, lean content shoots), including managing lighting, camera and sound independently when needed.

- Comfortable working across a variety of production environments from solo setups to larger-scale commercial shoots.

- Ability to step into a range of crew roles as needed, including Director of Photography, Camera Operator, 1st AC, 1st AD and Director.

- Mastery of lighting techniques (natural and artificial), camera systems (Blackmagic, RED, Wave, etc.), and post-production workflows.

- Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across creative and production teams.

- Proven ability to interpret creative briefs and deliver visually compelling results aligned with brand and campaign goals.

- Direct talent on set, ensuring strong performances and authentic storytelling.

- Maintain high-quality standards across all stages of production from pre-production through post.

- Design and execute the visual look of each project, including lighting, camera movement, and composition.

- Operate camera(s) or oversee the camera department to ensure both technical precision and artistic excellence.

- Select and configure lenses, rigs and gear best suited to the creative and logistical needs of each shoot.

- Collaborate with gaffers, ACs and grip to ensure seamless execution and creative alignment on set.

- Intermediate to advanced knowledge of Premiere and After Effects with the ability to work seamlessly across programs.

- Strong understanding of post-production workflows, including media management, syncing sound, transcoding and color correction prep.


**Bonus Points if:**

- You have agency experience

- You have beauty, wellness or lifestyle industry experience


**Benefits**

- 20 PTO days (prorated based upon start date) & 7 sick days per year

- Medical, Vision, and Dental Insurance Benefits

- 401k Retirement Plan

- Hybrid working schedule, primarily in-studio

- In-office perks

- MUST be located in San Diego or willing to relocate

- Summer Fridays

- Hybrid working schedule (remote + in-office)

- ClassPass membership

- Client product discounts

- Paid Professional Development Opportunities

- A fast-paced, high energy & dog friendly office space in Downtown San Diego with snacks and coffee

- Company-Paid Parking at our Downtown San Diego Office

title: Release Train Engineer
description:
Met jouw energie kan het

  • Je draagt bij aan betrouwbare digitale ondersteuning van elektriciteits- en gasaansluitingen voor huishoudens en kleine bedrijven.
  • Je helpt Agile teams die werken met Java-, SAP-, Mendix- en Flowable-applicaties om samen betere resultaten te behalen.
  • Je kunt daarbij rekenen op goede arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een flexibel arbeidsvoorwaardenbudget, een solide pensioenregeling en volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling.

Zo ga jij deze uitdaging aan

De Beheer- en Verbeterketen Kleinverbruik zorgt voor de digitale ondersteuning van elektriciteits- en gasaansluitingen. Denk aan het aanvragen, aanpassen, verplaatsen of afsluiten van een aansluiting en aan het plaatsen en vervangen van meters.

Als Release Train Engineer werk je binnen twee clusters van deze keten. Je helpt de clusters om verder te groeien in hun samenwerking, werkwijzen en resultaten. Daarbij houd je overzicht over wat er speelt, breng je mensen en belangen bij elkaar en zorg je voor duidelijkheid over doelen en prioriteiten. Je werkt nauw samen met de Agile teams, de andere RTE en verschillende stakeholders binnen Enexis.

Dit zijn jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Je houdt de focus op het leveren van businesswaarde en maatschappelijke impact.
  • Je helpt de twee clusters verder groeien en volwassen worden in hun Agile manier van werken.
  • Je stimuleert gewenst gedrag, eigenaarschap en een open samenwerkingscultuur.
  • Je neemt initiatief en zorgt voor continue verbetering van werkwijzen en resultaten.
  • Je toont verbindend leiderschap en creëert duidelijkheid en vertrouwen.
  • Je communiceert gemakkelijk met verschillende mensen en niveaus binnen de organisatie.

Zo pak jij het aan

Je werkt met aandacht voor mensen én resultaat. Je geeft ruimte waar dat kan en biedt richting waar dat nodig is. Door goed te luisteren, verschillende perspectieven samen te brengen en helder te communiceren, krijg je mensen in beweging. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, bent zichtbaar in de samenwerking en krijgt energie van continu verbeteren.

Verder heb je:

  • Hbo/wo werk- en denkniveau
  • Ervaring als Release Train Engineer of in een vergelijkbare rol.
  • Ervaring met SAFe en/of Agile werken.
  • Affiniteit met IT en digitale dienstverlening.

Je zet je schouders eronder met

Jouw collega’s binnen de Beheer- en Verbeterketen Kleinverbruik. Deze keten bestaat uit 16 Agile teams, verdeeld over vier clusters. De teams werken aan digitale oplossingen voor aansluitingen, meters, energiegebruik, klantinteractie en flexibiliteit.

Je werkt met name binnen twee clusters en werkt daarin nauw samen met een andere Release Train Engineer. Er heerst een prettige werksfeer waarin samenwerking, open communicatie en ruimte voor ieders inbreng belangrijk zijn. Verschillende teams werken met Java-, SAP-, Mendix- en Flowable-applicaties. Detail Specialist 1 - Some experience

Teph Seal Auto Appearance, a privately-held company, operates detail/reconditioning centers in auto dealerships across the United States. The detailer will use their manual dexterity and bodily coordination to perform an array of tasks, including washing the exterior of vehicles using various cleaning solutions, may also wax and buff vehicles using cloths and buffing machines, vacuum interior of automobiles to remove dirt and debris, clean upholstery and surfaces, use air compressors and cloths to dry surfaces and apply preservation chemicals to surfaces for protection against spots and stains.   • Occasional pushing, pulling, lifting, or carrying of up to 50 lbs.
  • Constantly receiving detailed information through oral communication.
  • Clarity of vision and hearing.
  • Ability to distinguish small imperfections in your work, such as, streaks left on windows, smudges on windows or painted surfaces, areas of missed vacuuming, etc.

  • Work with a sense of urgency that demonstrates the value we place on our customers' time.

The ideal candidate will have

  • A valid driver's license and a good driving record.

  • Desire to treat each customer’s personal vehicle with great care and respect

  • The willingness to come to work on time and stay on task when on the clock

  • The ability to drive both automatic and manual shift vehicles

  • The availability to work Saturday or Sunday and holidays as deemed necessary to meet production needs
  • Commitment to report to work on time and stay on task during shift

Teph Seal is a Drug-Free Workplace. All employment is contingent on successful completion of drug and background screening.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package and all the tools necessary to be successful. Our offerings include: Medical, Dental, Vision Plans, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off and 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match.

title: Pre-Sales Engineer
description:
Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Our Values

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding, and we strive to understand different viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals.

Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration.

Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative and bold solutions to tackle challenges.

Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results.

Who You Are

As a Pre-Sales Engineer at Develocity, you will be on the front lines, working closely with our customers, prospects, and partners, guiding them on how to optimize the productivity of their engineering organization by improving the software build and testing processes. You will work with our Sales, Product Management, and Engineering teams to help customers understand and experience the value of the Develocity solution from a technical, business, and financial perspective.

At Develocity, our sales organization gives you what you need to focus on creating pipeline and driving revenue:

  • A hardened qualification and prioritization process to ensure you are engaged with the right end users at the right companies.
  • A strong product that addresses a real, daily problem for software developers and engineering leaders.
  • A standardized evaluation process that delivers immediate technical value and a hard cost ROI in just a few days.
  • A referenceable network of brand name customers and OSS partners willing to speak to new prospects about their success.

To get a feel for the product, take a look at DPE University.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Account Executives through MEDDIC to identify, qualify, and develop enterprise opportunities.
  • Conduct customer discovery, deliver compelling software demos, solution presentations and PoCs showcasing Develocity's value.
  • Bring structured customer feedback to Product Marketing, Product Management and Engineering to shape the roadmap.
  • Up to ~35% travel to customer sites and events.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience working in Pre-Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Consulting or a combination of these, selling to enterprise environments.
  • A "Product Journey" and "Customer Journey" mindset with a deep desire to deploy impactful solutions.
  • Familiarity and technical understanding of the following:
    • Observability tooling e.g. Datadog, Splunk, Dynatrace
    • Build tools e.g. Maven, Gradle, Android, Bazel, npm, Python
    • CI/CD tooling e.g. Jenkins, GitLab, TeamCity, GitHub Actions, Harness, ArgoCD
    • Artifact repositories e.g. Artifactory, Nexus
    • Software Supply Chain Security
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Excellent time management skills and the ability to prioritize activities autonomously in the best interest of your Sales team.
  • Strong work ethic and can-do attitude.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field and/or previous experience working as a software engineer or a DevOps engineer.
  • Experience with MEDDIC or MEDDPICC.
  • Pre-sales experience with developer tools, observability, or other SaaS products.
  • Hands-on experience with Develocity.
  • Use of Agentic AI tools in your daily workflow to increase productivity and output.

What We Offer

  • Ability to work in a remote-first environment with flexible working hours.
  • Work on a fast-growing product with a clear vision for the future.
  • Close collaboration with an ambitious and experienced team and the opportunity to learn from them regardless of your experience level.
  • Opportunities for growth in your career and in leadership responsibilities.
  • In-person meetings, such as our annual company offsite team meetings, and onboardings.
  • Contribute to leading solutions in the new industry of Developer Productivity Engineering and work with cutting-edge DPE tools and practices.
  • Competitive salaries and equity grants.

Location

Remote from Europe. While our team works remotely and is spread across the globe, we deeply value daily interactions and collaboration.

title: Senior Data Scientist, ML— Fraud Detection & Effectiveness
description:
Senior Data Scientist, ML— Fraud Detection & Effectiveness

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Senior Machine Learning Data Scientist to build fraud and abuse detection models and measure how effectively they work. This role combines hands-on modeling with deep experimentation, evaluation, and analytics to improve detection and quantify business impact.

You will work across the fraud lifecycle — from modeling and ground-truth definition to performance measurement, monitoring, and executive-ready insights!

What you'll Do

  • Build and tune ML models for fraud and abuse detection using statistical and classical ML techniques.
  • Develop robust evaluation frameworks, datasets, and metrics to measure model and mitigation effectiveness.
  • Analyze false positives/negatives, model drift, and emerging fraud patterns to continuously improve detection.
  • Define ground truth, labeling approaches, and fraud taxonomies that support reliable model development and evaluation.
  • Design experiments and evaluate tradeoffs across precision, recall, customer impact, and fraud loss.
  • Build dashboards and metrics that translate detection performance into measurable business impact.
  • Pressure-test models and data for leakage, bias, data-quality issues, and other sources of misleading results.
  • Partner across engineering, product, policy, and risk teams to turn insights into detection improvements and business decisions.

What you'll need to succeed

  • 8+ years in applied Data Science / ML, with experience building and evaluating production ML models.
  • Strong foundation in statistical and classical ML, experimentation, model evaluation, and performance measurement.
  • Strong hands-on Python and SQL skills working with large, complex datasets.
  • Experience with model monitoring, drift, false-positive/false-negative analysis, and imperfect or delayed labels.
  • Strong data visualization and storytelling skills — able to translate complex analysis into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Strong analytical judgment, ownership, and ability to operate independently through ambiguity.
  • Bachelor's or equivalent experience in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field; advanced degree a plus.

Preferred Attributes

  • Experience in fraud, abuse, risk, identity, trust & safety, or other adversarial domains.
  • Experience with anomaly detection, clustering, behavioral modeling, or prevalence estimation.
  • Experience with labeling frameworks, weak supervision, active learning, or human-review systems.
  • Familiarity with LLMs and AI-assisted evaluation/analysis.
  • Experience evaluating multi-layered risk controls and automated decisioning systems.

title: Temporary Program Coordinator
description:
**Why Join JVS?**

JVS is a nonprofit working to close opportunity gaps in employment by supporting jobseekers with the skills and confidence to secure quality careers with family-sustaining wages. Grounded in core values of repairing the world and focused on helping our program participants achieve economic mobility, we believe everyone deserves access to training and the chance for a good job. JVS develops training programs in close partnership with employers in high growth sectors, offering high quality jobs.

Building on decades of experience and success, JVS is a data-driven organization that takes a whole systems approach to addressing employment and economic equity. Through our direct service programs, employer engagement and policy change, JVS is working toward a future where everyone has access to quality education and training programs that lead to high quality employment and economic mobility.

**Job Summary:**

The Temporary Program Coordinator plays a pivotal role in supporting participants throughout their enrollment and career development journeys. This position ensures accurate assessment, application review, and data management, while also providing personalized coaching and guidance.

The role involves participating in program orientations, developing career action plans, monitoring participant progress, and collaborating with internal teams and external partners. Success is measured by the ability to meet enrollment and cohort targets, support participant retention, and foster positive outcomes in career placement. A strong commitment to equity, inclusion, and excellent customer service is essential. This role is full-time, limited-term, and anticipated to end on 06/30/2027.

**Responsibilities:**

**Application & Assessment**

- Review and evaluate program applications for candidate suitability.
- Coordinate and participate in interviews using established criteria to determine participant qualifications.
- Enter and maintain accurate participant records and assessment data in Salesforce or similar systems.

**Program Orientation & Coaching**

- Participate in orientations to introduce participants to program expectations, resources, and support services.
- Provide ongoing coaching and feedback to guide candidates through enrollment and career development.

**Participant Journey Management**

- Track and monitor participant progress through career action plans and program milestones.
- Meet regularly with participants during their course and job search phases.
- Refer participants to external services for barriers beyond program scope.

**Support & Engagement**

- Maintain positive connections among participants, staff, and cohorts.
- Process participant resource dollars and support access to necessary resources.
- Inform participants about their progress and required actions to advance.

**Administrative & Data Management**

- Document participant encounters and barriers in Salesforce.
- Manage schedules to ensure participants stay on track with program and job search timelines.
- Collaborate with partner agencies and other program staff to ensure effective communication with participants and across agencies.
- Complete administrative projects in support of the Program Team.

**Performance Monitoring**

- Track participant outcomes and support progress toward sustainable wage careers.
- Monitor and encourage the application of behavioral skills in classroom and workplace settings.

**Qualifications:**

- 1–3 years of experience in a similar role.
- Experience working with diverse populations and a demonstrated commitment to equity and inclusion.
- Proven ability to help individuals achieve career or educational goals.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and record-keeping.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ability to learn Salesforce or similar CRM systems.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for building rapport with participants and stakeholders.
- Strong organizational and time management skills to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
- Ability to analyze participant needs and develop personalized action plans.
- Competence in documenting and tracking participant progress using CRM systems.
- Strong problem-solving skills to address participant barriers and critical incidents.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team and with external partners.
- Flexibility and adaptability to meet changing organizational and participant needs.
- High degree of initiative, integrity, and professionalism.
- Commitment to the mission and values of JVS.

description:

**Reporting to:** Sales Director

**Location:** London, Kings Cross or Brighton

**Core Mission of this role**

You can expect to play a vital role within a small creative team here at Key Production. We are #1 in our industry – the biggest production house in Europe for physical music manufacture, working with an incredible range of clients and artists. The Senior Product Design Manager leads the delivery of high-quality design work across multiple projects, combining creative leadership with strong commercial and operational awareness. This role oversees the design process from initial brief through to final artwork, ensuring technical accuracy, fostering strong client and supplier relationships, and supporting the ongoing growth and development of the design team. The role also works closely in partnership with the sales team to identify new business opportunities, strengthen client relationships, and support the continued growth of the business.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate expertise across a broad range of design disciplines and possess a genuine passion for the creative industry. We are seeking an individual who lives and breathes design, is deeply immersed in the creative world, and is driven to build a recognised reputation within the industry. This is more than just a role, it is an opportunity for someone who is committed to pushing creative standards, staying ahead of trends, and making a lasting impact through exceptional design.

With our knowledge and passion, we create unforgettable physical and audio experiences, striving to do so as sustainably as possible.

**Our Behaviours**

At Key Production, our core behaviours define the foundation of our workplace culture and guide our interactions with colleagues, clients, and stakeholders. We believe that embodying these behaviours not only enhances individual performance but also fosters collaboration and innovation. As a member of our team, you will be expected to demonstrate these core behaviours in your daily work, contributing to an inclusive and dynamic environment where everyone can thrive.

o We approach situations with a calm, level head

• Drive design quality across multiple projects

• Build strong product and market knowledge

• Use research to inform concepts and materials

• Understand trends across packaging, print, and product sectors

**Concept and Development**

• Generate ideas that meet client and commercial goals

• Develop concepts into production-ready designs

• Refine designs based on feedback and technical limits

• Apply strong software knowledge across design tools

• Produce accurate artwork and reprographics

• Work within templates and print specifications

• Ensure all outputs meet production standards

• Understand pricing, margins, and cost drivers

• Design with cost efficiency in mind

• Manage orders with awareness of budget and timelines

• Identify and target relevant prospects, building and maintaining a strong pipeline

• Develop clear proposals, follow up consistently, and close work at viable margins

**Client and Stakeholder Management**

• Build strong relationships with clients and planners

• Understand client needs and business context

• Deliver work that meets or exceeds expectations

• Work closely with suppliers on materials and feasibility

• Understand supplier capabilities and constraints

• Maintain strong working relationships

• Ensure designs translate effectively into production

• Support your team through guidance and feedback

• Contribute to training and development of the team

**Business Development Contribution**

• Support new business through ideas and proposals

• Contribute to brainstorming and pitch work

• Help grow existing accounts through strong delivery

**EXPERIENCE**

You should have a minimum of 5+ years’ experience in a Senior Product Design Manager role, with a proven track record of leading creative projects, managing end to end design processes, and delivering high-quality work across multiple design disciplines.

Experience using CAD and design software, including:

We're looking for a sharp, narrative-focused Editorial Lead to lead the Adobe Corporate Blog and shape the voice, standard and quality of all external written materials. title: Acquisitions Director
description:
The Transactions team at Curbline Properties is looking for an Acquisition Director in Texas to source, negotiate, and close convenience retail acquisition opportunities (averaging $10mm-$15mm per investment). The Acquisitions Director will lead deal efforts and partner with leadership to assess, recommend and facilitate the acquisition of retail real estate. This position plays a critical role in growing the Curbline portfolio by identifying convenience retail assets to acquire. To thrive in this role, we need an experienced dealmaker who is well connected in the retail real estate industry with prior retail real estate financial modeling experience.


This position will work remotely in Dallas, Houston, or Austin, TX. The position requires availability for occasional travel to tour assets, attend ICSC Conferences, and visit offices in Beachwood, OH and New York City, NY.


The expected salary range for this full-time salaried exempt position is between $130,000 - $165,000. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, job-related skills, internal peer equity, geographical and industry market data, and business considerations and other factors permitted by law.


To be successful in this role, you will need to:

  • Source, negotiate, and close acquisition opportunities sub-$20mm independently
  • Reviews financial projections and pricing analyses (utilizing financial metrics such as internal rate of return, return on investment, loan amortization schedules, earnings accretion, etc.) related to the investment using technical software such as Excel and Argus
  • Creatively sources off-market acquisitions through relationships with brokers and landlords
  • Participate in drafting and review of transaction documents (LOIs, PSAs, etc)
  • Contribute daily to the current and future implementation of corporate strategy as it relates to the transactions team. Take initiative in deal origination and deal sourcing by establishing industry relationships. Works actively to identify and recommend new assets
  • Participate in the negotiation of business terms of acquisitions
  • Lead the transaction process by coordinating with other departments, brokers, and internal/external legal counsel to consummate the investment process


We are looking for an Acquisitions Director with:

  • Exceptional attention to detail and well-developed analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Prior analytical and dealmaking experience in the retail real estate industry
  • “Deal Junkie” - Passion for retail real estate transactions and the dealmaking process
  • Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills with a high degree of initiative and independent judgement
  • Strong educational background in finance, accounting or real estate
  • Real estate and business financial acumen to understand how work relates to the Company’s overall goals and strategies

title: Project Scheduler
description:

The Senior Project Scheduler leads project planning and scheduling efforts by developing, maintaining and analyzing project schedules. This role identifies risk, communicates project status, and supports effective planning and on-time delivery.


Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Lead scheduling efforts across multiple projects and collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Develop and maintain detailed project schedules using industry-standard software
  • Partner with Project Managers to build Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), define sequencing, and estimate durations
  • Analyze construction documents and contract requirements to translate scope into actionable schedules
  • Monitor progress, identify risks, and analyze critical path activities
  • Perform schedule risk analysis and develop “what-if” scenarios to mitigate delays
  • Review contractor schedule submittals, including baseline and updates
  • Support claims analysis, including delay impacts and cost implications
  • Prepare reports including schedule updates, earned value analysis (EVA), and forecasting
  • Communicate schedule status, risks, and key milestones to stakeholders
  • Maintain standardized scheduling processes and ensure quality control across deliverables
  • Support business development efforts, client presentations, and RFP development


Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of relevant scheduling experience
  • Experience with Primavera P6 required
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, CPM scheduling, and delay analysis
  • Ability to analyze schedules, identify the critical path, and assess project risk
  • Experience with mission-critical, hyperscale, or data center construction projects
    (preferred)


Candidates must possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex schedule data and communicate risks and impacts clearly. This includes strong attention to detail, time management, and the ability to collaborate effectively with project teams in a fast-paced construction environment.


All job offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a drug screen and reference check. Tri-City Group is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Adobe is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Adobe Risk Platform (ARP) team. ARP is Adobe's centralized, adaptive system for detecting, preventing, and mitigating fraud and abuse across products and services — protecting surfaces like Commerce, Stock, and Firefly with real-time risk decisions, without degrading the customer experience.

In this position, you will help build and develop machine learning models to identify fraudulent activity, detect abusive account behavior, and protect the experience of hundreds of millions of users. You'll work across the model lifecycle from raw behavioral data and feature engineering, to model training, deployment, and monitoring alongside senior engineers on the team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Help build and train ML models covering various fraud and abuse areas. These include financial transaction fraud, device-related deception, and account and identity abuse. The goal is a unified, continuously-updated trust and risk score.
  • Contribute to feature engineering across transaction, device, and behavioral event data.
  • Build and maintain feature pipelines on Databricks and Spark, transforming raw transaction and device event data into high-quality model inputs.
  • Help translate prototypes into production ML systems, working with senior engineers on scalability, reliability, and observability.
  • Support MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, and production monitoring.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data science, product, and platform teams to understand fraud and abuse patterns across Adobe's surfaces.
  • Stay ahead of advances in ML/AI, particularly in fraud detection and behavioral modeling, and bring relevant ideas to the team.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of professional experience building and deploying ML solutions, or equivalent experience through internships, research, or personal projects.
  • Solid programming skills in Python, with hands-on experience in PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, or similar frameworks.
  • Working understanding of the ML lifecycle — from data collection through deployment and monitoring.
  • Eagerness to learn model optimization, inference efficiency, and production system integration, with support from senior engineers on the team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Coursework, projects, or professional experience in any of: payment fraud, device fingerprinting, account takeover detection, anomaly detection, or graph-based modeling.
  • Exposure to sequence modeling, transformer architectures, or graph neural networks.
  • Familiarity with Databricks, Spark, or large-scale transactional/event pipelines.

title: Delivery Director
description:
Location:Hybrid - 2 days a week in London or Bristol office

Salary:£84,000 - £100,000

### About the role

**Job level:** 13

**Working style:** Hybrid, the successful candidate will be expected to attend an office on average twice a week based on client demand in London or Bristol.

The Delivery Director is accountable for the delivery operating environment, quality and project execution health of manifesto. This is a senior leadership role created as manifesto grows in scale and complexity, the business requires a senior leader responsible for the delivery performance, operational consistency and client outcomes across the entire agency portfolio.

The role sits at the centre of the agency delivery system, connecting Commercial, Growth, Strategy, Technology, Design and Delivery into a coherent execution model. The Delivery Director is accountable for the environment through which work moves from sale into execution and into outcomes, ensuring programmes, projects, CI and support are properly governed, commercially controlled and delivered in a way that sustains client confidence and long-term relationships.

The role spans significant portfolio breadth, delivery governance and mobilisation, capacity and project workforce alignment, commercial performance against forecast/budget, revenue recognition, risk containment and escalation management. It requires real-time visibility across the health of the agency's entire delivery portfolio and the authority, judgement and presence to act decisively when performance is under pressure.

This role carries accountability for outcomes, not oversight of activity. The Delivery Director is not a layer of governance above delivery. They are the operational leader who removes friction, resolves ambiguity, holds standards and ensures the agency can deliver with consistency and pace at the scale the business demands now and the greater scale it is moving towards. Empowering and working with the senior leaders within the Project Management capability to deliver maximum impact for their portfolios, clients and team.

The Delivery Director provides leadership and intervention where delivery performance, client confidence and commercial outcomes require improvement.

Manifesto is evolving towards a more integrated, strategically-led and operationally mature AI enabled agency model. As scale increases, so do the tensions inherent in that growth: increasing delivery and commercial complexity, higher coordination overhead across multidisciplinary teams, pressure on margin and forecasting confidence, evolving client expectations and the growing importance of scalable delivery systems.

The Delivery Director exists to create delivery transparency and consistency in delivery across this environment. The role works in close partnership with the MD on maintaining delivery performance; Strategy Enablement and Partnerships Director, Strategy team, Head of PMO and Programme Leads on shaping viable, deliverable programmes; the Finance and Commercial Director on delivery execution within commercial frameworks; Technology and Design leadership on quality and capability maturity; and Growth and client services leadership on sales-to-delivery mobilisation, estimation and feasibility. The Delivery Director also works closely with the Engineering Director, who holds delegated ownership for engineering leadership, capability, technical standards and team management.

The effectiveness of this role depends on the quality of these relationships and the clarity of accountability boundaries between growth, client leadership, operational execution and commercial governance.

#### Responsibilities

The Delivery Director owns delivery as a business capability. The role is accountable for orchestrating the flow of work through the business from point of sale, with full ownership of the following:

- Delivery execution, governance and operational health across portfolios
- Sales-to-delivery mobilisation and delivery lifecycle management
- Delivery execution against agreed commercial budgets and operational plans
- Effective deployment of delivery capability against client requirement including management of near shore agreements
- Project and programme profitability/performance against agreed commercial parameters
- Supporting accurate forecasting and revenue reporting through on time and on budget delivery performance
- Client satisfaction and long-term retention through delivery excellence
- Risk containment, escalation management and delivery recovery
- Leadership, coaching and support for the project and programme management leaders and team
- Delivery standards, maturity and continuous improvement ensuring AI, automations and process improvements are implemented effectively

##### Commercial accountability

The Delivery Director carries direct commercial accountability for project and programme delivery performance. The role owns revenue performance and recognition against budget and forecast, and is accountable for ensuring projects and programmes can be and are delivered in a commercially sustainable way with senior project and programme management leaders that aligns with agreed margin assumptions.

This encompasses project and programme profitability, delivery margin management, scope containment, operational forecasting accuracy and the early surfacing of margin leakage, delivery risk and forecasting issues.

The Delivery Director works in close partnership with the Finance and Commercial Director, who owns financial reporting integrity, pricing governance, systems architecture, commercial MI, margin analysis frameworks and forecasting governance. The Finance and Commercial Director governs the commercial operating framework; the Delivery Director is accountable for operational execution and performance within it. This distinction is deliberate and essential to maintaining clear ownership boundaries while enabling close operational collaboration.

##### Delivery performance and client confidence

The Delivery Director is accountable for client confidence across delivery, not simply project completion. The operational environment must consistently produce work that clients trust, value and want to continue investing in.

- Delivery quality is consistent and reliable across all programmes
- Communication is proactive and transparent at every stage
- Risks are surfaced early and managed with rigour
- The delivery experience reflects the strategic ambition of the work
- Teams operate with clear accountability and ownership
- Projects convert into long-term relationships, retained revenue and reputation growth

Delivery quality directly drives client retention, account growth, referrals and commercial sustainability. Operational excellence is a strategic growth driver. This role also owns containment: in pressured environments, the Delivery Director creates clarity, pace and decision-making discipline. Ambiguity, escalation drift and delivery instability stop here.

##### Workforce, capacity and delivery leadership

The Delivery Director owns the operational alignment between demand and delivery capability. This extends beyond resource allocation to encompass future project capacity planning, delivery resilience, utilisation health, project and programme management succession risk and planning.

The role is accountable for ensuring the agency has the following:

- The right people aligned to the right work at the right time
- Gaps in skills and capabilities needed for project and programme delivery is identified with the Project and Programme Leadership team
- Sufficient operational capacity to deliver the portfolio sustainably
- Strong delivery leadership within programmes and projects
- Healthy escalation and decision-making structures
- Operational clarity across multidisciplinary teams
- The role operates within the capacity planning, utilisation frameworks and reporting structures governed by the Finance and Commercial Director. As the PSA implementation matures, operational resourcing and digital production responsibilities could evolve further into the Delivery Director function.

##### Delivery maturity and operational evolution

The Delivery Director is responsible for continuously improving delivery practices, governance, embedding operational standards, sharpening escalation clarity, developing project and programme leadership capability and progression. The goal is an agency that delivers at pace without losing quality, predictability or commercial discipline. The Delivery Director is responsible for supporting the agency and the project and programme management team in getting it there and keeping it there.

##### Leadership expectations

This role is not a functional delivery lead. This is a senior leadership role operating across the agency and working closely with Executive Leadership. The Delivery Director must be equally at home with c-suite clients as in the operational detail of complex programmes.

This requires someone who holds live operational detail and strategic context simultaneously, balances client satisfaction with commercial sustainability and maintains pace without sacrificing quality. They build trust across disciplines, challenge constructively at peer level and make sound decisions in complex, ambiguous environments without creating dependency.

Operational judgement, emotional intelligence and organisational credibility are prerequisites, not differentiators.

This role is a new investment for manifesto, and the successful candidate the opportunity to shape the role and value for the business but most importantly our clients.

##### Dimensions

**Budget:** Responsible for delivering/realising £12m revenue to agreed GM. Responsible for delivery team headcount budget

**Headcount**: 6-8

##### Resource complexity and nature of work teams: high

Complex role with accountability for delivery performance coordinating multiple concurrent client programmes through multidisciplinary teams spanning delivery, engineering, design, strategy, commercial, finance and nearshore partners. The role operates across a large matrix organisation, requiring significant cross-functional influence, workforce planning and stakeholder management.

##### Problem solving responsibility and complexity: high

Independent judgement and decision-making across delivery, commercial, operational and client challenges where there may be competing priorities, ambiguity and incomplete information. The role is accountable for identifying and resolving risks, delivery issues and performance challenges that could significantly impact revenue, profitability, client relationships, organisational effectiveness and long-term business growth.

##### Change management requirements: high

Driving the continuous evolution of delivery practices, governance, operating models and organisational capability to support business growth and increased complexity. The role requires influencing executive leaders, delivery teams and cross-functional stakeholders to embed new processes, systems and behaviours while maintaining delivery performance, commercial outcomes and client confidence.

##### Internal / external interactions:

- Manifesto Exec
- Manifesto Board
- Manifesto LT
- Manifesto delivery teams
- Manifesto Finance and Ops Functions
- TPX Operations (Legal, Systems, Finance, People and Compliance)
- Clients
- Prospects
- Sector bodies/membership organisations/collaborators
- Strategic timeframe working towards: 1-3 year business plan

### About you

#### Professional experience and knowledge

The successful candidate will bring significant senior leadership experience from a digital agency or equivalent, with a proven track record of leading multidisciplinary delivery organisations and creating the conditions for sustainable growth, strong client outcomes and commercial performance.

##### Essential skills

- Senior delivery, programme, project or client services leadership within a digital agency or equivalent environment within a similar scale of manifesto.
- A track record of leading delivery, programme management or operational functions within complex client-facing organisations and multiple sectors
- Experience managing project and delivery teams at scale across multiple concurrent client engagements and sectors
- Demonstrable success building and improving delivery operating models, governance structures and organisational processes
- Direct commercial accountability for project and portfolio profitability, forecasting, delivery margin and operational financial management
- Experience leading operational change and delivery transformation
- Confidence and experience managing executive-level clients and senior stakeholders in complex delivery environments
- A background in digital delivery environments spanning strategy, design, engineering, data and client leadership
- Experience with PSA or resource management system implementation, scaled agency environments or AI-enabled delivery models would be an advantage.

##### Technical skills

- Digital programme, portfolio and delivery management
- Delivery governance and operational performance management
- Commercial management, including forecasting, revenue recognition, margin and profitability management
- Resource planning, capacity management and workforce utilisation
- Risk, issue and escalation management
- Sales-to-delivery mobilisation and programme planning
- Project and portfolio financial controls and reporting
- Delivery operating model design and continuous improvement
- PSA (Professional Services Automation) and resource management systems (desirable)
- Software development lifecycle (SDLC) and digital product delivery
- Agile, hybrid and scaled delivery methodologies
- Stakeholder and client management at executive level
- Data-driven performance analysis and management reporting
- Nearshore and third-party supplier management
- Change management and operational transformation
- Understanding of strategy, design, engineering and data delivery disciplines
- Experience with AI-enabled delivery models and automation tools (desirable)

##### PACT values

- Purpose - The beating heart of our organisation—the impact we make on people, places, and the planet. Purpose is our driving force and at the core of our organisation.
- Accountability - As we apply flexibility, pace and growth through our self-organisation, we are accountable* to all of our stakeholders.
- Craft - Craft highlights our dedication to bringing precision, problem-solving, and creativity to our work, both with our clients and internally.
- Togetherness - Togetherness is ‘how’ we work - it captures the energy, fun, and user-centred approach that we embrace. It signifies the collaborative spirit we bring to our work, including people at every level and creating a sense of belonging to our teams.

### About us

### manifesto

We are the digital experience agency for changemakers. We are committed to delivering purposeful and positive impact for people, planet and society, in restless pursuit of a better world.

We take pride in creating award-winning digital experiences, products and services that are measurably ethical, inclusive, accessible, sustainable and joyful.

Our changemaker clients include UNICEF UK, Breast Cancer Now, The Trussell Trust, Woodgreen, The Royal Academy of Arts, Zoological Society London, Historic Environment Scotland and Fauna & Flora.

Part of the TPXimpact group - a Certified B Corporation™, we are a team of 130 digital product leaders, creative designers, user experience designers, engagement specialists, software engineers and experience strategists.

### TPXimpact

TPXimpact is a digital transformation company, and Certified B Corporation™, on a mission to build a future where people, places and the planet are supported to thrive. Combining vast expertise in human-centred design, data, experience and technology, we help the public, private and third sectors with their digital transformation journey, delivering high quality solutions that improve services, experiences and outcomes. We’re passionate people who work in close collaboration with our clients to create sustainable solutions ready for an ever-evolving world.

We are committed to having a positive impact on the clients and the communities we serve. We actively encourage applications from all genders, ethnicities, disabled people, members of the LGBTQIA+ community, and those from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

Don’t meet 100% of the criteria? We still want to hear from you. Please let us know if you require any adjustments during the recruitment process.
