title: Police Officer
description:
Enforces the General Laws of the Commonwealth and the regulations of the University in support of the mission of the University. Protects lives and safeguards the property of the University community.


SCOPE:

  • Interacts frequently with students, staff, faculty, administrators, and visitors to the University.
  • Interacts with representatives of other law enforcement agencies and the court system.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  1. Patrols the University's buildings and grounds to prevent and/or discover theft, trespass, vandalism, unsafe conditions, or violation of the General Laws of the Commonwealth or the University's rules and regulations;
  2. Investigates and brings violations of the General Laws or University regulations to the attention of proper authorities;
  3. Makes arrests as necessary and performs related and follow-up tasks including processing arrested individuals, testifying in court, applying for and/or serving arrests and/or search warrants. May also serve as court liaison by filling out and signing complaints for officers to bring offenders to justice;
  4. Responds efficiently to emergency calls such as fire and personal injury; renders assistance as needed, including administering First Aid and CPR;
  5. Prepares accurate and timely written reports of incidents and arrests in accordance with departmental procedures to provide a complete and on-going record of public safety related activity; receives written/oral requests for assistance;
  6. Gives direction and general information to visitors and guests in a pleasant and helpful manner;
  7. Transports University monies to the cashier’s office;
  8. When necessary, fires a weapon accurately in accordance with departmental procedures and the laws of the Commonwealth;
  9. May engage in the use of “reasonable force” when enforcing laws within the performance of his/her duties;
  10. Reports for work on time and maintains regular attendance;
  11. Performs physical activities such as running, jumping, climbing walls and crawling; must be able to lift weight equivalent to that of a person;
  12. Writes reports and other communication coherently and accurately;
  13. Exercises restraint and good judgment under severe stress; functions competently in dangerous situations;
  14. Frequently works in extreme temperatures and weather;
  15. Must be available to work any of the seven days during a given week including nights, weekends, and holidays. Overtime may be required;
  16. Other duties as assigned.

COMPENSATION: Salary Range: $26.62 - $34.59


DIFFERENTIAL PAY: $2.25 / Hour - Second Shift and First Shift on Saturday & Sunday $3.10 / Hour - Third Shift


ESSENTIAL EMPLOYEE: This position is designated as an Essential Employee. Essential Employees are those who are expected to be on duty to operate the University and provide for the safety and well-being of our students when normal operations are suspended, e.g. when classes are cancelled or delayed and when non-essential employees are released from work.

Staffing of essential support services may be at reduced levels, determined by the Administrator, dependent on the needs of our students. No compensatory time, additional wages or premium wages will be paid under these circumstances since the suspended hours are scheduled hours and part of each employee’s regular duties.


WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • Work may be performed in an indoor or outdoor setting on even or uneven terrain.
  • Exposure to dissatisfied or abusive individuals including possible confrontations, fights and use of weapons.
  • Work may include extended periods of sitting or standing.
  • Performs physical activities such as running, jumping, climbing walls and crawling.

title: Acquisition Software Developer
description:
Be visionary Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research. We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

Job Description Our Company is built on employee mutual commitment and respect, enthusiasm and progress. Teledyne Digital Imaging is a subsidiary of Teledyne Technologies Inc., a U.S. publicly listed enterprise, and specializes in the manufacture, design, research and development of high-performance CMOS and CCD image sensors and modular expandable cameras. Teledyne Digital Imaging's products are used worldwide in machine vision, document scanning, image capture, surveillance, process monitoring, manufacturing inspection, medical imaging, and multimedia. We are seeking an Acquisition Software Developer - GigE Vision with a passion for high-performance networking and machine vision systems to join our Software R&D team. The successful candidate will contribute to the design, development, validation, and maintenance of Ethernet-based software components used across multiple industrial imaging products. This role focuses on the development of Windows software for GigE Vision devices, networking infrastructure, and related SDK components. The position requires strong software engineering practices, including automated testing, cybersecurity awareness, and modern development workflows.

What You Will Do

  • Software Development Design, implement, and maintain software components in C and C++.
  • Develop tools, test infrastructure, and automation using Python.
  • Enhance and support Ethernet and GigE Vision software stacks used in industrial imaging applications.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve customer-reported issues.
  • Participate in software architecture discussions and design reviews.
  • Collaborate with hardware, FPGA, validation, and application teams.
  • Software Quality Develop and maintain unit tests for new and existing software components.
  • Contribute to integration, system, and regression testing activities.
  • Investigate defects and implement corrective actions.
  • Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Development Processes Use Git-based source control workflows.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and automated build systems.
  • Follow established software development lifecycle processes.
  • Maintain technical documentation and design specifications.
  • Networking and Ethernet Technologies Develop and troubleshoot software involving Ethernet communications.
  • Work with IP, UDP, RoCE and related network protocols.
  • Support GigE Vision-based imaging systems and high-speed data transfer applications.
  • Analyze network performance and communication issues.

What You Need

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 3 years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong programming skills in C and C++.
  • Experience with Python scripting and automation.
  • Knowledge of software development best practices including: Source control (Git) Code reviews Automated testing Continuous integration Experience developing unit tests and test automation.
  • Knowledge of Ethernet networking fundamentals and TCP/IP.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing Windows device drivers or low-level system software.
  • Experience with Linux software development.
  • Experience with machine vision, industrial cameras, or image acquisition systems.
  • Knowledge of GigE Vision, GenICam, or related industry standards.
  • Experience with cybersecurity standards and secure software development practices.
  • Familiarity with static analysis tools, sanitizers, and software quality metrics.
  • Experience using AI-assisted coding, testing, and software development tools.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in French in a bilingual environment.

What we offer

  • A collaborative engineering culture with global impact.
  • Opportunities to work on industry‑leading imaging and semiconductor technologies.
  • Professional growth supported by experienced technical leaders.
  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.
  • Access to world‑class design tools and testing facilities.
  • A workplace that values diversity, learning, and innovation.

Salary Range: $93,700.00-$124,900.000 The anticipated salary range listed for this role is only an estimate. Actual compensation for successful candidates is carefully determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, location, local regulations (such as minimum wage), education/training, work experience, key skills, and type of position.

Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions. You may not realize it, but Teledyne enables many of the products and services you use every day.

As North County's largest social services agency, Interfaith Community Services has been "helping people help themselves" since 1979. Each year, Interfaith Community Services impacts more than 20,000 community members by providing basic needs and nutrition support, social services, shelters and housing, employment development, senior services, veterans programs and addiction recovery support.

title: Data Scientist
description:
The Opportunity

Adobe Digital Insights (ADI) has been a leading authority on the global digital economy since 2013, building its analysis on trillions of visits, billions of online transactions, and the prompts behind billions of AI-generated assets crafted with Adobe Firefly. ADI works with creators, marketers, and business leaders, up to C-level leadership at Adobe’s largest customers, to help them understand how the digital economy is shifting and how their business is performing relative to industry peers using Adobe’s unique data.

ADI’s mission is to inspire and delight all of Adobe’s audiences with leading, credible, differentiated, data-driven insights. We are transitioning to an agentic AI operating model, where LLM-powered agents are embedded across the end-to-end insights lifecycle, from raw data to business-ready insight products to audience-ready narrative. This role puts you in the middle of that work as a hands-on analyst turning Adobe’s data into the insights and stories our audiences rely on.

Role Summary

We are seeking a Data Scientist to support ADI’s digital economy work first and foremost. You will query and develop large datasets into trusted, repeatable insights. You will build the digital economy metrics and reports ADI is known for, and stepping in wherever the team needs analytical horsepower, from analysis of US dollar inflation to benchmarking critical web metrics. This is a hands-on analysis role for someone who loves finding the story in the data and getting it right.

This is a full-stack role: you will work end to end from raw data through processing and analysis to the data products downstream users depend on. Along the way you will collaborate with engineering, analysts, architects, product managers, and leadership, becoming a go-to ADI subject-matter expert.

What you'll Do

  • Own your work across the whole stack — from raw data and processing, through analysis, to data products downstream users and dashboards depend on.
  • Query, prioritize, and mine large structured and unstructured datasets (Adobe Analytics, Experience Cloud, CJA, and licensed sources) to produce accurate, defensible insights.
  • Build and maintain the recurring analyses, metrics, and indices behind ADI’s digital economy reporting, turning clean inputs into trusted outputs.
  • Flex to support any ADI topic as priorities shift across creativity trends, document efficiency, traffic based on data analysis, and product insights.
  • Turn analysis into clear narratives and visualizations that non-technical audiences can understand and act on.
  • Run ad-hoc deep dives and answer time-sensitive questions from collaborators across Adobe.
  • Work AI-natively using ADI’s AI tools and agents to speed up exploration, analysis, and drafting, while keeping a careful human eye on quality and consistency.
  • Partner with engineering to define data requirements and improve the pipelines and datasets you rely on.

What you need to succeed

  • A degree or equivalent experience in a quantitative field (economics, statistics, mathematics, data science, or similar).
  • 4–6 years turning data into insight in an analytical, data science, or research role.
  • Strong data-analyst and insights skills querying with SQL and analyzing with Python to answer real business questions, not modeling for its own sake.
  • AI-native: proficient using AI and agentic tools to accelerate exploration, analysis, and drafting, with a careful human eye on quality.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks (or a comparable large-scale data platform).
  • Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving, forming hypotheses, testing them, and synthesizing clear recommendations.
  • A knack for data storytelling: explaining complex findings simply, in both writing and visuals.
  • Curiosity, care, and self-direction in a fast paced environment with shifting priorities; collaborative across teams and levels.

Nice to Have:

  • Background in economics, econometrics, forecasting, or time-series analysis.
  • Experience with Adobe Analytics, Experience Cloud, or Customer Journey Analytics.
  • Data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or D3).
  • Experience working with survey data and methodology.
  • Familiarity with R or other scripting languages.

title: Research Analyst, Community Insights
description:
**THE ROLE: Research Analyst, Community Insights**

Britebound is a national non-profit with a mission to support middle and high school learners to explore their interests, experience potential careers, and navigate a path to a meaningful and rewarding future. We fulfill our mission through free digital-first experiences, grantmaking, policy advocacy, research, and impact investing.

We believe that exploring career possibilities, as early as middle school, and providing access to education-to-career pathways aligned with one’s passions and goals will result in greater confidence and long-term success for all students.

We are looking for a Research Analyst, Community Insights. This role will partner closely with the Research & Insights team and colleagues across Britebound on internal- and external-facing research, while owning the strategy and day-to-day effectiveness of our online research communities.

**What You’ll Do:**

- **Research & Data Analysis:**
  - Ensure data integrity through data cleaning, validation, and preparation across diverse datasets; produce topline statistics, subgroup comparisons, and multivariate analyses that address key research questions.
  - Apply statistical methods such as regression analysis, clustering, significance testing, and driver analysis to uncover insights, explain variation in outcomes, and identify actionable findings.
  - Translate complex findings into clear charts, captions, visualizations, dashboards, reports, briefs, and presentations that are compelling and accessible to non-technical audiences.
- **Online Research Community Management :**
  - Manage Britebound’s three distinct online research communities (teens, parents, and counselors).
  - Engage with internal Britebound teams to design and conduct weekly research engagements to meet team needs. Synthesize and deliver findings on a quick-turnaround cadence.
  - Design and program research engagements based on organizational needs for teen, parent, and counselor online communities.
  - Lead the launch and ongoing management of Britebound’s new counselor community, including recruitment, engagement, research programming, and continuous improvement of the member experience.
- **Online Community Strategy:**
  - Develop and steward Britebound’s overarching strategy for online research communities, establishing consistent approaches to recruitment, retention, incentives, engagement, research cadence, governance, and insight sharing across audiences.
- **Collaboration & Leadership:**
  - Help shape the Research & Insights team’s research agenda and analytical approaches; build strong cross-functional relationships to identify shared research needs and advance data-driven initiatives across Britebound.
  - Contribute to Research & Insights reports by activating Britebound’s online communities to source relevant qualitative feedback that adds depth and context to quantitative findings.
  - Propose and develop strategies for creating dashboards or other data visualizations that enable impactful use of findings from online research communities and other Britebound research projects.

**About You:**

- 5-10 years of experience in research, polling, analytics, community-based research, or a related role, with a proven track record of completing complex analyses, working with rich datasets, and developing clear data visualizations.
- Strong quantitative and analytical skills, including experience with tools such as R, SQL, Python, STATA, SPSS, Dataiku, and/or comparable platforms; able to synthesize complex information and develop actionable insights.
- Experience building, managing, or engaging online communities, panels, or research participant networks; skilled in recruitment, retention, incentive strategy, moderation, and translating member feedback into usable insights.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn quantitative and qualitative findings into concise, audience-appropriate stories and recommendations.
- Able to connect the big picture to execution, manage multiple workstreams and deadlines, and proactively identify opportunities to improve research quality and business impact.
- Collaborative, adaptable, resilient, results-oriented, and comfortable engaging in constructive debate and incorporating diverse perspectives. Able to build trust and credibility across levels and functions.

**Salary Range: $87,700 - $115,000**

Britebound is committed to fair and transparent pay. In determining compensation, we consider a variety of job-related factors, including prior experience, certifications and licenses, skills and expertise, geographic location, and internal equity.

We take a total compensation approach, meaning we look beyond salary alone to support, reward, and recognize the whole individual. Depending on role eligibility, your offer may also include a bonus, 403(b) retirement plan participation, generous paid time off, and comprehensive health and life insurance benefits. As a result, final offer amounts may vary from the salary range listed in the job posting.

Join our mission-driven organization to enjoy these perks and benefits as well as investment in your growth, contributions, and future.

**Why Britebound?**

Britebound offers a wide range of perks and benefits to Team Members, including comprehensive medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans, a retirement plan (plus match), weekly lunches, commuter benefits, and tuition reimbursement.

We also heavily prioritize a healthy work/life balance, which is why we offer all full-time Team Members generous PTO options, Summer Fridays (every Friday off between Memorial Day and Labor Day), and a company holiday break between December 25th and January 1st.

Britebound works in a Hybrid schedule (2) two days a week in our Boston HQ. We prioritize strategic thinkers, collaborators, and work/life pros who are looking to help make a difference in kid's education and career goals.

title: Clinical Content Lead
description:
About Nolla Health

Nolla is building AI-powered healthcare to make high-quality care accessible to everyone. Our medical skincare and prescription product, Nolla Derm, helps patients understand their skin and get treatment. We’re expanding into broader care, women’s health, and beyond. We’ve raised $6.5M from General Catalyst and other strategic investors.

We’re looking for a clinician who can make medical information clear, useful, and engaging—and become a recognizable face of Nolla.

The role

You’ll lead clinical content at Nolla: finding the questions patients actually care about, researching the answers, writing scripts, and bringing them to life on camera.

This is a hands-on creative role. You’ll regularly film videos, create graphics and educational content, and help manage our social presence. You’ll also work directly with the founding team on founder videos, product explainers, interviews, and other brand content.

Your initial focus will be medical skincare and prescriptions: conditions, ingredients, treatment expectations, common misconceptions, and how to navigate care. Over time, you’ll help us bring that same approach to other areas of health.

We have a full-time video editor to support production. You’ll own the ideas, preparation, filming, creative direction, and feedback that turn raw footage into compelling content.

We strongly prefer an NP or PA. We’re also open to RNs and other clinicians with strong clinical experience and an excellent content portfolio.

What you’ll do

Create clinical content

  • Regularly appear on camera as a clinical face of Nolla, bringing warmth, credibility, and a natural conversational style.

  • Research topics and write hooks, scripts, captions, and creative briefs.

  • Develop recurring content series around patient questions, treatment journeys, and topics people misunderstand.

  • Create educational graphics, carousels, and other visual content using tools such as Canva, Figma, and AI design tools.

  • Turn complex clinical information into clear explanations that are accurate without feeling like a lecture.

Work with the founding team

  • Develop content ideas with the founders and help bring their perspectives, product knowledge, and company story to life.

  • Plan and direct shoots, helping people feel comfortable on camera and capture what the content needs.

  • Give our editor clear briefs, organized footage, and actionable feedback.

  • Review finished content for clinical accuracy, storytelling, and consistency with the brand.

Own the content workflow

  • Help set the direction and calendar for Nolla’s social channels, especially Instagram and TikTok.

  • Keep briefs, scripts, shoot schedules, assets, approvals, and publishing timelines organized.

  • Coordinate with the founding, clinical, growth, and creative teams to move content from idea to publication.

  • Use audience questions and performance data—including watch time, saves, shares, and patient interest—to improve what we create.

Bring clinical judgment to the brand

  • Research and fact-check content, collaborating with our clinical team on medical review.

  • Communicate treatment benefits, limitations, and expectations clearly and responsibly.

  • Recognize when a topic needs specialist input or a patient question requires individual care.

  • Bring insights from patient care into our content and product experience.

As the platform develops, there may also be opportunities to contribute to patient education and patient-facing care, depending on your interests, credentials, and licensure.

What you bring

  • Clinical training and patient-care experience as an NP, PA, RN, or another qualified healthcare professional. NP or PA strongly preferred.

  • Experience creating health or medical content, with examples of you speaking on camera.

  • A background managing social media for a brand, practice, organization, or your own professional account.

  • Strong writing skills and confidence developing briefs, scripts, and creative concepts.

  • Comfort directing shoots, collaborating with founders, and giving creative feedback.

  • The ability to create clear, polished graphics, with familiarity with Canva, Figma, and AI design tools.

  • Strong organization and follow-through: you can manage several pieces of content and consistently get them published.

  • Sound clinical judgment and a commitment to accurate, evidence-based communication.

  • Availability to work full-time, in person in New York City.

Bonus points

  • An established, engaged social media following, particularly around health, skincare, or wellness.

  • Experience in dermatology, medical skincare, or prescription treatments.

  • Experience in primary care, women’s health, or other areas relevant to Nolla’s expansion.

  • Experience at a healthcare startup, consumer health brand, or telehealth platform.

  • A track record of growing an audience and improving content performance.

Role logistics, compensation & benefits

  • Role Type: Clinical Content / Marketing

  • Base Salary: $125,000–$150,000 annually, based on experience

  • Job Type: Full-time

  • Work Setup: In-person, New York City

  • Equity: Meaningful equity, commensurate with experience

  • Health Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision

  • HSA/FSA: Eligible

  • Time Off: Flexible, unlimited vacation

  • Additional Perks: Meal stipends, team retreats

  • Work Hours: Flexible but demanding. We’re building something that matters

  • Growth: Opportunity to take on expanded responsibilities as Nolla grows

To apply

Please share your resume, a link to your Instagram, and any other relevant social accounts or portfolio. Include two or three videos featuring you on camera, along with examples of graphics, scripts, or briefs you’ve created. Tell us which parts of the work you owned.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Location:UK wide - hybrid

Salary:£65,000 - £75,000

### About the role

A Principal Engineer is the most senior technical role in manifesto’s  engineering team , providing leadership when it matters most: whether shaping a new client opportunity, designing complex architecture or resolving a critical live issue.

You will work across our client estate rather than being embedded in a single project, moving between platforms and codebases as the work demands. You will hold technical authority across our core stacks, .NET and Umbraco, PHP and Drupal, alongside the cloud infrastructure and hosting platforms that sit underneath them.

The role has three sides to it. You help shape technical solutions through discovery, technical qualification and solution design. You steer delivery on our most complex projects, setting the architectural direction and lifting the standard of the engineering around you. And you are the person who can drop into an unfamiliar codebase under pressure and diagnose what is actually happening, giving both our teams and our clients confidence at the moments that matter most.

We build digital products for charities, non-profits and membership and visitor organisations. Our clients are purpose-led, often working with constrained budgets, and the platforms we build carry donation journeys, supporter data and services people depend on. Technical decisions here have real consequences, and this role exists to make sure we get them right.

#### **Responsibilities**

- Provide technical authority across our client estate, spanning multiple platforms, hosting environments and codebases.
- Shape technical solutions for new business, from initial qualification through discovery to solution design and estimation.
- Lead the architecture of our largest and most complex client projects.
- Act as the senior technical escalation point for live incidents and complex problems, across multiple stacks.
- Raise the standard of engineering across the department through mentorship, technical review and setting clear standards.
- Build client confidence by representing us credibly with senior technical stakeholders.

##### **You set and hold the technical direction on our most complex work**

- You define architecture that is appropriate to the client's budget, team and long-term maintenance capability, not to the most interesting technical solution available.
- You uphold a clear software design philosophy and ensure teams deliver maintainable solutions.
- You have a clear understanding of simplicity. You define solutions that are simple by design and challenge requirements that introduce unconsidered complexity.
- You identify and challenge ineffective practices in delivery teams and in client organisations.
- You delegate, and maintain clear separation from work that should be considered routine.
- You make hosting, infrastructure and platform decisions with a clear view of cost, security and who will be responsible for what after launch.
- You are the senior technical escalation point across the estate
- You diagnose and resolve complex problems in codebases you did not write and may not have seen before.
- You lead the technical response to significant incidents, establishing root cause and directing remediation.
- You give clients and internal teams confidence at the point where things have gone wrong, through clear communication and visible control of the situation.
- You identify the systemic causes behind recurring problems and drive the changes that stop them repeating.
- You raise the standard of engineering across the department
- You are an active and visible technical leader across the company.
- You mentor lead and senior engineers, building capability rather than absorbing the hard work yourself.
- You contribute to and uphold our engineering standards, technical governance and software development lifecycle.
- You demonstrate your passion for keeping on top of current tools, standards and trends, including AI-assisted engineering practice.
- You support marketing and new business with prototypes, thought leadership or presentations where it plays to your strengths.
- You create learning within the team by specifying solutions that further our collective knowledge and give others opportunities to grow.

### About you

#### **Professional knowledge and experience**

- **Cross-stack technical depth.** Genuine working expertise across more than one platform and language, specifically .NET and Umbraco alongside PHP and Drupal. Comfortable holding technical authority in both rather than being deep in one and passing in the other.
- **Architectural leadership.** Expert in designing robust, scalable and secure architectures for content-managed platforms, integrations and modern web applications.
- **Cloud and infrastructure.** Practical, hands-on experience with cloud platforms, particularly Azure, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code and managed hosting environments. Enough depth to make infrastructure decisions and resolve infrastructure problems with minimal support.
- **Diagnostic ability under pressure.** Proven ability to enter an unfamiliar codebase, establish what is happening quickly, and lead resolution. This is a defining requirement of the role.
- **Pre-sales and technical discovery.** Experience qualifying opportunities, running technical discovery, producing solution designs and estimating work before it is sold.
- **Software engineering principles.** Mastery of clean code, testing practice, design patterns, security and accessibility standards.
- **Leadership and mentorship.** Demonstrated experience developing lead and senior engineers, raising standards through others rather than personally absorbing the difficult work.
- **Commercial awareness.** Understands that technical decisions carry margin, risk and maintenance consequences, and factors this into the solutions proposed.
- **Communication**. Outstanding ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, and to hold client confidence when things are difficult.

#### **Technical skills**

##### **Essential**

- Strong hands-on experience with content management platforms across more than one stack, specifically Umbraco and .NET, and Drupal and PHP
- Practical cloud engineering experience, primarily Azure, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code and environment management
- Experience across managed hosting platforms such as Azure, Acquia, Umbraco Cloud, WP Engine or Pantheon
- API design and integration, REST and GraphQL, including third-party systems such as CRM, payment and marketing platforms
- Security by design and DevSecOps practice, with particular awareness of handling supporter and donor data
- Accessibility standards and practice, WCAG 2.2 and above
- Version control, branching strategy and release management at scale across multiple codebases
- Agile delivery practice, and how to make it work in a client services context

##### **Desirable**

- Headless and decoupled CMS architecture
- Authentication and identity, including OAuth and SSO
- Search implementation, including AI-assisted and hybrid search
- AI-assisted engineering practice, agentic tooling or AI-enabled development workflows
- Experience of the charity, non-profit or membership sector and its particular constraints

#### **Behaviours**

description:
YSS is looking for a nuturing, hands-on Farm Coordinator to help young adults build skills, confidence, and pathways toward greater stability and self-sufficiency through our innovative Rooftop Gardens program.

Rooftop Gardens combines hydroponic farming and workforce development to create meaningful opportunities for young adults ages 18–24, including those with lived experience in foster care or the juvenile justice system, those experiencing homelessness, and others facing barriers to stability. Through a six-month apprenticeship, cohorts of young adults gain hands-on employment experience while building skills in workforce readiness, financial capability, housing stability, and healthy living.

As the Rooftop Gardens Farm Coordinator, you’ll bring the program to life by leading the day-to-day operation of our six hydroponic farms while teaching, mentoring, and supporting Participants as they develop skills for work and independent living. You’ll balance the practical work of growing and harvesting with the relationship-building and leadership needed to help young adults succeed.

What you'll do...

  • Oversee the daily operation, maintenance, growing, and harvesting of the program’s six hydroponic farms.

  • Develop and maintain relationships with businesses, community organizations, and other stakeholders to strengthen the program and create opportunities for Participants.
  • Assist with Participant recruitment, marketing, promotional activities, and community outreach as needed.
  • Maintain accurate records, collect program data, and complete required reports to support funding and program requirements.
  • Participate in required meetings and work closely with YSS staff, program partners, and external stakeholders.
  • Implement and follow YSS and Rooftop Gardens policies, procedures, and program requirements.

This is not a complete list of the responsibilities of this position. Duties may change at any time.

Who You Are...

You’re a hands-on, compassionate, and dependable person who enjoys both working with your hands and working with people. You’re comfortable getting into the details of growing and farm operations while also building relationships, teaching new skills, and encouraging young adults as they work toward greater stability and independence. You’re patient, adaptable, and organized—and you see potential in every Participant you work with.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We have a strong and growing product development organization made up of experienced professionals and talented junior engineers. Our product roadmap is healthy well into the future, offering a variety of technically meaningful challenges. To support our long-term roadmap and ambitious technology goals, we are looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer to help develop and maintain the infrastructure, tools, and processes that enable efficient, secure, and high-quality software and product delivery. We are seeking a hands-on professional with strong experience in DevOps toolchains, automation, CI/CD, and Kubernetes-based platforms.

Your role: As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and maintaining the development infrastructure used throughout the product lifecycle, including the underlying network connectivity and security controls. The environment includes source code and artifact management, build and release automation, test infrastructure, Kubernetes-based platforms, and integrations supporting requirements management, verification, validation, and product releases. You will collaborate closely with development teams to streamline development workflows and introduce modern tools and practices that support developers in their daily work.

Main Responsibilities

  • Maintain and continuously improve the development environment and DevOps toolchain, manage source code repositories, build systems, CI/CD pipelines, and artifact repositories.
  • Design, implement, and maintain secure, resilient network connectivity for development, build, test and deployment environments and troubleshoot issues.
  • Support network architecture and configuration for Kubernetes-based platforms, including ingress controls, load balancing, DNS, service connectivity, network policies and certificate management.
  • Ensure development infrastructure complies with relevant standards, cybersecurity requirements, and regulations.
  • Automate manual processes and drive continuous improvements in efficiency, reliability, traceability, and quality.
  • Integrate security controls, vulnerability management, and compliance checks into the software development lifecycle.
  • Evaluate, implement, and support AI-powered tools that enhance developer productivity.
  • Administer developer tools and software, integrate development data sources to provide clear visibility and reporting across the product development lifecycle.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent.
  • Minimum five years of relevant experience in DevOps, Build Engineering, Software Tooling, or a similar role.
  • Solid understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, proxies, load balancing, TLS/PKI, and network segmentation.
  • Experience with DevOps technologies such as GitLab, Git, Docker, Jenkins, Artifactory, Nexus, or similar.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated software delivery processes.
  • Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating Kubernetes-based container platforms.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, secure software development, open-source software governance, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability solutions.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar).
  • Strong communication skills in Finnish and English, both written and spoken.

We do not expect you to meet every requirement listed above. If you have a strong DevOps background, a hands-on mindset, and experience in many of the areas described, we encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, continuous learning, and the ability to solve complex technical challenges just as much as experience with specific tools.

What you will be part of Saab Sensor Technology Center in Tampere is part of Saab Surveillance business area. Our R&D teams are developing extremely versatile and innovative electronic warfare systems, motivated by a clear target: to keep people safe. As an example of a brilliant product we are developing in Tampere, check out Sirius Compact! Our development projects cover different phases of the product development cycle, from specification through development to laboratory and qualification testing, and development environment maintenance has a part in all of it.

In addition to learning by doing, Saab offers various trainings and learning paths to help you build your competence and career. We support flexible ways of working and offer opportunities for occasional remote work when the nature of the tasks allows. As a DevOps Engineer, you will work closely with software developers, architects, and engineering teams to continuously improve our development platforms, tools, and processes. Because of this close collaboration and the nature of our development environment, most work is carried out on site at our modern Saab Technology Center in Tampere.

Employee Benefits

  • employee share matching program
  • support for your daily commute through public transport benefits or parking options

In this job, some of your tasks have a connection to defense secrecy. Therefore, a drug test and approved security clearance in accordance with the Finnish Security Clearance act 726/2014 is required for the selected applicant.

We hope to welcome you to the team as soon as possible. We understand that candidates have different notice periods and circumstances, so we are happy to discuss a start date that works for both sides.

Why join us?

  • Play a key role in enabling the development of cutting-edge electronic warfare systems
  • Work with modern DevOps technologies, Kubernetes platforms, and automation solutions
  • Take ownership of processes and solutions that directly support product development and delivery
  • Collaborate with highly skilled software, systems, and engineering professionals
  • Grow your expertise through continuous learning, training opportunities and challenging technical projects

Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

description:
About Vanir

Vanir is a proud minority- and woman-owned company, recognized as a national leader in program, project and construction management (PMCM) and real estate development. Since 1964, we have consistently exceeded client expectations. Ranked as a top PMCM firm by Engineering News-Record (ENR) for more than three decades, our award-winning team provides a full range of services to public and private sector clients in the aviation; healthcare; education (K-12 and higher); justice and essential services; science and technology; state and local government; transportation; water and wastewater; energy; and commercial, residential and nonprofit markets.

Job Description

Vanir is always interested in connecting with talented Project Managers for current and future opportunities.

This is a general application and is not associated with a specific current opening or project. By submitting your application, you will be considered for opportunities as they become available based on your experience, qualifications, location, and career interests. The Project Manager provides the planning, coordination, and direction for project management activities to ensure they meet owner needs, specifications, cost, and schedule, from initial project identification through construction closeout. May supervise office/field administrative staff, project/field engineers, assistant project/construction managers, and other assigned staff.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Primary contact and liaison for owner and principle partner entities for the contract, design, systems, procedures and related deliverables

  • Leads in project meetings to include documentation, administration, and tracking of relevant information and statuses
  • May coordinate, direct, and monitor activities of construction management staff, contractors, engineers, architects, and related performing entities

  • Performs other duties as required

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or equivalent is required (Extensive relevant project management experience in place of education may be considered)
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Project Manager is required
  • Knowledge and application of master planning, A/E solicitation, project development, design-phase management, construction estimating, cost, project controls/scheduling, documentation, engineering/construction principles, contracts and delivery methods are required
  • Strong computer skills and familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite products, and experience with project-related systems such as Prolog and Primavera are required

Vanir offers a comprehensive, competitive benefits package that includes 401(k) Savings with employer matching contributions, medical, dental, vision, health savings account (HSA) with employer contributions, life, AD&D and disability benefits, flexible spending account (FSA), voluntary benefits, Teladoc, pet insurance, paid time off, national employee assistance program (EAP) and employee referral program.

title: Software Developer Backend
description:
Packly è una digital manufacturing company che sta trasformando il modo in cui il packaging personalizzato viene progettato e prodotto. Attraverso la nostra piattaforma online, aziende e designer possono creare, visualizzare in anteprima e ordinare packaging, dal singolo prototipo fino alla produzione completa, senza quantità minime.

Ciò che ci distingue è la connessione diretta tra tecnologia digitale e produzione industriale. Dietro la piattaforma c’è uno stabilimento produttivo dove macchinari avanzati, processi ottimizzati e persone altamente qualificate trasformano ogni giorno i progetti digitali in packaging reale, prodotto on demand e con meno sprechi.

Oggi migliaia di aziende in tutto il mondo utilizzano Packly per progettare, prototipare e produrre packaging in modo più efficiente.

In Packly lavorerai all’intersezione tra tecnologia e manifattura, contribuendo a strumenti e processi utilizzati da aziende in tutto il mondo. Farai parte di un team internazionale e multidisciplinare che affronta sfide reali con impatto globale, in un contesto dove le idee vengono ascoltate e il contributo delle persone conta davvero, indipendentemente dal ruolo o dall’anzianità.

L’ambiente è informale ma altamente professionale: le persone esprimono le proprie idee, portano avanti le iniziative e si assumono la responsabilità del proprio lavoro.

Background e prospettive diverse non sono solo benvenuti: sono ciò che rende il team più forte. Qui tutti hanno un posto al tavolo — non perché sia scritto in una policy, ma perché è semplicemente il modo in cui lavoriamo.

Se cerchi un luogo in cui poter davvero lasciare il segno, Packly è il tipo di azienda che lo rende possibile. Stiamo crescendo rapidamente, e questa crescita crea opportunità reali per assumere responsabilità, sviluppare nuove competenze e costruire un percorso professionale che evolve insieme all’azienda. Investiamo nelle persone perché i nostri risultati dipendono da loro.

Quello che costruiamo contribuisce anche a un modello di packaging più sostenibile: una produzione on demand progettata per ridurre gli sprechi fin dall’origine.

Stiamo cercando un/una Backend Developer con solide competenze DevOps per rafforzare il nostro team tecnico e contribuire all'evoluzione delle nostre piattaforme digitali.

Avrai l'opportunità di lavorare sulla progettazione, implementazione e gestione delle nostre architetture backend scalabili e resilienti. Il tuo ruolo sarà cruciale non solo nello sviluppo del software, ma anche nell'ottimizzazione dell'infrastruttura, nell'automazione dei processi di rilascio (CI/CD) e nella gestione dei nostri ambienti containerizzati su piattaforme cloud.

Le attività che seguirai:

  • Progettare e implementare API RESTful (e/o GraphQL) e architetture backend scalabili e performanti, con un focus su microservizi.
  • Sviluppare e mantenere applicazioni server-side (es. utilizzando Node.js o altri stack moderni).
  • Gestire e ottimizzare l'infrastruttura assicurando affidabilità, scalabilità e controllo dei costi.
  • Implementare e manutenere pipeline di CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment) per automatizzare i processi di build, test e rilascio.
  • Gestire la containerizzazione delle applicazioni (Docker) e la loro orchestrazione (Kubernetes).
  • Monitorare le performance dell'infrastruttura e delle applicazioni, intervenendo proattivamente per risolvere bottleneck e incidenti.
  • Integrare servizi esterni e gestire database (SQL e NoSQL) per supportare le funzionalità dell'applicazione.
  • Partecipare attivamente alle code review e contribuire al miglioramento continuo delle pratiche di sviluppo e DevOps.
  • Lavorare in metodologia Agile partecipando attivamente ai processi di planning e retrospective.
  • Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica o discipline affini, oppure esperienza equivalente.
  • Esperienza professionale di almeno 3 anni nello sviluppo backend e in ruoli con responsabilità DevOps.
  • Competenza avanzata nella containerizzazione e nell'orchestrazione (Kubernetes).
  • Solida esperienza nella creazione e manutenzione di pipeline CI/CD (es. GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Conoscenza approfondita di Node.js, TypeScript e framework come Express.js, Fastify o NestJS.
  • Esperienza nello sviluppo di API RESTful e / o GraphQL
  • Conoscenza di Git e piattaforme di versionamento (GitHub).
  • Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.
  • Capacità di problem solving e mentalità orientata ai risultati.

Competenze preferenziali:

  • Esperienza con sistemi di monitoraggio e logging (es. Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack).
  • Conoscenza di architetture event-driven (es. Kafka, RabbitMQ).
  • Conoscenza di GraphQL / Apollo.
  • Conoscenza di gRPC
  • Esperienza con Headless CMS.
  • Esperienza con metodologie Agile/Scrum.
  • Inserimento in un’azienda solida, innovativa e in forte espansione.
  • Un ambiente di lavoro collaborativo, attento alle persone e aperto all’ascolto.
  • Formazione continua sul campo e reali opportunità di crescita professionale.
  • Un contesto unico che unisce tradizione manifatturiera e innovazione digitale, dove ogni contributo fa la differenza.

title: Producer
description:
A Producer at TUX is a highly organized, solution-oriented leader who oversees the end-to-end production of advertising campaigns, from pre-production planning to final asset delivery. This role is responsible for managing budgets, timelines, vendors, and on-set logistics, ensuring all creative and production elements align seamlessly.

Producers at TUX work across a variety of productions, from small-scale social shoots to large-scale 360° national campaigns, collaborating closely with Executive Producers, Production Coordinators, Creatives, Client Partners and Post-Production teams. If you’re an experienced producer who thrives in fast-paced environments, loves problem-solving, and is motivated about creating complex and dynamic work, then this is the role for you.

Success in this role is directly measured by:

– Flawless execution of creative productions: delivering projects on time, within budget, and meeting creative expectations.

– Strong budget & resource management: maximizing efficiency while ensuring high production value.

– Clear communication & leadership: acting as the central point of contact between client partners, creatives, vendors, and production teams.

– Proactive problem-solving: identifying risks early and implementing solutions to keep productions running smoothly.

– Client & team satisfaction: building strong relationships by fostering collaboration, transparency, and trust throughout the production process.

Responsibilities and Sample Daily Tasks:

– Develop and manage production budgets, schedules, and resourcing plans for multiple projects.

– Lead pre-production meetings, aligning creatives, clients, and vendors on production details.

– Source and negotiate with vendors, talent, crew, locations, and production partners.

– Oversee all permits, insurance, contracts, and legal documentation needed for productions.

– Collaborate with the Creative team to ensure production solutions align with the campaign vision.

– Oversee all aspects of shoot execution, ensuring seamless on-set operations.

– Manage crew logistics, call sheets, schedules, and production timelines.

– Act as the primary liaison between client teams, creatives, and production crews, ensuring clear communication and alignment.

– Troubleshoot logistical challenges, problem-solve in real time, and make quick decisions under pressure.

– Coordinate with Post Producer and post-production teams (editors, VFX, sound, and colorists) to ensure smooth workflow and timely deliveries, as relevant.

– Alongside Client Partners, track review rounds, client feedback, and approvals to keep projects moving forward.

– Ensure all deliverables meet technical specs, creative expectations, and platform requirements.

– Oversee final asset delivery and archive production files for future use.

Skills and Qualifications:

– Experience: 4+ years of production experience at an agency, production company, brand, or in a freelance capacity.

– Technical Skills: Strong understanding of budgeting, scheduling, and the full production lifecycle (pre-production, on-set, and post). Experience with Excel, Google Sheets, budgeting tools, and production management software. Familiarity with Figma and Adobe Creative Suite is a plus.

– Personal Skills: Ability to juggle multiple projects, track moving parts, and maintain meticulous attention to detail. Strong ability to lead teams, manage stakeholders, and navigate high-pressure production environments.

– Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with broadcast, digital, and social media production requirements, as well as emerging trends in advertising production.

– Languages: TUX operates in English and French, and additional language proficiency is a plus.

Required Qualities:

– Highly Organized & Detail-Oriented – Ensures no detail falls through the cracks across complex productions.

– Cool Under Pressure – Thrives in high-stakes, fast-paced environments.

– Proactive Communicator – Keeps clients, creatives, and crews aligned throughout every phase of production.

– Budget-Conscious & Strategic Thinker – Balances financial efficiency with creative execution.

– Collaborative Leader – Excels at building trust, leading teams, and making confident decisions.

What We Offer:

- A 4-day work week with competitive compensation
- Offices in Los Angeles
- A diverse set of international brands and campaigns
- Strong in-house production capabilities
- A sharp, culturally aware team
- A company that’s the right size (not too big, not too small)
- A people-first management approach based on collaboration, empathy, and tailored development

Working with us means joining talented, passionate, and supportive teams. It also means thriving in a company culture that values and nurtures curiosity. Yes, you’ll have access to tools and resources to keep learning year-round, but you’ll also dive into offbeat, out-of-the-box projects—perfect for sparking inspiration. Speaking of which: we work a four-day week. Because great ideas don’t just happen at the office between 9 and 5.

Oh, and we’re idealists. We’re counting on you to help us build a company that’s more diverse, equitable, and inclusive. If this resonates with you, let’s connect!


[Learn more](https://workforcenow.adp.com/en/culture/)

title: Sr. Program Manager, Talent Systems & Process Design
description:
The Opportunity

As a Sr. Program Manager on the Global Talent Acquisition Team at Adobe, you will play a vital role in optimizing global recruiting processes. You will be a key player in crafting the future of our recruitment operations, driving solutions for both long-term and immediate priorities. Your role will be instrumental in ensuring flawless execution and implementing innovative strategies in a world-class organization! The right candidate brings deep talent operations expertise, thrives in complex collaborative environments, and excels at translating strategy into action!

What you'll Do

  • Play a critical role in our talent systems and process design team by maturing and optimizing workflows and ensuring solutions are scalable and user-centric.
  • Collaborate independently with cross-functional partners demonstrating executive presence to influence and align partners at all levels.
  • Provide strategic leadership in design thinking and support vision development for innovation within Global TA.
  • Establish, design, and implement TA programs and initiatives that streamline processes and technology while ensuring systems are AI-ready.
  • Analyze and report on program outcomes using industry-standard approaches and benchmarking to make data-driven recommendations on continuous improvement.
  • Proactively identify the need for new areas of analysis or gaps in existing product lines.
  • Ability to translate customer feedback and business requirements into actionable process enhancements and system integrations.
  • Proven ability to map, analyze, and improve end-to-end recruiting and operational processes using methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Design Thinking.
  • Operate collaboratively and influence as a trusted partner with cross-functional teams including Talent Acquisition, HR Tech, People Analytics, Legal/POCL and more.
  • Translate strategic business decisions into results with clear success criteria.
  • Establish and maintain SOPs, user guides, and knowledge articles.

  • 8+ years of experience in TA Operations and/or HR product or project management, with a relevant bachelor’s degree or advanced degree.
  • Proven track record managing complex, cross-functional programs end-to-end — from scoping and planning through execution, risk management, and delivery.
  • Comfortable building programs from the ground up — designing new processes, systems, or workflows where none exist yet, rather than just optimizing established ones.
  • Experience with TA systems such as Workday (ATS), candidate relationship management (CRM) platforms, LinkedIn Recruiter and Talent Insights, AI first talent intelligence platforms like BrightHire.

title: Senior Data Architect
description:
Opportunity


As a Senior Customer Experience Orchestration Data Architect at Adobe, you will lead the development of advanced, secure data solutions for our innovative digital marketing platforms. We craft data strategy, architecture, SQL and governance for customer solutions, including end-to-end profiles, segmentation, journeys, and campaigns!

What You’ll Do

  • Provide deep experience to build data solutions across multiple Adobe products and cloud platforms aligned with enterprise data strategy.
  • Engage closely with customers and Adobe team to facilitate data discovery by evaluating systems and business processes. Analyze customer sources, data movement, data granularity, relationships, data format, etc.
  • Unify disparate data (e.g., sales, CRM, analytics data, etc.) to meet customers’ digital marketing use cases. Lead and develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models for multi-solution delivery.
  • Establish frameworks for data quality, define standards, master data management, data services, data governance, data modeling, tools, data security, privacy, and compliance with industry regulations (PII, PCI, HIPAA, GDPR, etc.).
  • We develop and champion data architecture guidelines via detailed documentation. These encompass architectural blueprints, ERDs, data flow diagrams, source-to-target mappings, data dictionaries, metadata catalogs, governance frameworks, guardrails, and security and compliance protocols.
  • We engage with cross-disciplinary groups and Adobe professionals to identify customer demands. We provide data layout and strategic blueprints, advocating for scalable, secure resolutions. Assume the role of a liaison to promptly tackle technical obstacles.
  • We develop strategies for growing data volumes, tools, and integrations, while aligning with customers’ objectives.
  • We deliver mentorship on data architecture to customers and consultants to align work with targets.
  • We deliver Adobe platform data lake and real-time customer profile to get ready for data ingestion and activation. Employ REST APIs, Postman, and basic scripting to automate and streamline the implementation and setup.
  • Develop and construct data ingestion solutions for streaming and batch processing, online and offline data within AEP. Collaborate with data engineers to develop and implement ETL/ELT pipelines for data collection and extraction.
  • We improve data query performance across platforms by tuning models and adhering to guidelines and ensure product guardrails are followed and deployed in solutions

Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of data architecture, modeling, SQL, and working with customers!
  • Expert proficiency in crafting customer-centric database models, datasets (e.g., CRM, Call Center, Marketing, Offline, Point of Sale, etc.) with relational, hierarchical (e.g., RDBMS, Columnar, Data Warehouse, BI, Document, Semantic layer modeling, Data Lakes, OLTP & OLAP, etc.).
  • Advanced skills in SQL development (e.g., functions, data transformations, arrays, joins details, stored procedures, data analysis).
  • Deep experience in translating business requirements into scalable data architecture by conducting structured analysis of data workflows and processes
  • Demonstrate outstanding organizational skills and ability to balance customer projects concurrently with strong verbal, written communication skills and previous experience with customer-facing engagements

Special Consideration given for

  • Hands-on use or administration of Adobe Experience Platform (AEP)
  • Deep domain expertise in one or more industries (Retail, Telecom, Healthcare, Automotive, Cloud and Streaming platforms, etc.)
  • Experience with programming languages (e.g., Python or Bash scripting)

title: Deal Desk Analyst
description:
The opportunity

From the moment you wake up in the morning until you go to bed at night consider the media you consume, the adverts you see, the apps you use, the websites you browse and almost all of the shopping you do online throughout the day. Chances are that every single one of those interactions, every single one of those experiences, was touched by an Adobe product.

We have a fantastic opportunity for a Deal Desk Analyst to join our regional team based in Paris.

The primary focus of this role is to help structure profitable deals that meet the needs of a diverse set of internal partners, grow Adobe's revenue, and make our Western EMEA sales teams more efficient and productive. This role will own first line deal approvals, participating in deal structuring and accelerating deal closures. This will be accomplished by partnering with your sales teams to identify Customers’ key business issues and assist in crafting transactions that meet both Adobe's and Customer's goals and requirements and the Customer’s needs.

What you’ll do

  • Manage the day to day deal approval process, communicate via documented business case with cross-functional partners to articulate deal value in a consistent manner

  • Guide and counsel the sales teams during the different phases of the deal cycle

  • Prepare and draft the sales orders, ensure validation and finalisation from all internal partners

  • Interact with internal partners, including but not limited to: Legal, Sales Operations, Finance, Revenue Assurance, Business Units, Order Management, Credit and other functions

  • Regularly connect with your sales teams to ensure consistent knowledge and application of process and policy

  • Perform to a specified set of metrics and service levels

  • Ensure that transactions respect Adobe's internal revenue recognition rules, compliance policies and operational guidelines

  • Evaluate current processes and offer recommendations for areas of improvement

What you need to succeed

  • Bachelors/Masters or equivalent experience in Finance, Business or related field

  • Some experience in FP&A, Sales Finance, Sales Operations and/or Deal Desk

  • A genuine curiosity about deal structuring, sales support, and commercial operations

  • Ability to work independently in a fast paced environment

  • Capability to build strong working relationships with team members and cross-functional partners

  • Familiarity with multi-element contracts (subscriptions, licenses, services and support)

  • Professional working proficiency in English and French, written and spoken

title: Business analyst/Product owner
description:
Location:UK hybrid, within reasonable commuting distance of London or Bristol.

Salary:£40,000 - £48,000

### About the role

The Business Analyst / Product Owner plays a critical role in the successful delivery and ongoing performance of our clients’ digital estates. Working within multidisciplinary project and programme teams and in close partnership with our clients, this role translates vision, user needs, and organisational goals into clear, prioritised, and actionable requirements.

Always delivery-led, the role flexes depending on the engagement. In some contexts, the BA/PO acts as a proxy Product Owner for ongoing or retained work, owning the backlog and day-to-day prioritisation. In others, they work alongside client Product Owners, Digital Teams, and Technology leadership to shape, challenge and deliver solutions that balance immediate needs with long-term value.

This role thrives in an agency environment — managing multiple workstreams, navigating varying levels of digital maturity, and bringing clarity, structure and momentum to complex digital initiatives.

Reports to: Delivery Director (matrix relationship with Technology, Strategy and Design teams)

#### Responsibilities

##### Delivery & product ownership

- Translate client vision, user needs and business objectives into clear, structured requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.

- Own and manage product backlogs, ensuring items are prioritised to maximise value and aligned to agreed outcomes.

- Act as proxy Product Owner where required, providing continuity, pace and focus for client teams.

- Work closely with delivery teams to support sprint planning, refinement, reviews and retrospectives.

- Ensure requirements are well understood, testable and achievable within agreed constraints.


##### Client & stakeholder collaboration

- Build strong, trusted relationships with client stakeholders, operating as a partner rather than a note-taker.

- Facilitate workshops and discovery sessions to uncover needs, assumptions and opportunities.

- Confidently challenge client thinking where appropriate, balancing ambition with pragmatism and sustainability.

- Support clients with varying levels of product and digital maturity, adapting approach as needed.


##### User & outcome focus

- Champion a user-centred approach, ensuring decisions are grounded in user needs, data and evidence.

- Work with Strategists and Designers to define and track meaningful outcomes and success measures.

- Use insight from analytics and qualitative feedback to inform prioritisation and continuous improvement.


##### Business analysis & problem definition

- Work with clients and internal teams to clearly define problems before solutions are agreed.

- Analyse business needs, user needs, constraints, dependencies and risks to ensure work is well-founded.

- Surface assumptions and challenge incomplete or conflicting requirements early.

- Explore and articulate solution options, outlining trade-offs across value, cost, complexity and sustainability.

- Provide clear recommendations that support informed decision-making by clients and delivery teams.

- Maintain traceability between business objectives, user needs, requirements and delivered outcomes.

- Support effective change control by assessing the impact of new or evolving requirements.


##### Ways of working

- Apply Agile principles pragmatically, tailoring methods to suit the engagement and client context.

- Collaborate closely with Technology, Design, Strategy and Delivery colleagues to ensure joined-up thinking.

- Contribute to improving internal standards, tools and approaches for BA / PO practice across the agency.


##### Measures of success

- Backlogs are clear, prioritised and trusted by delivery teams and clients.

- Teams have the clarity they need to deliver efficiently, with minimal rework or ambiguity.

- Clients feel supported, appropriately challenged, and confident in their decision-making.

- Delivered work demonstrably contributes to agreed outcomes, not just outputs.

- User needs are consistently represented in discussions and decisions.

- Work balances short-term delivery with long-term sustainability of digital platforms.


You are comfortable operating in an agency environment, where context-switching is normal, priorities evolve, and strong relationships matter as much as strong process.

### About you

#### Experience

- Experience working as a Business Analyst, Product Owner or similar role within a digital, technology or agency environment.

- Experience supporting the delivery of digital products, platforms or services across multiple clients or workstreams.

- Exposure to clients or organisations with early to mixed levels of digital maturity.

- Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery environments.


#### Skills and experience

- Strong requirements elicitation and documentation skills (user stories, acceptance criteria, epics, roadmaps).

- Backlog management and prioritisation, balancing value, effort and risk.

- Experience of running ceremonies.

- Workshop facilitation and stakeholder engagement.

- Ability to interpret web analytics and other insight sources to inform decisions.

- Strong requirements elicitation and documentation skills (user stories, acceptance criteria, epics, roadmaps).

- Experience of running ceremonies.

- Workshop facilitation and stakeholder engagement.


#### Technical skills

- Business analysis: Experience in identifying business needs, analysing problems, and recommending solutions to improve processes and services (As Is-To Be process mapping, User Stories, Story Pointing, Minimum Via Product, MoSCoW prioritisation, Acceptance Criteria

- Strong practical understanding and application of Agile methodologies, principles and tools.

- Experience of working with common digital platforms and ecosystems, including CMS-driven and headless architectures.

- Comfortable working with tools such as Jira, Figma, Miro and web analytics platforms.

- Experience in Agile methodologies experience with agile methods and tools.


#### Dimensions

##### Budget

- Operates within agreed project or programme budgets.

- Supports value-based decision-making and change discussions, with shared commercial accountability.


##### Headcount

- No direct line management initially; works within multi-disciplinary delivery teams.

- May mentor team members informally.


##### Resource complexity & nature of work

- Multiple concurrent workstreams across different clients.

- Mix of project-based and ongoing product-style engagements.

- Varying technical complexity, including legacy platforms and evolving digital estates.


##### Change management

- Medium level of change and stakeholder complexity.

- Supports clients through shifts in ways of working, priorities and expectations.


##### Interactions

- Internal: Delivery, Technology, Design, Strategy, Client Services - mixed levels.

- External: Client project teams and wider stakeholders


##### Strategic timeframe

- Operates both tactically sprint-to-sprint while contributing to roadmaps and plans spanning approximately3–24 months.


#### Behaviours and personal attributes

You are energised by solving multiple challenges at once and bringing order to complexity. description:

Health Management Systems of America (HMSA) seeks a compassionate, skilled Clinical Therapist to join our Outpatient Clinic team.

This is an opportunity to provide meaningful behavioral-health services to individuals experiencing co-occurring mental health and substance use disorders while working collaboratively with an experienced clinical team and community partners.

The Clinical Therapist maintains responsibility for the ongoing treatment of adults and/or children experiencing severe and persistent mental illness and substance-use concerns. In this role, you will conduct assessments, develop individualized treatment plans, provide counseling services, coordinate care, and help clients navigate their path toward stability and improved well-being.
