  • Provide individual counseling services to clients experiencing severe and persistent mental illness and substance-use concerns.
  • Conduct diagnostic assessments and formulate diagnoses within your scope of practice.
  • Develop individualized treatment plans in collaboration with clients and other appropriate individuals.
  • Complete progress notes, treatment-plan updates, transition plans, discharge plans, and other required clinical documentation accurately and timely.
  • Effectively manage an assigned caseload while meeting contractual and service requirements.
  • Collaborate with the clinical team to coordinate care and facilitate appropriate internal and external referrals.
  • Coordinate services with community providers, courts, social-service agencies, and other community partners.
  • Participate in peer consultation, staff meetings, continuing education, and clinical supervision, as applicable.
  • Provide consultation and educational services to individuals and community groups as requested.
  • Participate in program development and other responsibilities assigned by management.

What We’re Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in counseling, social work, or a related behavioral or mental-health field from an accredited college or university.
  • Minimum of two years of experience in the field.
  • Current State of Michigan LLMSW or LLPC license.
  • Motivational Interviewing (MI) training.
  • Experience utilizing trauma-informed care approaches.
  • Experience utilizing Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT).
  • MCBAP CADC/CAADC certification or Development Plan.

Preferred Qualifications

  • State of Michigan LMSW or LPC license.
  • Three years of experience working with the substance-use-disorder population.
  • Two years of experience working with the criminal-justice system.
  • MCBAP CADC/CAADC certification.
  • Experience working with children.

Benefits & Professional Growth

At HMSA, we recognize that supporting our clinicians is essential to supporting the people we serve. Benefits include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance beginning the first of the month following 30 days of employment.
  • $55,000 employer-provided life insurance.
  • 401(k) retirement plan.
  • Short-term disability coverage.
  • Up to $1,400 annually in professional-development funds for eligible full-time employees toward pre-approved professional licenses, certifications, education, seminars, and training related to their position.
  • Paid vacation and sick/personal time.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • Wellness benefits.

Why HMSA?

HMSA provides behavioral-health services with an emphasis on high-quality, creative, and cost-effective care.

As a Clinical Therapist with HMSA, you’ll have the opportunity to provide meaningful clinical services, support individuals with complex behavioral-health needs, collaborate with community partners, and continue developing professionally within your field.

If you are looking for an opportunity to make a meaningful impact while working as part of a collaborative behavioral-health team, we encourage you to apply.

HMSA is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

description:

title: Threat Intelligence / Reverse Engineering Investigator
description:
The Threat Intelligence / Reverse Engineering Investigator identifies, investigates, and disrupts fraud, abuse, and adversarial activity targeting Adobe's products, services, and ecosystem. Through threat intelligence, reverse engineering, technical investigations, detection engineering, and AI-driven capabilities, the team delivers actionable intelligence and scalable mitigations that strengthen platform resilience and protect Adobe, its customers, and its ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities & Areas of Impact - The responsibilities below represent the primary areas of focus for this role and may evolve alongside emerging risks, business priorities, and organizational needs.

Threat Intelligence & Adversary Research

  • Monitor and assess adversarial activity, fraud, abuse, and emerging threats impacting Adobe products, services, and business operations.

  • Assess threat actors, campaigns, and evolving adversarial behaviors to understand risk exposure and support proactive threat mitigation efforts.

  • Leverage open- and closed-source intelligence, industry partnerships, intelligence-sharing communities, and emerging data sources to enhance threat visibility and intelligence collection capabilities.

  • Produce intelligence assessments and threat reporting that inform detection, investigations, and operational decision-making.

Reverse Engineering, Investigations & Detection

  • Reverse engineer and analyze malicious tooling, automation frameworks, browser extensions, attack infrastructure, and other mechanisms used to target or abuse Adobe services, documenting attacker methodologies and identifying opportunities for disruption.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI-enabled attack techniques, adversarial tooling, and automation frameworks, to identify evolving threats and develop scalable detection and mitigation strategies.

  • Conduct complex technical investigations into fraud, abuse, account compromise, platform misuse, and other malicious activity, including escalation analysis, attribution, root cause determination, and identification of coordinated threat activity.

  • Discover exploited or potential vulnerabilities and partner with stakeholders to develop mitigation strategies, remediation plans, and long-term risk reduction approaches.

  • Translate intelligence and investigative findings into scalable detection, monitoring, prevention, and enforcement capabilities.

  • Develop and maintain investigative methodologies, detection workflows, and operational processes that support effective threat detection, analysis, and response.

  • Strategic Collaboration & Influence

  • Partner with Product, Security, Engineering, Data Science, Risk, Trust & Safety, and other stakeholders to mitigate threats, improve platform resilience, and strengthen customer protection.

  • Support incident response and emerging threat investigations by providing intelligence, attribution analysis, investigative expertise, and strategic guidance.

  • Develop executive-ready briefings, investigative summaries, and risk assessments that communicate findings, business impact, and strategic recommendations.

  • Advise stakeholders on intelligence-driven risk mitigation, fraud prevention, abuse prevention, and vulnerability management strategies.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on adversarial behavior, emerging threats, and fraud trends, helping inform long-term threat reduction and platform protection strategies.

Qualifications & Core Competencies:

  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex investigative, intelligence, and technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for technical, operational, and executive audiences.

  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify patterns, assess risk, and transform complex data and intelligence into meaningful insights that drive informed decision-making.

  • Creative and strategic problem-solving capabilities, including the ability to anticipate emerging threats, identify gaps, and develop innovative, scalable solutions to mitigate risk.

title: Part Time Floor Leader - Willowbrook Mall
description:
Position: Part Time Floor Leader

Weekly: 20-29 hours

Interview Plan

Floor Leader

As a Floor Leader, you'll play a vital role in supporting the Store Management Team across all areas of the business. This includes everything from driving sales and opening/closing the store to analyzing sales results and leading training sessions. Together with your fellow leaders, you'll work to ensure that every aspect of the store is firing on all cylinders, creating an exceptional customer experience, a happy and motivated staff, and operational excellence that would make even the most detail-oriented among us proud.

Your day-to-day will be spent on the shop floor, where you'll lead and inspire a team of sales associates to achieve and surpass their goals. By fostering a culture of passion and positivity, you'll help create a work environment that's both productive and fun, resulting in happy customers and happy employees. The Floor Leader role is all about making the world a better place one soap at a time!

Responsibilities:

Sales & Customer Experience:

  • Driving Sales: Utilize the StoreForce dashboard results to provide effective coaching and feedback to the sales team, and make necessary adjustments to the shop floor structure to meet and exceed sales goals. Take ownership for your results and actively work to grow the contribution of your segments to the store’s overall sales. Celebrate sales achievements with your team!
  • Customer Experience: Lead by example in delivering a world-class customer experience on the shop floor, including product demonstrations. Observe and listen to consultations, collaborate with your team, and strive to exceed daily sales goals. By fostering a culture of excellence in customer service, you'll drive sales, create a loyal customer base, and build a positive reputation for your store.
  • Building the Brand: Educate customers on Lush brand values, and articulate our position on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging in the shop and through community engagement, hosting store parties, and other traffic-driving initiatives.
  • Product Passion: increase the depth of your product knowledge through constant learning and consistently make informed product recommendations for every need.

Lead by example, take ownership of your development, assess your performance, and actively seek feedback, resources, and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge and abilities.

Foster a sense of belonging by promoting teamwork, encouraging collaboration, and recognizing and valuing each employee's unique contributions.

Operational Excellence:

    • a fast-paced team environment

title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend (Online Storage)
description:
AtAffirm,weexist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Data and Storage Services team is responsible forAffirm'sdata infrastructure across OLTP and OLAP systems, spanning critical online checkout databases, batch orchestration, streaming infrastructure, event-driven frameworks, BI, analytics tooling, large-scale data platforms, and agentic data tools such as semantic layers and internal platform data applications. Our mission is to provide trustworthy, intuitive, and cost-efficient solutions forAffirmers to secure, store, analyze, and transform data at exceptional scale.

The Online Storage team provides a set of managed databases as a platform, used to persist data for allAffirmservices. Our platform enables self-service access to OLTP storage systems, including RelationalDB(MySQL), DynamoDB, Distributed SQL, Cache(Redis). As a team, we are responsible for various data and access patterns, including but not limited to mission-critical financial transactional data, data science models, and any new persistence use case. These responsibilities require us to learn and gain deep expertise in various database systems.

We are looking for a highly skilled and detail-oriented Staff Software Engineer who can drive the technical roadmap for our Databases (Relational and KeyValue) identifying opportunities to improve how we build, productize, operate and improve this mission-critical infrastructure to unlock substantial value within our business. You’ll have the opportunity to directly influence your team’s roadmap in close collaboration with your peers, share your knowledge and expertise with others and learn from some of the best on our shared mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives.

What You’ll Do

  • You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.
  • You will work closely with and contribute to other teams - including product, infrastructure, and site reliability engineering (SRE).
  • You will design and build components of a scalable datastore platform, contributing to the overallAffirm'sgoals, and leveraging experience in creating multi-region, horizontally scalable, globally available, and high-performance datastore solutions.
  • You will develop control planes for management, self service of hundreds of databases at scale automating schema/data migrations, disaster recovery, sharding and performance tuning.
  • You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle, focusing on database solutions, by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.
  • You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.
  • You take ownership of your team’s operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, policies, testing and alerting in place to support “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
  • You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

What We Look For

  • You have 8+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
  • You have an extensive track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, Spark and Kubernetes.
  • You have 5+ years of hands‑on Database Expertise, leveraging your deep knowledge of Relational and/or Distributed SQL such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, TiDB/Vitess to optimize database performance, ensuring data integrity, and implementing efficient data access patterns. Should possess deep understanding of Database fundamentals including schema design, query optimization, scaling, partitioning, sharding and performance tuning in multiple functional environments. Strong background and expertise in building and operating databases in cloud environments. Expertise in database benchmarking, load testing, and capacity planning. Familiarity with connection poolers and proxies such as ProxySQL, RDS Proxy, Pg Bouncer, etc.
  • You have experience delivering major features, system components or deprecating existing functionality in a system through the definition of a technical and execution plan. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
  • You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work.
  • Your growth and impact trajectory demonstrates that you have mastered gathering and iterating on feedback from your engineering and cross‑functional peers.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Pay Grade - P

Equity Grade - 7

Employees new to Affirms typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirms focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirms Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

CAN base pay range per year: $181,000 - 241,000 CAD

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Remote

This remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan.

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirms office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirms stock at a discount.

title: Qualified Architect (Manchester)
description:
We’re looking for a talented and passionate Project Architect to join our Manchester studio and help us design a better every day.

With several exciting new projects underway, this is an opportunity for an architect with two or more years’ post-Part 3 experience to take the next step in their career, working on projects that make a meaningful and lasting difference to the people and communities they serve.

We’re particularly keen to hear from architects with strong UK experience in education, higher education, science or healthcare, who combine excellent design judgement with the technical knowledge and confidence to take projects from concept through to delivery.

**About ADP**

At ADP, we believe architecture has the power to improve everyday life. Our work is rooted in understanding the people and communities who will use the places we design; creating environments that support learning, health and wellbeing, scientific discovery and stronger communities.

With seven studios across the UK, Cyprus and India and a 60-year history, we work collaboratively to create buildings that make a positive difference. Our approach is shaped by the principles of sustainability, belonging and engagement listening carefully, designing responsibly and creating places where people feel they belong.

**The role**

As a Project Architect, you’ll take an active role in the design and day-to-day delivery of one or more projects, working collaboratively with clients, consultants and colleagues.

You will:

- Lead projects from concept and technical design through to construction and completion.
- Translate strong design concepts into coordinated, buildable solutions while protecting the integrity of the original design intent.
- Produce and oversee high-quality drawings, specifications, technical information and presentation material.
- Coordinate consultants, specialist designers, contractors and suppliers.
- Manage work packages, programmes, information flow and key project deliverables.
- Navigate UK planning requirements, Building Regulations and procurement processes with confidence.
- Attend and contribute to client, consultant and site meetings, representing ADP with warmth and professionalism.
- Support and mentor junior colleagues, contributing to a studio culture that is collaborative, curious and generous.
- Regularly review designs against the project brief and contribute actively to design reviews.

**What you’ll bring**

We’re looking for someone with:

- A strong portfolio demonstrating both design talent and technical rigour.
- ARB registration and a professional qualification recognised in the UK. RIBA membership is welcomed but not essential.
- Typically, two or more years’ post-Part 3 experience, including experience delivering UK projects through RIBA Stages 4–6.
- Experience in education, higher education, science or healthcare projects, which is highly desirable.
- Sound knowledge of UK Building Regulations, construction detailing, procurement and contract administration.
- The judgement and organisation to coordinate multiple contributors while keeping the architectural idea coherent.
- Proficiency in Revit, alongside strong Adobe Creative Cloud skills. Enscape or equivalent visualisation experience would be an advantage.
- Excellent spoken and written English, intellectual curiosity and a calm, collaborative approach.

**Why ADP?**

ADP is an employee-owned practice, which means everyone has a voice in how the business is run and shares in its success. We believe that great architecture starts with a positive working culture, and that a healthy work-life balance enables people to do their best work. As part of this commitment, all our staff work a nine-day fortnight.

Our work and culture have also been recognised across the industry, with recent accolades including Architect of the Year at the OxProp Awards, Best Student/Pupil Experience Project at the Learning Places Scotland Awards, and the AJ Architecture Award for Best Health and Wellbeing Project.

We’re an equal opportunities employer and a gold-standard Investor in People, reflecting our belief that it takes a people-centred practice to create people-centred architecture.

Diversity is central to our success, and we warmly welcome applications from people and communities that are underrepresented within architecture.

If you’re an ambitious architect who cares about thoughtful design, technical quality and creating places that have a positive impact on people and communities, we’d love to hear from you.

##### Start Date: ASAP

##### How to Apply

If you’re interested in joining our team, please submit your CV, portfolio and a cover letter to [careers@adp-architecture.com](mailto:careers@adp-architecture.com) with ‘Architect Manchester’ in the subject line. Attachments should be in PDF format and no larger than 5MB in size.

title: Talent Operations Lead
description:
The Talent Operations Specialist is a full-time role providing the governance, compliance, and systemsenablement backbone for India Talent Acquisition. Operating beyond day-to-day execution, the role owns end-to-end operational outcomes, process and audit standards, systems and vendor governance, and critical escalations for India TA Operations. At a scale of ~2000 annual hires and 10+ Talent Coordinators, the role provides dedicated operational leadership across a complex ecosystem of Talent Partners, Talent Coordinators, COEs, Global Talent Operations (GTAO) peers, and technology/vendor partners, while also leading key global and India-specific initiatives. The position reduces reliance on contingent resources for core, audit-sensitive operations and brings clear FTE accountability to business-critical processes. The incumbent is expected to operate with significant autonomy— identifying and driving improvements, resolving operational risks, and independently representing India TAO in global forums.

Key Responsibilities

1. Talent Coordination Governance & Leadership
• Lead end-to-end TC operations across onboarding, training, workload management, offer enablement, and interview scheduling—setting operating standards and driving consistent execution.
• Own SLA and performance governance, proactively identifying risks, diagnosing root causes, and driving resolution; escalate only where policy, investment, or leadership intervention is required.
• Lead complex issue resolution and escalations, exercising judgment beyond standard playbooks and continuously strengthening processes based on recurring themes and insights.
• Drive operational health and continuous improvement through weekly performance reviews and RCAs, with clear accountability for closing systemic gaps—not simply identifying them.

2. TA Operations & Systems Enablement
• Drive operational excellence across core TA processes, including interview scheduling, offer operations, onboarding readiness, and referrals—owning execution, governance, and continuous improvement.
• Own India TA systems governance as the SPOC and SME for Workday Recruiting, ServiceNow, Phenom CRM, and HackerRank, ensuring data integrity, access governance, and effective adoption.
• Lead capability building and enablement for Recruiters and TCs through structured process and systems training, including readiness for new tools, workflows, and rollouts.
• Drive TA technology enhancements in partnership with TechOps and GTAO, leading requirements validation, UAT, change readiness, and rollout support. • Strengthen process governance and audit readiness by maintaining SOPs, governing documentation and change requests, and ensuring robust audit trails. • Identify and solve operational gaps by proactively diagnosing process inefficiencies and developing scalable, automation-led improvements for TA leadership approval.

3. Vendor, Procurement & Compliance Governance

title: Part Time Floor Leader - Mandalay Bay
description:
Position: Part Time Floor Leader

Weekly: 20-29 hours

Interview Plan

Floor Leader

As a Floor Leader, you'll play a vital role in supporting the Store Management Team across all areas of the business. This includes everything from driving sales and opening/closing the store to analyzing sales results and leading training sessions. Together with your fellow leaders, you'll work to ensure that every aspect of the store is firing on all cylinders, creating an exceptional customer experience, a happy and motivated staff, and operational excellence that would make even the most detail-oriented among us proud.

Your day-to-day will be spent on the shop floor, where you'll lead and inspire a team of sales associates to achieve and surpass their goals. By fostering a culture of passion and positivity, you'll help create a work environment that's both productive and fun, resulting in happy customers and happy employees. The Floor Leader role is all about making the world a better place one soap at a time!

Responsibilities:

Sales & Customer Experience:

  • Driving Sales: Utilize the StoreForce dashboard results to provide effective coaching and feedback to the sales team, and make necessary adjustments to the shop floor structure to meet and exceed sales goals. Take ownership for your results and actively work to grow the contribution of your segments to the store’s overall sales. Celebrate sales achievements with your team!
  • Customer Experience: Lead by example in delivering a world-class customer experience on the shop floor, including product demonstrations. Observe and listen to consultations, collaborate with your team, and strive to exceed daily sales goals. By fostering a culture of excellence in customer service, you'll drive sales, create a loyal customer base, and build a positive reputation for your store.
  • Building the Brand: Educate customers on Lush brand values, and articulate our position on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging in the shop and through community engagement, hosting store parties, and other traffic-driving initiatives.
  • Product Passion: increase the depth of your product knowledge through constant learning and consistently make informed product recommendations for every need.

Team Involvement:

  • Development: Train and coach Sales Ambassadors and peers on effective sales techniques and product knowledge to improve their performance, support the growth of your team, and to increase sales. Lead by example, take ownership of your development, assess your performance, and actively seek feedback, resources, and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge and abilities.
  • Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging: Encourage open communication and actively listen to team members perspectives related to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). Foster a sense of belonging by promoting teamwork, encouraging collaboration, and recognizing and valuing each employee's unique contributions.

Operational Excellence:

  • Cash Handling and Store Opening/Closing: Manage cash handling, including customer transactions, opening/closing the register, reconciling cash drawers, preparing nightly deposits, and securing the store at the end of each day. As required at your store location, take deposits to the bank.
  • Time and Attendance: Lead by example in terms of attendance and punctuality, and encourage the same from all employees. Monitor employee breaks to ensure they are taking their scheduled breaks, promoting a healthy work environment and improving employee wellbeing. Review daily communications, including store updates and task lists, to ensure that team members are informed and prepared for their shifts, promoting a culture of preparedness and organization.
  • Visuals and Merchandising: Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store to enhance the customer's shopping experience and drive sales.
  • Stock and Inventory: Train your team on inventory best practices and fresh standards, and support management with inventory tasks. Utilize Visual Merchandising guidelines to make real-time adjustments to product displays based on sales and improve the customer experience.
  • Policies and Procedures: Support your management team to keep your store compliant and ensure your staff are practicing company standards for opening and closing, product integrity, respectful workplace, and health and safety.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in:
    • customer service and sales
    • cash handling and opening/closing procedures
    • supervisory experience involving coaching, feedback, and training
    • problem-solving issues related to customer service in day-to-day operations
    • a fast-paced team environment
  • Knowledge and passion for skincare, natural beauty, and ethical business
  • Flexible schedule to accommodate store needs, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

Preferred:

  • Experience with consultation-based customer service models
  • Experience analyzing sales metrics
  • Experience working in skincare or cosmetics
  • Experience in cross cultural collaboration and DEIB or social justice training
  • Fluency in Spanish, French or other languages

$16.50—$16.50 USD

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Location:Hybrid - 2 days per week in London or Bristol

Salary:£40,500 - £60,000

### About the role

**Job level:** 9

**Working Style:** Hybrid, the successful candidate will be expected to attend an office on average twice a week based on client demand  in London or Bristol.

The Senior Project Manager role is vital in supporting our clients in delivering against their strategic objectives and helping meet the needs of their customers and supporters.

This role is focused on delivering delegated projects within our client portfolio of digital projects, support programs and partnership frameworks. You’ll play a key role in ensuring we provide successful, impactful project work for our clients within the digital experience and transformation realms.

Working closely with a dedicated team of client services, strategists, designers and developers, the role is  responsible for project management excellence throughout the entire project lifecycle. In return, the role works  with various exciting clients within the charity, healthcare, higher education, and culture sectors.

The  Senior Project Manager uses  skills, knowledge, and experience to manage projects of greater complexity and challenge. It will also use the  passion for craft and knowledge of different delivery methodologies to help set and maintain delivery standards across our division, mentor junior team members, and share your knowledge with our clients.

The complexity or breadth of projects, products or teams will vary in this role, depending on the context.

Project and programme management can be applied to a wide variety of change and transformation projects. The differences and skills often lie in the complexity (requirements, stakeholders, timelines, dependencies), budget size, and whether the project is part of our core offering or an extension of our work.

A senior project management role  is expected to involve medium-high value, medium-high complexity change initiatives, and it will be performed by experienced and trained project managers.

Billable at 80%

#### **Responsibilities**

- Ensuring delegated projects achieve agreed success KPIs, including but not limited to budget, time, scope, quality and client satisfaction
- Taking ownership for escalation and resolution of all risks and issues that may affect meeting project/progress success KPIs
- Maintaining accurate and timely documentation and reporting
- Flagging any opportunities to the right people where they might be an opportunity to grow or deepen a relationship
- Following agreed ways of working and behaviours as described by your SLT
- Owning your part in building an effective working relationships with all colleagues, stakeholders and clients
- Working across either portfolio delegated to either the Programme Director or Head of Project Manager (if running projects in the Programme Director’s portfolio, you will also have a dotted line into the Programme Director)
- Running Overseeing the day-to-day to day project and programme management delegated projects and programmes using agreed methodologies, approaches and frameworks
- Being mindful of the commercial underpinning of the business and your direct contribution to meeting in-month revenue forecasts
- Proactively managing project overburns, ensuring stability to project profit forecast
-  Develop a deep understanding of key client organisations and identify opportunities to improve the experience for clients’ customers and supporters; support fostering excellent client relationships through on-site meetings
- Making active contributions to governance and reporting forums
- Deepening your knowledge of your craft, our sectors and the services we provide
- Being passionate about what we do, embodying ‘make pride a KPI’
- Working in deep partnership with clients, Services and project teams
- Contributing to new business opportunities (content, proposals and pitches)
- Contributing to marketing content products via social media promotion, thought leadership, blogs etc of all of the portfolio of projects within the Sector
- Adopting a mindset of continuous improvement and optimisation
- Giving timely feedback

#### **Dimensions**

**Budget** **:** N/A

**Headcount:** N/A

**Resource complexity and nature of work teams** **;** Medium-high value,problem solving responsibility and complexity -medium-high complexity change initiatives

**Problem solving responsibility and complexity:** Senior Project Manager solves medium-high complexity problems that span: Operational delivery (managing KPIs, risks, overburns), Client experience (anticipating blockers, improving outcomes), Team and process optimisation (mentoring, cross-team coordination), Technical and strategic dimensions (digital delivery constraints, aligning with portfolio goals). Complexity arises from: multiple stakeholders, evolving requirements, multiple concurrent projects, technical coordination, and the need for commercial awareness.

**Change management requirements** **-** Project and programme management can be applied to a wide variety of change and transformation projects. The differences and skills often lie in the complexity (requirements, stakeholders, timelines, dependencies), budget size, and whether the project is part of our core offering or an extension of our work.

**Internal / external interactions:**

- Programme Director
- Head of Project Management,
- Senior leaders in manifesto
- Project managers, designers, developers, client service teams, growth team
- Communities of Practice
- Clients

**Strategic timeframe working towards:** 1-3 year business plan

### About You

#### **Professional knowledge and experience**

##### **Essential criteria**

- Agency experience
- Passionate about creating the right environment so that we can deliver the best outcomes for our client
- Substantial hands-on project management experience delivering several digital experience initiatives
- A solid understanding of Agile delivery, with experienced knowledge of the Scrum framework and a solid basis for project governance and control
- Comfortable with technical aspects of digital experience delivery and demonstrable experience across various digital experience projects such as UX, content management systems, website development, applications and integrations
- Comfortable working with ambiguity, able to use your stakeholder and delivery skills to bring shape and clarity to project plans and outcomes
- Able to work autonomously with little or no supervision
- Resilient, able to juggle a large number of priorities
- Able to work effectively across multiple projects and competing deadlines
- Excellent relationship management, stakeholder engagement, organisation, and facilitation skills
- Excellent organisation, and attention to detail
- Eager to play a role in building our business and contribute to the continuous improvement of our ways of working
- Able to support in the new business development process and take the lead for Delivery elements in new business proposals/pitches
- Able to coach and support more Junior members of the Delivery Studio

##### **Technical skills**

- Experienced Senior Project Manager specialising in digital experience and transformation projects within agency environments.
- Skilled in Agile delivery, particularly Scrum, with a strong foundation in project governance and control.
- Proven ability to manage medium to high-complexity initiatives, balancing multiple priorities and stakeholder needs with resilience and autonomy.
- Adept at technical coordination across UX, CMS, website development, and integrations. Committed to driving project success through meticulous risk management, commercial awareness, and fostering strong client and team relationships.
- Passionate about continuous improvement, mentoring junior colleagues, and contributing to business growth through new business support and thought leadership

##### **Behaviours**

- Resilient and accountable takes full ownership of project delivery while effectively managing multiple priorities and ambiguity.
- Demonstrates strong collaboration, communication, and client-focused approaches to build trust and drive successful outcomes.
- Proactively solves problems and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous improvement and excellence.
- Maintains commercial awareness and a passion for delivering high-quality, impactful digital experiences.

##### **PACT values**

- **Purpose -** The beating heart of our organisation—the impact we make on people, places, and the planet. Purpose is our driving force and at the core of our organisation.
- **Accountability -** As we apply flexibility, pace and growth through our self-organisation, we are accountable* to all of our stakeholders.
- **Craft -** Craft highlights our dedication to bringing precision, problem-solving, and creativity to our work, both with our clients and internally.
- **Togetherness -** Togetherness is ‘how’ we work - it captures the energy, fun, and user-centred approach that we embrace. It signifies the collaborative spirit we bring to our work, including people at every level and creating a sense of belonging to our team.

### About us

### **manifesto**

We are the digital experience agency for changemakers. We are committed to delivering purposeful and positive  impact for people, planet and society, in restless pursuit of a better world.

We take pride in creating award-winning digital experiences, products and services that are measurably ethical,  inclusive, accessible, sustainable and joyful.

Our changemaker clients include UNICEF UK, Breast Cancer Now, The Trussell Trust, Woodgreen, The Royal Academy of Arts, Zoological Society London, Historic Environment Scotland and Fauna & Flora.

Part of the TPXimpact group - a Certified B Corporation™, we are a team of 130 digital product leaders, creative designers, user experience designers, engagement specialists, software engineers and experience strategists.

### **TPXimpact**

TPXimpact is a digital transformation company, and Certified B Corporation™, on a mission to build a future where people, places and the planet are supported to thrive. Combining vast expertise in human-centred design, data, experience and technology, we help the public, private and third sectors with their digital transformation journey, delivering high quality solutions that improve services, experiences and outcomes. We’re passionate people who work in close collaboration with our clients to create sustainable solutions ready for an ever-evolving world.

**We are committed to having a positive impact on the clients and the communities we serve. We actively encourage applications from all genders, ethnicities, disabled people, members of the LGBTQIA+ community, and those from lower socio-economic backgrounds.**

title: Hands-on Data Center Deployment Engineer
description:
About the role

Nordecon Oy is converting a former industrial bakery building in Riihimäki into a data centre designed for AI and high performance computing workloads. Repurposing an existing industrial site brings interesting engineering problems a new build never has.

We are looking for a hands‑on Data Center Deployment Engineer to help us build it and then run it. You will be part of the core team in this role, which means you will not inherit someone else’s procedures, you will build them.

Founded in 2006, Nordecon is an OEM and solution provider with nearly two decades of experience in mobile, server and custom‑built desktop systems. The data centre is the next phase of that business.

What you will do

  • Plan and oversee the installation of data centre infrastructure: servers, storage, networking and power systems
  • Coordinate with vendors and contractors on procurement, installation, commissioning and acceptance testing
  • Configure, integrate and troubleshoot systems to keep them performing
  • Work with environmental and monitoring systems — cooling, power distribution, alarms
  • Carry out site assessments and make sure we meet safety and industry standards
  • Write and maintain the documentation: design records, installation procedures, and the operating procedures the site will run on
  • Take part in our ISO/IEC 27001 certification work. Building the operational procedures and controls that certification is based on, not just following them
  • As the team grows, support and guide our data centre technicians

What helps you succeed in this role

  • Hands‑on experience deploying and operating data centre infrastructure
  • Solid understanding of network and data cabling, and of network and power capacity planning
  • Strong Linux skills
  • Working knowledge of HVAC and cooling dynamics in a data centre context
  • Fluent Finnish and good English
  • A degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field or equivalent experience earned on the job
  • Willingness to be on site in Riihimäki, and to take part in an on‑call rotation once the site is live

Nice to have

  • Experience converting or retrofitting an existing building for data centre or other critical facility use
  • Experience commissioning a new site or a major capacity expansion
  • Liquid‑cooled or high‑density deployments
  • Exposure to ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or similar management systems
  • Electrical or HVAC qualifications

We offer you a permanent full‑time position with interesting and versatile tasks with the opportunity to have a real influence on the development of the data center. The applicant must speak Finnish.

We read every application, but we are a small team and receive a high volume of them. We will only contact candidates we invite to interview. If you have not heard from us within two weeks of applying, the role has moved forward with other candidates. We know applying takes real effort, and we appreciate the time you put into it.

Employment relationship: Employment

Wage: Other

Working time: Daytime work, Evening work, Night work, Weekdays, Weekends

Number of positions: 1

title: Senior Media Planner
description:
The Opportunity

Ready to build the media planning playbook for one of the world's most recognized brands? Adobe is establishing a new in-house media planning function to take direct ownership of end-to-end media buying and develop an AI-driven engine for global advertising execution. As Senior Media Planner, this role will translate regional media strategy into tactical media plans for one or more paid channels — starting with Meta, TikTok, and Snap — converting strategy into plans the buy desk can implement directly. It's an early opportunity to help shape how Adobe plans and buys media for years to come!

What the Role Does

This role sits between the media strategy teams and the buy desk, making sure every plan is platform-native and ready to execute! The Senior Media Planner builds tactical plans for assigned channels — audience targeting, budget splits, flighting, and placement — based on regional media strategy, and stays in daily contact with the local strategy team to maintain alignment. Keeping pace with platforms that change their ad products and targeting tools every quarter takes staying current and applying that knowledge consistently across every plan.

Finished plans get handed to Adobe's India-based media-buying team for execution. This role flags blockers and resolves them against the team's established process. Where it fits, Adobe's own marketing technology — GenPem, AEP, RTCDP — gets built into the plan, putting Adobe's platforms to work on its own advertising. Before anything moves to the buy desk, campaigns are tagged, organized, and quality-checked against Ops standards, with local nuance (language, regulatory, pricing) layered on top of consistent global planning practices.

This role will also partner with regional strategists and analysts to review campaign reporting and translate results into optimizations: budget shifts, targeting changes, and creative refreshes for their channel(s). Performance trends, platform changes, and new targeting or data-sharing opportunities get surfaced back to the Director of Media Planning and the broader team. The role also helps shape a consistent quarterly planning process and works directly with platform partners to identify testing and beta opportunities each cycle.

Scope & Reporting

This is an individual contributor role, one of a global team of seven Media Planners reporting to the US-based Director of Media Planning. The role works closely with, but does not manage, the India-based buy desk, analytics, media strategy, and engineering partners. Initial focus is paid social (Meta, TikTok, Snap), with scope expected to grow over time.

First 90 Days

During the first quarter, the goal is to ramp fast and build trust. Become proficient in Adobe's audience segments, brand guidelines, and channel mix, and work on building relationships with regional strategists regarding media objectives and planning cadence. Complete the buy desk handoff process for at least one full plan submission. You will audit current tagging, naming, and QC practices against new Ops standards. You will establish a regular cadence with regional strategy counterparts and the India-based buying team.

What's Needed to Succeed

  • 5+ years in digital advertising or media planning/buying, with hands-on experience in at least one of Meta, TikTok, or Snap

  • Strong working knowledge of platform ad managers, audience targeting tools, and campaign measurement

  • Experience managing multi-market activations, including platform setup across a wide range of markets and languages

  • A track record of delivering performance-focused paid social campaigns

  • Comfort reading campaign dashboards and working with analysts to shape concrete optimization recommendations

  • Ability to translate strategic briefs into detailed, executable media plans

  • Clear communication across regional and offshore teams, holding to global standards while adapting to local needs

  • Strong attention to detail — comfortable owning QA, QC, and documentation for assigned plans

Nice-to-Haves

  • Familiarity with AI-driven media buying, including executing buys through LLM-based tools like Meta's MCP

  • Experience with Adobe's marketing and advertising tools (GenPem, AEP, RTCDP)

  • Experience working with an offshore or outsourced buying/execution team

  • Background spanning both B2B and consumer advertising

  • Agency experience, or exposure to a newly formed team — ideally at a company insourcing media execution

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.


Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.


Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.


Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.

title: Training and Enrichment Supervisor (Full-Time)
description:
Turn Animal Behavior Expertise Into Better Animal Welfare

Are you passionate about animal behavior and energized by helping others become better trainers?

ZooTampa is looking for a Supervisor of Training and Enrichment to help advance behavioral husbandry, animal training, and enrichment programs across our animal teams. Working alongside our behavior team and reporting to the Curator of Behavioral Husbandry, this role combines hands-on behavioral expertise with coaching, collaboration, problem solving, and program development.

This is an opportunity to influence how animal training and enrichment are practiced across the Zoo while helping animal care professionals develop their own skills and creating measurable improvements in animal welfare.

Does This Sound Like You?

Do you have hands-on experience applying operant and classical conditioning with animals in a zoo, aquarium, or similar professional animal care environment?

Do you enjoy coaching other animal care professionals—helping them troubleshoot behavioral challenges, strengthen their training skills, and celebrate successful outcomes?

Can you turn behavioral observations and data into practical training and enrichment strategies that improve animal welfare?

If you answered yes, we would like to hear from you.

Position Summary
The Supervisor of Training and Enrichment works alongside the behavior team to support the daily behavioral modification and enrichment programs across all animal teams at ZooTampa at Lowry Park. In conjunction with the behavior team, this position helps guide animal care staff in developing, implementing, and evaluating species-specific training and enrichment strategies that support animal welfare, guest engagement, and accreditation compliance. The Supervisor helps ensure the animal department meets the behavioral husbandry standards set by the Association of Zoos & Aquariums (AZA), supports accurate training and enrichment record keeping, and collaborates with animal health, animal care leadership, and marketing to advance the zoo's behavioral programs. Reports directly to the Curator of Behavioral Husbandry.
Who We Are
ZooTampa at Lowry Park is one of the most popular zoos in the southeastern U.S., with over 1.2 million visitors annually. We have grown to what now encompasses 56 acres of naturalistic animal exhibits in a lush, tropical garden setting. The Zoo, accredited by Association of Zoos and Aquariums (AZA), offers popular educational programming, fun recreational amenities, up-close animal encounters and engaging seasonal events for which it has won awards as one of the country’s most family-friendly zoos.
Our mission is to rescue, rehabilitate and care for animals; create exceptional personalized experiences that connect people with wildlife and each other in fun, immersive ways.
Our vision is that everyone we touch is motivated to join us in taking action to protect and preserve wildlife.
Join us and become a part of creating unforgettable natural connections!
Your day to day
Functional Areas of Responsibility
Support, in conjunction with the behavior team, of ZooTampa's animal behavioral modification and enrichment programs; shared oversight of the Animal Training Liaison (ATL) and Enrichment Discussion Group (EDG) accountability groups; support of staff training in operant and classical conditioning; and coordination with animal health, animal care leadership, marketing, and development to advance behavioral welfare initiatives.
Essential Functions (including but not limited to):
Behavioral Modification
  • Support conditioning of the animal population, in conjunction with the behavior team, to assist with animal management in a zoo setting.
  • Work with the behavior team to troubleshoot behavior concerns as they arise.
  • Help support staff education on operant and classical conditioning through seminars and area visits.
  • Support staff in learning and applying more complex behavior modification techniques.
  • Support appropriate interactions between animals and guests.
  • Support a daily record-keeping system for behavioral training in accordance with accreditation requirements.
  • Help provide summaries of training records for animals as requested.
  • Help maintain behavioral repertoire sheets and training priorities.
  • Participate in and support the Animal Training Liaison (ATL) accountability group in advancing behavior across departments.
  • Coordinate with the hospital team, alongside the behavior team, on medical training priorities.
  • Participate in yearly evaluations of teams, animals, and staff.
  • Support a yearly behavior training workshop.
  • Help identify behavioral accomplishments that may support marketing opportunities.
  • Support the development and sharing of success stories at professional webinars and conferences.
Enrichment
  • Support daily functional enrichment across animal areas, in conjunction with the behavior team.
  • Help review newly requested enrichment items.
  • Support the review of behavioral data to help identify gaps in enrichment strategies.
  • Assist with purchasing new enrichment items.
  • Support an enrichment record-keeping system in accordance with accreditation requirements.
  • Help provide summaries of enrichment strategies to support identification of gaps and successes.
  • Participate in the evaluation of enrichment strategies.
  • Support development of a behavioral goal-setting program for species at the zoo.
  • Support development of Individual Environmental Enrichment Plans (IEEPs) for singly housed social species.
  • Participate in and support the Enrichment Discussion Group (EDG) accountability group in assessing enrichment across departments.
  • Coordinate with the veterinary team on approval of new enrichment items.
  • Help coordinate the giving tree and enrichment wish list.
  • Work with the development team to support donor engagement related to enrichment.
  • Support enrichment workshops focused on developing new enrichment items.
  • Help coordinate themed enrichment for holidays.
  • Help coordinate enrichment-related events for marketing opportunities and media.
  • Support presentations on the enrichment program for corporate volunteer workshops.
  • Support staff training on appropriate enrichment implementation.
  • Support collaboration with universities and outside partners on enrichment development.
What are we looking for?
Qualifications and Experience:
  • Bachelor's degree in psychology, biology, zoology, or a related field, or equivalent specialized training, is required.
  • A preferred minimum of three to five years of experience in animal training, behavioral husbandry, or enrichment in an aquarium or zoological setting.
  • Strong working knowledge of operant and classical conditioning principles and their application in a zoo setting.
  • Demonstrated ability to teach and mentor staff on behavioral training and enrichment techniques.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret behavioral data, records, and accreditation standards.
  • Leadership: a demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate accountability groups (ATL, EDG) and get results through others.
  • Planning: an ability to think ahead and plan training and enrichment priorities over multiple timeframes.
  • Management: the ability to organize and manage multiple priorities across animal teams.
  • Problem analysis and problem resolution related to behavior and enrichment challenges.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including written and presentation skills.
  • High-performing team member and strong team player.
Other Requirements:
  • Conducts all activities in alignment with AZA standards and guidelines, all relevant laws and regulations, safety standards and standards that ensure animal welfare.
  • Provide professional development opportunities and work with university partners to ensure all virtual interns gain necessary knowledge and skills throughout each semester.
  • Must be able to withstand typical Florida climate, sometimes temperatures exceeding 90 degrees.
  • Must be willing to work varied and long shifts including holidays and weekends.
  • Must be able to lift at least 65 pounds.
  • Must be able to work in a variety of physical positions, including sitting, bending, standing, walking and driving.
Our Perks at ZooTampa
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Pet, Life Insurance, 403(b) Pension Plan
  • Generous PTO (Vacation and sick time)
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Tuition Forgiveness
  • Discounted gym membership
  • Free admission to the Zoo, MOSI, Glazer Children's Museum and the Florida Aquarium
  • Free or discounted admission to many attractions in Florida
  • And so much more!
Equal Opportunity Employer & Drug-Free Workplace

title: Insulation Supervisor
description:
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

The Insulation Supervisor plays a vital role in ensuring the quality, safety, and efficiency of residential, commercial, and industrial insulation projects. This position is responsible for supervising insulation removal and installation work, coordinating installation teams, and ensuring completed work meets project specifications, building codes, safety requirements, and customer expectations. The Insulation Supervisor is a hands-on leadership position that combines technical expertise, team leadership, attention to detail, and customer communication. You will work closely with Branch Managers, Customers, and installation teams to coordinate project timelines, maintain quality standards, and support successful project completion.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Supervise insulation removal and installation projects to ensure work is completed according to specifications.
  • Coordinate and manage insulation removal and installation teams throughout each project.
  • Inspect completed work for quality assurance, compliance with building codes, and customer satisfaction.
  • Train and mentor junior staff on insulation removal and installation techniques and safe work practices.
  • Partner with Branch Managers and Customers to coordinate project timelines and communicate project requirements.
  • Maintain accurate records of materials used and work completed.
  • Communicate with Customers to understand their insulation requirements and help ensure expectations are met.
  • Stay current on insulation technologies, industry practices, and best practices.


WHO THRIVES IN THIS ROLE


This is a role for a hands-on leader who takes pride in quality work and developing people. The strongest fit is someone who:

  • Leads teams effectively and sets clear expectations for quality, safety, and productivity.
  • Communicates proactively with Customers, Branch Managers, and installation teams.
  • Is organized and detail-oriented with materials, project records, timelines, and follow-through.
  • Is comfortable training and mentoring team members in insulation removal and installation practices.
  • Takes a proactive approach to problem solving and resolving project challenges.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Experience in building construction and insulation removal and installation.
  • Certification in HVAC or energy efficiency practices.
  • Strong leadership and supervisory skills.
  • Knowledge of building codes and insulation materials.
  • Experience in insulation or construction management.
  • Basic understanding of safety regulations in construction.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills.


SCHEDULE & WORK LOCATION

Schedule and work location to be determined based on project and branch requirements.

title: Senior Specialist, Customer Experience
description:
At Front Row, we partner with leading brands to accelerate their ecommerce growth. We leverage our capabilities and proprietary technology to design, market, distribute and accelerate brands on a global scale. We’re continually cultivating functional areas of expertise and retaining the highest caliber of talent — while sharing knowledge and data, creating efficiencies, and looking at every aspect of our client’s business from a 360 perspective. We work effectively to give every client the hands-on support, niche knowledge, and first-access they need to win in the world’s most competitive commerce markets and make each of our six capabilities the first to act on the next big things.

We live for the exchange of energy between brands and audiences, you should too, and we’ve made it our mission to expand every brand’s market share and heart share. Because we believe every transaction has the potential to be transformational.

We leverage data-driven insights from Catapult, our proprietary technology, and our deep understanding of marketplaces like Amazon, [Walmart.com](http://Walmart.com), TikTok Shop, to craft strategies unique to each brand we work with while protecting their pricing and channel strategies at every lifecycle stage and in any global market.

**Role Overview:**

The **Senior Specialist, Customer Experience (CX)** will manage the day-to-day health of our ecommerce channels, primarily Amazon, and be the operational backbone of a portfolio of brands across the health, wellness, beauty and CPG categories. This individual will work closely with cross-functional members of internal teams such as Brand Strategy, Creative, SEO and Logistics as well as external brand partners and our Amazon contacts to ensure we maintain the optimal customer experience. From ensuring the detail pages reflect the work that our teams have delivered to troubleshooting suppressions and putting together appeals, you will have ownership of the brands under your belt and be able to utilize your experience to keep our listings up and running.

Reporting to the Manager, Customer Experience, this person should be organized, meticulous, and have a strong ability to project manage and navigate multiple client priorities. The individual should be well-versed in the Amazon space, have knowledge of the breadth of issue types that may come up in Seller Central, the ways to resolve them, and an understanding of compliance requirements across the health & beauty categories.

**Key Responsibilities**

● Set up new brands and products in our internal system, and maintain accurate product details in our catalog

● Create and manage feeds for SKU/ASIN creation as well as catalog updates on Amazon for images, copy and backend attributes

● Monitor Account Health, performance notifications, policy violations, stranded inventory, restricted ASINs, etc across marketplaces

● Address inventory and/or compliance issues promptly, taking escalation measures where necessary

● Manage cases/tickets through regular follow-ups, relaying status updates to appropriate teams and tracking in our project management system

● Conduct audits on our listings to ensure they match whatwe pushed live and address any new issues that arise

● Identify opportunities for streamlining processes to enhance team efficiency and lead improvement projects

● Remain up to date on new Amazon listing compliance requirements and provide strategic recommendations to maintain healthy listings

● Oversee the brand registry application process and manage trademarks across new and current brands

● Collaborate across teams on any changes or requests needed to ensure timely communication and resolution of issues

**Qualifications:**

● 3+ years working hands-on in Amazon Seller Central managing catalogs, account health & cases

● 1+ years working in an agency/multi-brand or high SKU count environment preferred

● 1P/Vendor Central and international marketplace experience a plus

● Deep fluency with flat files, listing feeds, Amazon catalog tools, best practices and compliance

● Detail-oriented, self-motivated with strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills

● Advanced Google Sheets knowledge

● SQL experience with data querying and reporting preferred

● Relevant experience and degree in operations or related field preferred

● Basic HTML, and/or Photoshop knowledge preferred

● Walmart, TikTok Shop or other e-commerce channel experience a plus

● OMS/ERP systems (NetSuite) system and/or Asana experience a plus

● Background in health, wellness, beauty, or supplement space is beneficial

**Benefits:**

● Health, dental and vision insurance

● PTO

● Summer Fridays

● 401K matching

● Educational stipend

● Wellness and commuter benefits

**Salary:** $80,000 – $90,000 + bonus

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Mid-to-Senior Network Software Engineer to help design, build, and operate the networking platform that powers large-scale cloud-native infrastructure.
This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, platform engineering, distributed systems, cloud networking, and networking infrastructure. You will work on technologies including Kubernetes, Cilium/eBPF, Envoy Proxy, Contour, service mesh, and cloud networking across AWS and Azure.
A key part of this role is building and evolving custom networking control planes that translate high-level application and networking intent into dynamic proxy and dataplane configuration.
What You Will Do:
  • Build Network Control Planes: Design, develop, and operate custom Kubernetes-native networking control planes, similar to architectures used by Istio and Contour, that translate declarative APIs and configuration into dynamically programmed data planes.
  • Program Envoy via xDS: Build and maintain control-plane integrations using Envoy xDS APIs, including LDS, RDS, CDS, and EDS, to dynamically configure listeners, routes, clusters, endpoints, and traffic policies.
  • Build Cloud-Native Networking Platforms: Design and operate Kubernetes networking capabilities including CNI, network policy, service routing, load balancing, DNS.
  • Work with Cilium: Deploy, operate, and optimize Cilium-based Kubernetes networking, including network policy and observability
  • Extend Proxy Capabilities: Develop or integrate Envoy filters, extensions, external authorization, traffic policies, authentication/authorization mechanisms, and other L4/L7 capabilities.
  • Design Cloud Networking: Work with networking services across AWS and Azure, including VPC/VNet networking, load balancers, NAT, routing, private connectivity.
  • Build Network Observability: Develop telemetry and troubleshooting capabilities using metrics, logs, tracing, network flows, Hubble, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana.
  • Drive Reliability at Scale: Participate in architecture reviews, production readiness, incident response, root-cause analysis and reliability improvements for critical networking infrastructure.
  • Shape Next-Generation Networking: Evaluate emerging technologies including Gateway API, eBPF networking, AI/agent gateways, MCP, Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols, and agent/service mesh architectures.
  • Participate in On-Call Rotation: Participate in the team's on-call rotation to support production networking infrastructure, solve incidents, restore service, and drive root-cause analysis and long-term reliability improvements.
What We Are Looking For:
  • Software Engineering: 4+ years of experience developing production software, infrastructure platforms, networking systems, or distributed systems.
  • Programming: Strong proficiency in Go and experience with one or more languages such as Python, Rust
  • Networking Control Planes: Experience building, extending, or maintaining networking control-plane implementations similar to Istio, Contour, Envoy Gateway, or other Envoy/xDS-based platforms.
  • Kubernetes Networking: Strong understanding of CNI, Services, NetworkPolicy, Ingress, Gateway API, DNS, service discovery, load balancing, and pod networking.
  • Networking Fundamentals: Knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3/QUIC, gRPC, TLS/mTLS, NAT, routing, and load balancing.
  • Proxy & Application Networking: Direct involvement in using Envoy Proxy, Contour, Istio, NGINX, HAProxy, or similar L4/L7 proxy technologies.
  • Linux Networking: Experience fixing network namespaces, routing tables, iptables/nftables, sockets, conntrack, DNS, and packet-level traffic flows.
  • Cloud Networking: Experience with networking in at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure.
  • Infrastructure Automation: Experience with GitOps, Argo CD, Helm, and CI/CD automation.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience designing or contributing to a custom Envoy-based control plane.
  • Experience with Envoy xDS APIs (LDS, RDS, CDS, EDS) and dynamic configuration management.
  • Experience with Contour, Istio, Envoy Gateway, Gateway API, or similar application-networking platforms.
  • Experience developing Kubernetes CRDs, controllers, operators, admission webhooks, or API extensions.
  • Hands-on experience with Cilium based networking.
  • Experience operating networking infrastructure across large multi-cluster and multi-region Kubernetes environments.
  • Experience with Hubble, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, distributed tracing, or network-flow analytics.
