title: Senior Digital Designer
description:
Location:UK wide - hybrid

Salary:£52,000 - £62,000

### About the role

**A portfolio is required to be submitted as part of your application**

You are a creative designer with a technologist streak. You're responsible for the quality of interaction design, delightful moments, and UI quality on the projects you work on. You bring storytelling into everything you make, whether that's a brand's online presence or a single interaction.

AI is part of your workflow. You use LLMs to work at speed, from ideation through to production, and you're comfortable coding with AI to bring your own concepts to life. You think beyond working faster, and consider how AI can genuinely improve the experiences we build for clients. You bring that thinking into the design studio.

You might mentor junior or mid-weight creative team members, or concentrate and own a particular competency within the discipline, such as motion, design systems, or AI-driven workflows.

You provide better quality, more ambitious user experiences, as well as lower development costs, as you create usable code as part of the design process.

You produce work that's built to compete, and to win.

#### **Responsibilities**

- Expand and evolve client brands into rich online experiences, working within and extending design systems
- Lead concept development for digital products and services, from concept through to polished execution, bringing storytelling into every project
- Use AI tools to accelerate ideation, prototyping, and production, and code with AI assistance to build experiences directly
- Identify where AI can genuinely improve client experiences, not just how we produce them, and bring that thinking back into the studio
- Partner with clients, UX, research, and development teams to ensure creative vision survives real-world constraints, on time and on budget
- Ensure designs are accessible and meet usability and user-centred design standards
- Identify and address delivery risks before they become issues
- Mentor junior and mid-weight team members, sharing practice knowledge across the studio
- Contribute to communities of practice and studio growth initiatives
- Produce work that competes for, and wins, industry recognition

#### **Dimensions**

##### **Resource complexity and nature of work teams:**

- This role works across multiple concurrent projects, balancing creative craft with hands-on build using AI-assisted coding, and operates with a high degree of autonomy, shaping ambiguous briefs into concepts, design systems, and working prototypes.
- Complexity sits in the fusion of disciplines: creative direction, interaction design, and front-end build, moving fluidly between them as needed.
- Day-to-day collaboration spans UX, research, and development teams, plus clients directly on top-tier accounts, and the role may include ownership of a specific competency, such as motion, systems, or AI workflows. Influence extends beyond individual projects, shaping how the wider team adopts AI, and decisions carry real weight on client relationships and account growth.

##### **Problem solving responsibility and complexity:**

- This role solves problems that sit at the intersection of creative vision and technical feasibility, often with no clear precedent to follow.
- Briefs can be loosely defined, requiring the individual to interpret client needs, weigh creative ambition against delivery constraints, and decide how AI tools can genuinely improve an experience rather than just speed up its production.
- Solutions must hold up across brand, interaction design, and code, so trade-offs in one area need to be understood in terms of their impact on the others.
- Judgement is exercised independently on most projects, with escalation reserved for problems that affect client relationships, account growth, or studio-wide ways of working.

##### **Change management requirements:**

- Influencing clients and internal teams to adopt AI-augmented ways of working, based on creative recommendations and a clear view of where AI genuinely improves the experience.
- Supports smooth transitions by clearly communicating the rationale behind design and technical decisions, helping stakeholders understand the benefits and impacts of new approaches.
- Mentoring and collaboration also contribute to fostering a culture of continuous improvement, helping the wider team evolve their practice alongside changing tools and expectations.

##### **Internal / external interactions:**

- Head of Design
- Design team - UX researchers, designers
- Strategy team
- Tech team
- Project management and Delivery
- Client teams and stakeholders

Strategic timeframe working towards:1-3 year strategic plan

### About you

#### **Professional knowledge and experience**

##### **Essential**

- Strong craft background in creative design, with a portfolio showing range across digital products, brand experience, and front-end experiments
- Experience applying user-centred design principles, interpreting user research and usability testing insights to inform design decisions
- Proven, hands-on experience using AI tools across the creative process, from ideation and prototyping through to production code
- Solid understanding of design systems, accessibility standards, and how to work within technical constraints without losing creative ambition
- Proven expertise in creative  design  within sectors such as not-for-profit, higher education, and public services.
- Strong leadership in managing complex projects, delivering on time and budget while maintaining high-quality standards.
- Demonstrated ability to balance creative vision with commercial constraints and budget management
- Experience leading creative direction from concept through to delivery, ensuring design quality across multidisciplinary teams
- Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data privacy, copyright considerations and the appropriate use of generative AI within client projects
- A portfolio demonstrating strategic thinking, creative excellence, interaction design, AI-enabled workflows and measurable client outcomes
- Experience mentoring and developing junior and mid-weight UX and research team members.
- Experience designing micro-interactions, motion design and interactive digital experiences that enhance usability and brand storytelling
- In-depth knowledge of accessibility standards,
- Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, clients, and stakeholders to align with business goals.
- Active contribution to practice development, process improvement, and new business growth initiatives.
- Strong presentation skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale clearly to diverse stakeholders

##### **Technical skills**

- Comfortable working with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) to prototype and build working interactions directly from design
- Skilled in AI-assisted coding tools and workflows, using them to accelerate build without compromising quality
- Comfortable working within and extending design systems in Figma, ensuring consistency across components and platforms
- Experience using modern prototyping tools and design collaboration platforms.
- Familiarity with component-based design and front-end frameworks (for example React) to collaborate effectively with development teams.
- Experience using version control or collaborative development workflows (e.g. Git) when contributing code.
- Understanding of responsive and performance-focused design principles

##### **Behaviours**

- You consistently meet your personal targets, where relevant to your role.
- You contribute to the growth and development of team members by championing, mentoring and providing constructive, candid feedback.
- You share knowledge that benefits your team and supports junior team members in progressing.
- You support our inclusive environment and ESG commitments.
- You have a good understanding of other practice areas and take a holistic view in your approach.
- You provide useful and actionable feedback when reviewing others’ work, and accept constructive feedback graciously.
- You make steady, consistent progress on assigned work and keep your team updated.
- You resolve blockers independently where possible and seek guidance when needed.
- You seek opportunities to grow and develop your skills.
- You show passion for the growth and improvement of yourself and the Design Studio
- You challenge, critique and contribute to the user experience and research of solutions to push quality.
- You demonstrate commitment and progress in developing professionally in areas relevant to your role.
- Embodies Manifesto’s values, championing purpose-driven work and fostering a positive team culture.

##### **PACT values**

- **Purpose -** The beating heart of our organisation—the impact we make on people, places, and the planet. Purpose is our driving force and at the core of our organisation.
- **Accountability -** As we apply flexibility, pace and growth through our self-organisation, we are accountable* to all of our stakeholders.
- **Craft -** Craft highlights our dedication to bringing precision, problem-solving, and creativity to our work, both with our clients and internally.
- **Togetherness -** Togetherness is ‘how’ we work - it captures the energy, fun, and user-centred approach that we embrace. It signifies the collaborative spirit we bring to our work, including people at every level and creating a sense of belonging to our teams.

### About us

### **manifesto**

We are the digital experience agency for changemakers. We are committed to delivering purposeful and positive  impact for people, planet and society, in restless pursuit of a better world.

We take pride in creating award-winning digital experiences, products and services that are measurably ethical,  inclusive, accessible, sustainable and joyful.

Our changemaker clients include UNICEF UK, Breast Cancer Now, Trussell, Woodgreen, The Royal Academy of Arts, Zoological Society London, Historic Environment Scotland and Fauna & Flora.

Part of the TPXimpact group - a Certified B Corporation™, we are a team of 130 digital product leaders, creative designers, user experience designers, engagement specialists, software engineers and experience strategists.

### **TPXimpact**

TPXimpact is a digital transformation company, and Certified B Corporation™, on a mission to build a future where people, places and the planet are supported to thrive. Combining vast expertise in human-centred design, data, experience and technology, we help the public, private and third sectors with their digital transformation journey, delivering high quality solutions that improve services, experiences and outcomes. We’re passionate people who work in close collaboration with our clients to create sustainable solutions ready for an ever-evolving world.

**We are committed to having a positive impact on the clients and the communities we serve. We actively encourage applications from all genders, ethnicities, disabled people, members of the LGBTQIA+ community, and those from lower socio-economic backgrounds.**

**Don’t meet 100% of the criteria? We still want to hear from you. Please let us know if you require any adjustments during the recruitment process.**

title: Research Scientist II
description:
The Opportunity

The Speech AI Lab at Adobe Research is seeking a Senior Audio Research Scientist to join our speech generative AI and multimodal research efforts, based in San Francisco.
This role is ideal for researchers who stay deeply up to date with the latest AI model architectures and innovations and are motivated to push them forward in real-world creative systems. You will work alongside a world-class team of scientists and engineers to invent, evaluate, and scale next-generation audio and speech technologies—translating state-of-the-art research into products used by millions.


Our lab values independent research leadership, technical excellence, and impact. We actively support publication at top venues, collaboration with academia, and rapid iteration from research insight to deployed technology.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute independent research in speech generative AI, audio modeling, and multimodal learning (text and visuals), with a strong focus on modern large-scale model architectures.

  • Design, analyze, and advance state-of-the-art AI models and training procedures, including foundation models, representation learning, and generative systems for speech and audio.

  • Maintain strong technical currency with the latest developments in model architectures, optimization techniques, data scaling, and training strategies, and apply them creatively to audio and multimodal problems.

  • Demonstrate deep understanding of both audio signal fundamentals and machine learning, enabling principled model design and insightful experimentation.

  • Publish research at leading conferences and journals and pursue patent protection for impactful innovations.

  • Build high-quality research prototypes that demonstrate technical rigor, scalability, and clear paths to product integration.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to ensure research outcomes translate into robust, real-world impact.

  • Provide technical mentorship and help set a high bar for research quality and engineering excellence.

Requirements

  • Ph.D (preferred). or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with a strong research focus in audio, speech, and machine learning.

  • 3+ years of research experience in industry strongly preferred.

  • Proven track record of independent research contributions, such as first-author publications or equivalent leadership in research projects.

  • Deep expertise in audio and machine learning, including strong intuition for:

    • Speech and audio generation

    • Audio representations and modeling

    • Training large-scale neural models

  • Hands-on experience with modern AI architectures and training pipelines, and a demonstrated ability to quickly adopt and extend new techniques.

  • Strong Python and deep learning development skills, with attention to performance, reproducibility, and experimental rigor.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to clearly articulate complex technical ideas.

  • A clear appetite for real-world impact, coupled with a commitment to technical excellence and high research standards.

title: Flipper
description:
Enjoy hands-on work and being part of a team? Backyard Discovery is looking for a Flipper to help move, stack, and organize products throughout our warehouse. In this active role, you’ll work alongside teammates to handle products safely, keep work areas organized, and support daily warehouse operations.

As a Flipper, you’ll report to the Warehouse Supervisor and help keep products moving safely and accurately through the warehouse. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Lift, carry, stack, and move boxes and products throughout the warehouse.

  • Work with teammates to team lift products weighing up to 150 pounds daily.

  • Maintain clean, organized work areas and assist with warehouse and inventory cleanup.

  • Follow safety procedures, quality standards, and supervisor instructions.

  • Work efficiently to meet deadlines while maintaining attention to detail.

  • Support special projects and assist other departments as needed.

  • Comfortable working in a warehouse environment and adapting to varying temperatures.

  • Current driver’s license.

  • Ability to listen carefully, follow directions, and work effectively with a team.

  • Strong attention to detail, quality, and accuracy.

  • Ability to keep pace in a busy, deadline-driven environment.

  • Successful completion of a pre-employment background check and drug screen.

Preferred Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • Previous manufacturing or warehouse experience.

  • Forklift experience is helpful but not required.

Physical Requirements and Work Environment

This is a physically active position that involves standing and walking while carrying boxes for up to 10 hours per day. Duties require frequent lifting, bending, twisting, and use of hands, along with reaching, climbing, squatting, and kneeling. Products weighing up to 150 pounds are lifted as a team. Work takes place around warehouse material-handling equipment, with varying temperatures and occasional exposure to dust or airborne particles. No travel is required.

Adobe is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who will apply AI and machine learning techniques to big-data problems to help Adobe better understand, lead and optimize the experience of its customers. Partnering with the business units, the candidate will be building various products that address challenging business problems through our customers’ full lifecycle, from customer analytics to marketing media optimization.

By using statistical and econometric methods, predictive models, experimental design methods, and optimization techniques, the candidate will be working on the research and development of exciting projects like attribution, media mix modeling, budget optimization, personalization, causal analysis, time series analysis.

title: Senior Product Security Engineer
description:
The Opportunity

Are you passionate about securing global systems and mitigating risks in a fast-paced environment? Adobe Security is looking for a dynamic candidate to join its Vulnerability Operation Center (VOC). As a VOC Senior Product Security Engineer, you will analyze and triage incoming identified vulnerabilities and engage with developers for all of Adobe’s products and online services. In this role, you will partner directly with developers and engineers to pave the way for measuring, prioritizing, and reducing risk across Adobe's suite of product offerings. This is a great opportunity to join in ground-breaking work to influence our organization's risk posture.

  • Validate and assess severity of public and privately disclosed security vulnerabilities
  • Drive security issues to resolution through continuous engagement with engineering teams
  • Build automation and AI tools to drive scalability across the vulnerability management pipeline
  • Champion remediation efforts to Industry Wide Vulnerabilities and reducing preventable vulnerabilities
  • Identify security gaps and collaborate directly with product engineering teams on improved hardening opportunities
  • Investigate systemic vulnerability trends to improve product risk posture and reduce preventable vulnerabilities

description:
We are searching for an Education Coordinator for the Surgical Orthopedic Inpatient Unit, someone who works well in a fast-paced setting. In this position, you will provide education and administrative support for unit operations to ensure effective and efficient implementation of the various key educational processes at the unit level.

Think you’ve got what it takes?

Qualifications:

  • Required bachelor's degree Nursing
  • Required 2 years Clinical nursing experience and 1 year Preceptor or educator experience preferred
  • RN - Lic-Registered Nurses by the Texas Board of Nursing or Nursing Licensure Compact
  • BLS - Cert-Basic Life Support by the American Heart Association
  • Experience in a surgical sub-specialty highly preferred

Responsibilities:

  • Ensures the design, implementation and evaluation of cost-effective unit-based orientation process that focuses on knowledge, skills, and relationships. Designs, implements, and evaluates annually, a cost-effective unit-based orientation pathway for each job as measured by leadership team feedback. Individualizes the unit-based orientation pathways to meet the specific learning needs of staff, as measured by feedback from orientees, preceptors, and leadership team.
  • Coordinates/Conducts required training to close performance gaps in knowledge and skills. Uses organizational policies and procedures, unit-specific performance improvement data and accrediting and regulatory standards to determine performance gaps, as measured by leadership team feedback. Develops and/or implements required unit-specific training that assists in closure of performance gaps, as measured by leadership team feedback. Implements a unit-based plan for staff competence staff on all shifts that results in improved performance. Obtains feedback from unit leadership and staff regarding development needs for each job/role, as measured by feedback from staff and leadership team. Compiles and analyzes needs assessment data and reports outcomes to the leadership team.
  • Assesses, plans, implements, coordinates, evaluates, and documents patient care. Performs and documents assessment of the patient/family’s bio-physical, psychosocial, development (age appropriate), cultural, spiritual, and environmental needs with input from patient/family and analyzes assessment data to identify patient needs and to anticipate potential problems. Develops an individualized plan of care with input from patient and family and ensures that plan is discussed and initiated within 24 hours of admission. Re-prioritizes and updates the plan of care based on new information and changes in the patient’s condition. Communicates this information to other health care team members and documents in the medical record, as appropriate. Coordinates and participates in conferences/rounds aimed at meeting needs identified in the plan of care.
  • Orients and develops preceptors. Develops, implements, and sustains a unit-based process for the orientation, professional development, and support of preceptors, as measured by feedback from preceptors, orienteers, and the leadership team. Coordinates the unit-based clinical experience for students. Implements a unit-based process to facilitate a positive and effective clinical experience for students, as measured by feedback from students, faculty, and leadership team observation. Coordinates the orientation of students/faculty to the unit, as measured by feedback from students/faculty.
  • Participates in the Quality Outcomes Program and/or unit-based quality initiatives to educate staff and monitor clinical outcomes that show nursing excellence. Collaborates with the leadership team in reviewing and analyzing performance, establishing action plans to address performance issues, and evaluating outcomes of actions taken by pre-established timelines, as measured by feedback from leadership team.
  • Provides administrative support for unit-based operations. Adjusts and updates staff schedules as necessary to support the orientation needs of a new employee, as measured by feedback from staff and supervisor. Assumes on-call responsibilities as needed to address preceptor, orientee, and overall orientation concerns, as well as, unit educational needs, as measured by feedback from staff and supervisor.
  • As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and healthy workplace, all successful candidates will be required to undergo respiratory fit testing in compliance with occupational health and safety standards.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Notch is the AI operating system built for enterprises running complex, regulated operations. We deploy purpose-built agents that resolve real workflows end to end, compliantly and at scale, across insurance and financial services. Our platform connects customer and employee interactions with back-office systems to automate complex workflows — all delivered with the highest standards for auditability, explainability, and governance.

Backed by top-tier VCs, Notch has raised $45 million to date, including a $30 million Series A in March 2026 led by Headline, with participation from Lightspeed, Jibe Ventures, Illuminate Financial, Munich Re, and Phoenix.

About the Role:

We're looking for really good engineers who want to build great software.

Our platform runs hundreds of thousands of AI-driven conversations and workflows for enterprise customers who can't tolerate a wrong answer. The hard problems here don't sit in one layer — they sit in how the layers fit together: an LLM pipeline that has to be deterministic exactly where it matters, a data model where a leak between customers is a severity-1, long-running workflows that have to survive restarts and retries, and one product that has to ship into a shared cloud, a dedicated single-tenant environment, and a customer's own data center without becoming three different products.

You'll own problems all the way through from the product decision, through the data model and the backend, to what the user actually sees. Small team, real ownership, decisions that stick.

What You'll Do:

  • Own features end to end: product conversation → schema → API → UI → how it behaves in production.
  • Design the systems behind our AI agents — pipelines, orchestration, retries, guardrails, evaluation — so behavior is predictable and explainable.
  • Build backend services and data models that stay correct and stay fast as volume grows — across shared, single-tenant, and on-prem deployments.
  • Build the product surfaces our customers and our delivery teams use to configure, monitor, and audit agents.
  • Own your code in production: CI, deploys, observability, alerting, and the debugging that follows.
  • Work on how we ship, build and release pipelines, environments, and the infrastructure that lets one codebase deploy into very different customer environments.
  • Make the call on where complexity is worth it and where things should stay boring.
  • Raise the bar around you: code review, design review, mentoring, and the standards that keep a codebase alive two years from now.


Requirements

You're a Good Fit If:

  • You have 4+ years of engineering experience, 3+ of them building real products across both frontend and backend.
  • You're strong in at least one modern typed language and ecosystem: TypeScript, Python, Go, Java, C#. We write TypeScript, and we expect you to be productive in it fast, but we hire for how you think, not for which language you last used.
  • You're genuinely full-stack - you can debug a React render, a slow query, and a stuck queue in the same day.
  • You know relational databases properly: schema design, indexes, transactions, and what happens under concurrency.
  • You've worked with distributed systems and know where the race conditions hide.
  • You're product- and solution-oriented - you ask what the customer is trying to do before you ask what to build.
  • You can take a vague, complex problem and turn it into an architecture that Just Works.
  • You care about your teammates, and you're looking to both learn and teach.
  • You work AI-natively. You use coding agents seriously, and you build the things that make them useful - skills, agents, evals, internal tooling, context that makes the whole team faster. This is how we work, not a side project.
  • You believe a small, dedicated team beats a big one.
  • You've built LLMs in production - not a demo, but something with evals, guardrails, and regression testing behind it.
  • You've worked in a regulated or high-stakes environment where auditability wasn't optional.
  • You take pride in frontend architecture - accessible, responsive, fast components.
  • An early-stage startup is what you're actively looking for: hard work, processes that aren't fully defined, and a lot of freedom.

Our Stack

We treat the stack as a set of tools, not as the solution — the specifics change, the thinking doesn't. The essentials:

  • TypeScript everywhere, strict, across a single monorepo.
  • Backend: Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, and a workflow-orchestration layer for everything long-running.
  • AI: the major model providers behind our own agent, retrieval, and evaluation layer.
  • Frontend: React, in real-time product surfaces our customers and delivery teams work in daily.
  • Infrastructure: multi-cloud, and deployed inside the customer's own environment where regulation requires it — so portability and data residency are design constraints, not afterthoughts.

Our Culture

  • Extreme ownership and accountability
  • High standards, fast pace, and lots of freedom
  • Minimal bureaucracy, evolving processes
  • People who want to grow beyond a narrow role definition
  • A small, commando-like team where your impact is immediate and visible
  • work from our office in the Bursa, Ramat Gan

title: Core Pet Sitter / Dog Walker – Providence Territory (AM & PM Shifts)
description:
Core Pet Sitter / Dog Walker – Providence Territory (AM & PM Shifts)

Service Area: Providence, with occasional travel to East Providence, Pawtucket, and bordering areas of Cranston.

You

* Prior professional animal care experience

* Reliable, detail-oriented, and committed to exceptional pet care

* Comfortable working independently with dogs, cats, and other small animals

* Looking for a long-term position with a professional pet care company

Us

Furry Fellas Pet Service has proudly served Rhode Island since 2006. We’re committed to exceptional pet care, professionalism, reliability, and supporting our employees so they can focus on caring for pets.

We are currently hiring both an AM Shift and PM Shift Core Pet Sitter / Dog Walker for this territory.

What Will My Schedule Look Like?

Each territory is covered by a dedicated AM Shift sitter and PM Shift sitter who work together as a team.

Each sitter is assigned a consistent weekly schedule that includes:

* Three Regular Days

* Two Extended Coverage Days

* Two Consecutive Days Off every week

You’ll have the same schedule each week, making it easy to plan appointments, family time, vacations, and other commitments.

AM Shift

Regular Days

* Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday

* 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM

Extended Coverage Days

* Sunday & Monday

* Available between 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM

Days Off

* Friday & Saturday

PM Shift

Regular Days

* Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday

* 1:00 PM – 9:00 PM

Extended Coverage Days

* Friday & Saturday

* Available between 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM

Days Off

* Sunday & Monday

Please Note: Extended Coverage Days mean you’re available to accept visits throughout our service hours if clients are scheduled. This does not mean you’ll be working continuously from 7:00 AM until 9:00 PM. Your daily schedule will vary based on client bookings, route density, and seasonal demand.

Visit Arrival Windows

Most visits are scheduled within a designated two-hour arrival window rather than at an exact appointment time.

Visits are grouped into the following arrival windows:

* Morning: 7:00 AM – 10:00 AM

* Mid-Day: 11:00 AM – 3:00 PM

* Evening: 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM

* Night/Bedtime: 7:00 PM – 8:00 PM (arrive by 8:00 PM to finish by 9:00 PM)

* Flextime: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM (cats and other small pets only)

* Optional Overnights: 8:00 PM – 5:00 AM

For example, a morning visit may be scheduled within a two-hour arrival window such as 7:00–9:00 AM or 8:00–10:00 AM.

On busy days, you’ll typically complete 2–4 visits during most arrival windows, with weekday mid-day windows often including 3–5 visits. Breaks throughout the day are common depending on your route and client schedule.

What Does a Pet Sitting & Dog Walking Visit Look Like?

Visits are generally 15–60 minutes long (30 minutes is most common). Mileage is paid while traveling between client visits.

Before every visit, you’ll review each pet’s care notes and household instructions in our client management system and carefully follow each pet’s individualized care routine.

Responsibilities Include

* Walking and exercising dogs

* Letting dogs out for bathroom breaks

* Feeding pets and refreshing water

* Administering medications (when applicable)

* Providing cat care and small animal care

* Scooping litter boxes and cleaning pet areas

* Providing exceptional care, love and attention while clients are at work or away from home

* Following detailed client care instructions and documenting visits within our client management system

* Traveling throughout your assigned territory to care for pets in clients’ homes

* Taking photos and sending a visit summary after every visit

* Bringing in mail and newspapers

* Watering indoor and outdoor plants

* Checking the home for any concerns

* Completing any additional household tasks included with our services

Requirements

* Must be at least 18 years of age

* Prior professional animal care experience

* Reliable vehicle, valid driver’s license and proof of auto insurance

* Smartphone with reliable internet access

* Daily access to email and the internet

* Comfortable using mobile apps for scheduling, communication and visit documentation

* Able to pass a criminal background check

* Excellent attention to detail, communication and customer service skills

* Reliable, punctual and dependable

* Comfortable working independently and managing your daily schedule

* Comfortable walking dogs outdoors year-round in various weather conditions

* Able to safely handle dogs of various sizes, breeds, temperaments and energy levels

What We Mean by Professional Animal Care Experience

Professional animal care experience means caring for animals in a professional, volunteer or educational setting.

Examples include:

* Professional pet sitting or dog walking

* Veterinary hospital or veterinary clinic

* Animal shelter or rescue organization

* Dog daycare or boarding facility

* Pet grooming salon

* Dog training

* Veterinary technician or veterinary assistant

* Animal care technician

* Veterinary, animal science or related internship/externship

* Horse barns, equine facilities or farm animal care

* Wildlife rehabilitation or wildlife care

* Zoo, aquarium or similar professional animal care experience

Compensation & Hours

Position Type: W-2 Employee (not an independent contractor)

Per-Visit Compensation

* 15-minute visits: $9.00

* 20-minute visits: $10.00

* 30-minute visits: $10.50

* 45-minute visits: $12.00–$13.50

* 60-minute visits: $16.00–$18.00

Mileage is paid while traveling between client visits.

Please Note: This position is paid per visit, not by the hour. The hourly pay range shown on job boards is required by the job board and does not reflect how this position is compensated.

During training, your schedule will start gradually while you learn our procedures, become familiar with your territory, and build relationships with your clients.

As your route grows, additional clients will be added to your schedule. Our goal for this Providence territory is to build Core Pet Sitters / Dog Walkers to approximately 30-40 hours per week, based on client demand, route density, and seasonal fluctuations.

Based on actual payroll records, established Pet Care Professionals have averaged approximately $18–$20+/hour in total compensation. Actual earnings vary based on route density, visit length, visit mix, gratuities, mileage reimbursement, holiday assignments, overnight services, certifications, experience, and client demand.

Benefits

* Paid mileage between client visits

* 100% of tips

* Paid training and meetings

* Paid certifications and continuing education

* Reimbursement for Pet First Aid certification (if not previously completed before hire)

* Additional pay available for advanced certifications, including the equivalent of +$1 per visit for Certified Veterinary Technicians, Certified Dog Trainers, and Fear Free Certified Professionals

* We pay Workers’ Compensation, Unemployment Insurance, and payment of the employer portion of Social Security and Medicare taxes.

* We handle client acquisition, scheduling, billing, marketing, and office support so you can focus on providing exceptional pet care.

* Employee discounts

* Opportunities for advancement as the company continues to grow

* Consistent weekly schedule with two consecutive days off

* Assigned local territory to minimize travel

* Opportunity to build long-term client relationships

To Apply

Visit www.furryfellaspetsitting.com/about-us/employment to submit an application.

We’re looking for compassionate, dependable professionals who treat every pet and every client’s home with the same care and respect they would expect for their own.

Veterinary technicians, veterinary assistants, dog trainers, pet groomers, kennel technicians, dog daycare professionals, animal shelter and rescue staff, pre-veterinary students, and others with professional animal care experience are encouraged to apply.

title: Data Platform Engineer, S-Pankki
description:
Tervetuloa töihin vähän erilaiseen pankkiin! Haluatko olla mukana kehittämässä pankkipalveluita, jotka tekevät yli kolmen miljoonan asiakasomistajan arjesta sujuvampaa ja helpompaa? Me S-Pankissa haluamme olla asiakkaidemme luotettu paremman arjen kumppani sekä mahdollistaa miljoonille suomalaisille rahakkaampi huominen, ja S-Pankille kasvu uuteen kokoluokkaan. Haluamme haastaa toimialan totuttuja käytäntöjä ja mahdollisuuksia vaikuttaa on valtavasti. Vaikka teemme vaativaa asiantuntijatyötä, emme turhia jäykistele.

Mitä tulisit meillä tekemään?

Tässä roolissa työskentelet osana S-Pankin tiedolla johtamisen palvelut -tiimiä ja toimit Databricks-alustan teknisenä asiantuntijana. Vastaat yhdessä tiimin kanssa siitä, että data-alustamme pysyvät teknisesti ajan tasalla ja vastaavat niin liiketoiminnan tarpeisiin kuin finanssialan sääntelyn asettamiin vaatimuksiin.

Työsi keskiössä ovat Databricks-ekosysteemin ylläpito, kehittäminen ja uusien teknisten ominaisuuksien käyttöönotto. Tuet uusien dataintegraatioiden toteutuksia teknisestä näkökulmasta sekä varmistat, että data-alustat kehittyvät liiketoiminnan ja teknologian tarpeiden mukana. Roolissa pääset ottamaan vastuuta omasta teknologiakokonaisuudestasi ja tekemään yhteistyötä datainsinöörien, analyytikoiden, tiedonhallinnan asiantuntijoiden, IT-kehityspäälliköiden sekä ulkoisten kumppaneiden kanssa. Osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan voit osallistua myös Microsoft Fabric-alustan kehitystyöhön.

Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen, ja se solmitaan suoraan S-Pankin kanssa. Työpisteesi sijaitsee S-Pankin pääkonttorilla Vallilassa, ja työskentelemme hybridimallissa Suomen rajojen sisäpuolella. Arjessasi vietät toimistolla noin kaksi päivää viikossa.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää vahvaa Databricks-osaamista sekä kokemusta data-alustojen teknisestä ylläpidosta, kehittämisestä ja hallinnasta. Sinulla on vähintään kahden vuoden kokemus Databricks-ympäristössä työskentelystä ja haluat kehittää osaamistasi jatkuvasti muuttuvassa teknologiaympäristössä.

Arvostamme lisäksi kokemusta Microsoftin datateknologioista, Microsoft Fabricista, versionhallintatyökaluista tai muista data-alustojen ylläpitoa tukevista teknologioista. Ymmärrys finanssialan tai muun säännellyn toimintaympäristön vaatimuksista katsotaan eduksi. Työskentelet sujuvasti sekä suomeksi että englanniksi.

Olet työskentelytyyliltäsi itsenäinen, analyyttinen ja oma-aloitteinen. Uskallat tuoda näkemyksesi esiin, perustella teknisiä ratkaisuja ja tehdä päätöksiä omalla vastuualueellasi. Lisäksi nautit yhteistyöstä erilaisten sidosryhmien kanssa ja olet aidosti kiinnostunut teknologiasta sekä sen jatkuvasta kehittämisestä.

Mitä me tarjoamme sinulle?

Tässä roolissa pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten S-Pankin Databricks-ekosysteemiä kehitetään ja millaisia teknisiä mahdollisuuksia data-alustat tarjoavat tulevaisuudessa. Työskentelet modernien ja kasvavien datateknologioiden parissa roolissa, jossa yhdistyvät tekninen syväosaaminen, itsenäinen vastuu ja pitkäjänteinen alustakehitys.

Onnistumisesi tueksi tarjoamme perusteellisen perehdytyksen, jossa sinua tukevat sekä eri sidosryhmät että kokeneet tiimikaverisi. S-Pankki on jo kaksitoista kertaa valittu Suomen vastuullisimmaksi pankkibrändiksi (Sustainable Brand Index). Meille vastuullisuus tarkoittaa myös sitä, että pidämme hyvää huolta työntekijöistämme. S-Pankin taustalla vaikuttava S-ryhmä tarjoaa ison talon ainutlaatuisia voimavaroja ja mahdollisuuksia, mutta arjessa toimimme ketterästi ja meiltä löytyy pienen talon intoa tehdä ja kehittää.

Työn ja muun elämän tasapaino on meille tärkeää. Työskentelemme hybridimallissa, jossa yhdistyvät etätyön ja toimistolla työskentelyn parhaat puolet, ja käytössäsi on myös liukuva työaika. Tarjoamme lisäksi kattavan työterveyshuollon sekä tukea liikunta- ja harrastusmahdollisuuksiin. Työntekijöillämme on myös ostoetu S-ryhmän toimipaikoissa. Näistä on hyvä aloittaa, mutta S-Pankki tarjoaa paljon muutakin. Tutustu meihin tarkemmin: s-pankki.fi/ura.

title: Head of Government Relations & Public Policy, UKI and Middle East
description:
The Opportunity

Adobe seeks a leader to join our Global Government Relations and Public Policy team to advance our efforts in the UK, located in London. This leader will also support Adobe’s policy involvement in Ireland and the Middle East.

The team fosters a vibrant and enjoyable work atmosphere with outstanding opportunities to interact directly with governmental organisations, formulate policy positions, and assist Adobe’s operations. This role includes working alongside senior leaders, advising them, and designing engagement plans when appropriate. The position will report to the EMEA Director based in Germany.

We are seeking a creative and well-networked government relations professional who demonstrates initiative. The ideal candidate will possess comprehensive knowledge of digital policies in the UK as well as technology procurement policy procedures. This position demands outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, enthusiasm, and a keen interest in technology policies, government IT modernisation, and the customer experience field.

What you will do

  • Development, coordination, and implementation of a successful government relations engagement strategy, including engagement planning for senior leaders.

  • Take ownership of Adobe's engagement with UK regulatory authorities on sensitive, active matters, working closely with Legal and senior collaborators and managing confidential communications.

  • Advocate for policy changes that are good for our employees, customers, and business generally.

  • Handle resources to accomplish the goals of the organisation including outside consultants and trade associations.

  • Work autonomously and engage with senior leadership to drive impact.

  • Ensure Adobe is well positioned and follows all relevant regulations and requirements.

  • Develop and advocate for external policy positions which improve Adobe’s position in the marketplace.

  • Develop monitoring and reporting processes to ensure policies and issues that impact Adobe are flagged and mitigated where possible.

  • Responsibility for delivering successful outcomes and maintaining high levels of internal and external partner happiness.

  • Assist Adobe’s local teams based in the UK in every aspect of their work.

  • Aid Adobe's local groups in the Middle East (with emphasis on KSA and UAE) whenever needed; this is not encouraged to be the main allocation of time.

  • Build on and deepen relationships with policy experts, internal teams, trade association personnel, and government decision-makers.

  • Align with Adobe's Global Public Policy team on overarching narratives and positions, tailoring messaging and engagement approach to fit the specific dynamics of the UK market.

  • Drive Adobe’s Government Relations involvement in public sector sales/procurement activities in UK/I & Middle East.

  • Promote procurement and digital government policies that advance the customer experience and the digital service delivery provided by government.

What you will need

  • 15+ years of confirmed experience in successful government engagement

  • Comprehensive, direct experience with government policies and procedures in the UK

  • Experience engaging with government or regulatory bodies on a sensitive, high-stakes matter requiring discretion and confidentiality

  • Direct knowledge of political structures and functions, and sound understanding of how to appropriately engage with political and external policy development bodies and parties

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to translate complicated technical concepts into a compelling, succinct case for political outreach

  • Strong self-starter, comfortable working autonomously while building consensus and collaboration with top executives internally

  • Capability to guide through influence rather than official power: forming alliances and attaining outcomes with internal and external partners who are not your direct reports. You will think and act both strategically and creatively.

  • Dedication to quick results balanced with the vision to see how long-term strategies need to unfold

  • Genuine passion for the positive role government can play in society, and a strong desire to help improve it

  • Curiosity and adaptability to grow alongside Adobe's expanding business as it accelerates

  • Knowledge of policy dynamics in the Gulf region (KSA/UAE) and Arabic language skills are a plus, but not required

  • High command of English and preferably another European language

title: Director of Maintenance and Construction
description:
Position Overview:

The Director of Maintenance and Construction provides enterprise-aligned leadership for all Worlds of Fun attractions, facilities, and grounds maintenance operations, ensuring uncompromising safety and best-in-class guest experience. This role drives the strategic translation of corporate initiatives into disciplined local execution, balancing operational excellence with financial performance. As a senior leader, the Director shapes the culture for both safety and associate experience, optimizes workforce and cost structures, and sets clear, results-oriented direction. In close partnership with park management, the Director ensures the safe, reliable, and compliant operation and construction of all park assets.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operational Leadership: Sets clear expectations and directs all maintenance activities across the park and attractions, including internal teams, cross-divisional partners, and contractors.
  • People Leadership & Culture: Champions the Associate Experience within the Maintenance Division, fostering a culture of communication, accountability, ownership, and recognition.
  • Problem Solving & Decision Making: Leads the resolution of complex maintenance challenges, collaborating with other parks and ride manufacturers to deliver timely, effective solutions.
  • Financial Acumen: Oversees development and execution of the division's operating budget and capital projects, ensuring alignment with financial and operational goals.
  • Project Management: Partner with corporate engineering, local architects, and engineers to enhance the property, including budgeting, prioritization, and monitoring spending inclusive of labor expense and leased services.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identifies and implements process and procedural enhancements to drive efficiency, reliability, and performance. Extract, analyze, and report KPIs related to asset maintenance, reliability, and lifecycle performance.
  • Policy & Compliance: Ensures consistent enforcement of company policies, regulatory requirements, and operational standards. Lead the implementation, governance, and ongoing optimization of a park-wide CMMS, ensuring consistent use across all assets of the property.
  • Safety Leadership: Upholds and advances company safety standards, proactively driving improvements in safety culture and performance.
  • Strategic Alignment & Accountability: Aligns divisional priorities with enterprise objectives while delivering measurable results.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned by the Park President.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree, technical certification, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive leadership experience in maintenance operations or a related field.
  • Valid driver's license.
  • AIMS and/or NAARSO certifications preferred.
  • Demonstrated executive-level communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proven track record in project management, consistently delivering projects on time and within budget.
  • Strong talent assessment and selection capabilities, with experience hiring and developing senior leaders.
  • Customer-focused mindset with the ability to effectively support and engage both guests and associates.
  • Data-driven leader with experience leveraging analytics, reporting, and performance metrics to drive results.
  • Demonstrated leadership presence with a strong sense of accountability, ownership, and integrity.
  • Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams in a dynamic operating environment.
  • Track record of fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

The Director of Maintenance and Construction demonstrates strategic leadership by aligning long-term planning with organizational objectives, ensuring disciplined execution of projects on time and within budget. This role fosters a high-performing, positive culture that strengthens teamwork and develops leadership capability across the maintenance organization. Leveraging data and analytics, the Director drives informed decision-making, enhances operational performance, and promotes clear, effective communication to enable collaboration and resolve complex challenges.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

The Director of Maintenance and Construction balances executive-level administrative responsibilities with active field leadership across the park. The role includes office-based planning, budgeting, and operational oversight, alongside routine on-site inspections requiring mobility across varied terrain. Responsibilities involve engagement with vendors, contractors, and internal teams in both indoor and outdoor environments, with exposure to a range of weather conditions. This position requires the ability to safely navigate the park environment while occasionally performing physical tasks, ensuring effective oversight of maintenance and construction operations and adherence to safety standards.

title: Managing Director, Middle School Career Exploration Hub
description:
**THE ROLE: Managing Director, Middle School Career Exploration Hub**

Britebound is a national non-profit with a mission to support middle and high school learners to explore their interests, experience potential careers, and navigate a path to a meaningful and rewarding future. We fulfill our mission through free digital-first experiences, grantmaking, policy advocacy, research, and impact investing.

We believe that exploring career possibilities, as early as middle school, and providing access to education-to-career pathways aligned with one’s passions and goals will result in greater confidence and long-term success for all students.

We're looking for a Managing Director, Middle School Career Exploration Hub.

**About the Middle School Career Exploration Impact Hub**

Young people are not consistently taught how to explore their aptitudes, or interests and how that could inform their future choices. There are limited exploration opportunities for young people in K12, and when opportunities are available, they are inconsistent across geography, quality, and type. Exploration activities are often siloed from core academics and the broader scope and sequence/developmental stages of education.

We’re launching the Middle School Career Exploration Impact Hub to change that.

The Middle School Career Exploration Impact Hub is a new national center of excellence dedicated to transforming how young people, ages 11-14, engage in self-discovery and early career exploration. The Hub will focus on one of the most important and often overlooked developmental stages in a young person's journey: early adolescence.

The Middle School Career Exploration Impact Hub exists to answer a critical question: how can we help young adolescents better understand themselves and their future possibilities in ways that meaningfully influence their long-term educational and career trajectories? To answer this question, the Hub will identify, design, test, evaluate, and scale innovative approaches that help young people explore their interests, strengths, values, identities, and aspirations. We believe that when we foster the enabling conditions for young people to explore themselves, their interests, and their strengths, they have the knowledge and confidence to make informed, empowered decisions about the next step in their educational and career journey. By generating evidence, supporting innovation, and building partnerships across sectors, the Explore Impact Hub aims to drive lasting systems change in middle school career exploration nationwide.

**The Opportunity**

Britebound seeks a visionary and collaborative Managing Director to launch and lead the Middle School Career Exploration Impact Hub.

This role presents a rare opportunity to shape a national initiative at the intersection of adolescent development, education innovation, and career readiness. The Managing Director will be responsible forestablishing the Hub's strategic direction, leading its team and operating model, managing its portfolio of programs, and serving as its primary external ambassador.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in early adolescent development with the leadership capabilities required to build a high-impact organization. They are equally comfortable shaping long-term strategy, cultivating partnerships, overseeing research and evaluation efforts, managing teams and budgets, and influencing national conversations about youth development and career exploration.

The Managing Director reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer and works closely with Britebound's other Impact Hubs and executive leadership team.

**What You’ll Do:**

**Strategic Vision and Leadership**

- Define and steward the Hub's strategic direction, theory of change, and long-term goals in partnership with Britebound’s leadership and key stakeholders.
- Develop a rigorous framework for identifying, designing, and selecting initiatives that help young adolescents develop self-knowledge, explore interests, and build a foundation for future pathways.
- In collaboration with the Britebound research team, stay at the leading edge of research on early adolescent development, interest formation, and the landscape of programs and experiences serving this age group.

- In collaboration with the Britebound policy team, shape a policy agenda for how young learners are experiencing career exploration and self-identity both in school and during out-of-school time


**Portfolio Development and Management**

- Build and manage a diverse portfolio of initiatives — from partnerships and early-stage pilots to scaling investments — spanning a range of approaches and delivery contexts.
- Work with partners to strengthen program design, define learning agendas, and set measurable milestones.
- Apply clear decision-making frameworks for investing in, continuing, scaling, or sunsetting initiatives based on evidence and learning.

**Delivery Model & Design**

- Investigate and determine the most effective mechanisms for delivering self-discovery and exploration experiences to young adolescents — whether in school, or through after-school and summer programs, community-based organizations, digital platforms, employer and community partnerships, or entirely new models.
- Design and test a range of delivery approaches (internally or in partnership with external organizations), remaining open to unconventional solutions and building the evidence base to understand which contexts and modalities work best for which young people.
- Where school-based delivery emerges as effective, support partners in building that capacity — but treat it as one option among many, not a default.

**Partnership & Field Building**

- Cultivate a robust national network of youth-serving organizations, community partners, researchers, policy makers and funders committed to supporting young adolescents in this critical developmental window.

Represent Britebound and the Hub at national convenings and in thought leadership platforms.

- Build conditions for the field to adopt, adapt, and sustain promising models beyond the Hub's direct investment.

- In collaboration with the Britebound comms team, shape the Hub’s thought leadership and communications strategy to drive impact.


**Team & Operations**

- Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing, mission-aligned team.

**About You:**

- 12+ years of progressively responsible leadership experience in youth development, education, program design, education policy, research, philanthropy, workforce development, or a related field.
- Demonstrated success designing, launching, and managing complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives.
- Deep understanding of early adolescent development and the experiences that support them to figure out who they are, what they care about, and what’s next.

This is an opportunity to lead a nationally significant initiative and help shape the future of career exploration for millions of young people.

- Partner with leading researchers, innovators, educators, funders, and policymakers.
- Lead a high-performing team and portfolio of programs.
- Generate evidence and solutions that can drive lasting systems change.

This is a full-time hybrid position The Managing Director will be expected to travel periodically for partner meetings, conferences, site visits, and field-building activities.

title: Software Developer Full Stack - Internship
description:
Ti piace scrivere codice e vedere uno strumento che hai costruito entrare nel lavoro quotidiano dei colleghi? Questo stage è pensato come primo passo nello sviluppo software di un'azienda tecnologica e internazionale, anche senza esperienza pregressa. Music & Lights progetta, produce e distribuisce soluzioni di illuminazione professionale per i settori Film & TV, Live Events, Theatre e Architectural, utilizzate in oltre 70 Paesi. Entrerai nel reparto IT, in un ambiente giovane, con un percorso formativo strutturato e l'affiancamento costante di colleghi esperti.

Scopri di più sull'ambiente di lavoro e sui benefit nella sezione Career:

Descrizione del ruolo

La persona selezionata svolgerà un tirocinio presso il nostro HQ di Minturno (LT), all'interno del reparto IT, seguendo un percorso formativo strutturato di 6 mesi (3 + 3) con l'affiancamento degli sviluppatori più esperti. Supporterà lo sviluppo degli applicativi interni che l'azienda usa ogni giorno - gestionali, verticalizzazioni sui processi e strumenti a supporto dei reparti - lavorando prevalentemente sul backend in PHP e contribuendo anche alle interfacce. Imparerà come gli applicativi si integrano con il gestionale aziendale e con gli altri sistemi in uso, e parteciperà alla digitalizzazione dei processi e alle prime integrazioni di funzioni di AI. Affiancherà inoltre il reparto nel supporto ai colleghi sulla diagnosi e risoluzione di problemi hardware e di rete. È un percorso di ingresso pensato per costruire competenze concrete di programmazione su progetti reali. Sono previste trasferte occasionali in Italia e all'estero, in affiancamento al team.

Principali responsabilità

  • Affiancare gli sviluppatori nella realizzazione e manutenzione degli applicativi interni, contribuendo allo sviluppo backend in PHP e alle basi di dati SQL.

  • Contribuire alla realizzazione delle interfacce degli applicativi con HTML, CSS e JavaScript, imparando a curare usabilità e chiarezza per chi li usa ogni giorno.

  • Supportare le integrazioni tra gli applicativi, il gestionale aziendale e gli altri sistemi in uso, imparando a leggere e utilizzare le API.

  • Partecipare all'analisi dei processi aziendali insieme ai reparti coinvolti, contribuendo a tradurli in soluzioni software.

  • Contribuire all'integrazione di funzioni di AI negli applicativi: assistenti sui dati e sulla documentazione interna, estrazione e classificazione delle informazioni.

  • Imparare a usare gli strumenti di AI per lo sviluppo (Claude Code, Codex) come supporto alla scrittura, alla revisione e al test del codice.

  • Affiancare i colleghi del reparto nel supporto agli utenti interni e nella diagnosi dei problemi hardware e di rete.

  • Acquisire il metodo di lavoro del team: versionamento, test e documentazione tecnica di quanto sviluppato.

Requisiti

  • Forte motivazione ad apprendere e interesse per la programmazione e per la digitalizzazione dei processi.

  • Conoscenza di base della programmazione, in PHP o in un altro linguaggio, anche maturata in percorsi di studio o progetti personali.

  • Nozioni di sviluppo web: HTML, CSS e JavaScript.

  • Nozioni di base di SQL e di basi di dati.

  • Nozioni di base di networking.

  • I nteresse e curiosità per gli strumenti di AI a supporto dello sviluppo (es. Claude Code, Codex).

  • Conoscenza dell'inglese di livello B1, utile per la documentazione tecnica.

  • Uso di strumenti informatici di base: Microsoft Office e posta elettronica, con dimestichezza nell'ambiente digitale.

  • Disponibilità a trasferte occasionali in Italia e all'estero, in affiancamento al team.

  • Non è richiesta esperienza pregressa nel ruolo: è gradita un'eventuale precedente esperienza, anche breve, anche in ambito di studio o su progetti personali.

Competenze preferenziali

  • Prime esperienze con un framework front-end (React, Vue o equivalenti).

  • Nozioni di UI/UX design e di prototipazione (es. Figma).

  • Versionamento del codice con Git.

  • Dimestichezza con ambienti Linux.

  • Nozioni di diagnostica e risoluzione di problemi hardware (troubleshooting).

  • F ormazione tecnica in ambito informatico (preferenziale, non indispensabile).

Soft skill

  • Curiosità e voglia di imparare.

  • Precisione, metodo e attenzione al dettaglio.

  • Attitudine al problem solving.

  • Collaborazione in team con funzioni diverse.

Inquadramento e retribuzione

  • Contratto: tirocinio (stage) della durata di 6 mesi, articolato in un percorso formativo di 3 + 3 mesi.

  • Indennità di tirocinio: 800 euro mensili nei primi 3 mesi, 1.000 euro mensili nei successivi 3 mesi.

  • Modalità: full time, presso l'HQ di Minturno (LT), con affiancamento a un tutor aziendale.

  • Benefit: mensa aziendale e palestra aziendale.

Lo stage è finalizzato all'assunzione con contratto di apprendistato professionalizzante, percorso che porta al pieno inquadramento nel ruolo di Software Developer Jr.

Candidature aperte

Valutiamo con attenzione anche candidature che non soddisfano tutti i requisiti indicati: per i profili con forte motivazione offriamo percorsi di formazione e inserimento per crescere fino al pieno inquadramento del ruolo. Allo stesso modo diamo spazio a profili con maggiore esperienza nel settore, per i quali possiamo valutare opportunità di carriera e inquadramenti superiori a quelli indicati.

title: Seasonal Ambassador - Baybrook Mall
description:
Position: Seasonal Ambassador

0-39 hours/week

Contract Role

Seasonal Ambassador

Seasonal Ambassadors at Lush are experts in product and brand knowledge, as well as providing exceptional customer consultations and product demonstrations. Seasonal Ambassadors cultivate strong team relationships and contribute to overall shop excellence in both sales and operations. On the shop floor, they consistently surpass daily sales goals while creating a fun and inclusive team environment that keeps customers coming back for more.

We encourage you to put yourself in the customer's shoes and think about what would make their day. Whether it's providing personalized product recommendations or sharing your knowledge and expertise, you have the power to create a unique and memorable experience for every shopper.

For our Seasonal Ambassadors, it's not just about selling soap – it's about making a positive impact on the world, one bar at a time!

Responsibilities:

Sales and Customer Experience:

  • Driving Sales: Utilize StoreForce dashboard results and seek feedback to exceed sales goals. Take ownership of your results and actively work to grow your contribution to the store’s overall sales.
  • Customer Experience: Consistently deliver a world-class customer experience to every customer who walks through our doors. Connect with customers and identify their needs by listening attentively and asking open-ended questions. Show off our amazing products by demonstrating their unique benefits and features. Seek opportunities to make customers' day and leave the world Lusher than we found it.
  • Building the Brand: Educate customers on our brand values including our stance on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging. Expertly articulate these values in the shop and through community engagement by hosting store parties and other initiatives that help bring in more traffic. Spread the word about what makes Lush unique, and inspire others to join us in making a positive impact on the world!
  • Product Passion: Continually expand your product knowledge with ongoing learning and diving deep into all things Lush. Stay up-to-date on our products, ingredients, and unique benefits to confidently and consistently make informed product recommendations for every customer's needs.

Team Involvement:

  • Development: Utilize Lush resources to develop effective sales techniques and product knowledge to improve your performance, support the growth of your team, and increase sales. Take ownership of your development, assess your performance, and actively seek feedback, resources, and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge, and abilities.
  • Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging: Encourage open communication and actively listen to team members’ perspectives related to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). Foster a sense of belonging by promoting teamwork, encouraging collaboration, and recognizing and valuing each employee's unique contributions.

Operational Excellence:

  • Time and Attendance: Be punctual, reliable, and present at work. Actively participate in teamwork, prioritize your wellbeing by taking breaks when necessary, and keep up-to-date with company news and updates.
  • Visuals and Merchandising: Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store to enhance the customer's shopping experience and drive sales.
  • Stock and Inventory: Utilize Visual Merchandising guidelines to make real-time adjustments to product displays based on sales to improve the customer experience.
  • Policies and Procedures: Ensure you are practicing company standards for opening and closing, product integrity, respectful workplace, and health and safety.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Flexibility to adapt to changing situations and priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge and passion for skincare, natural beauty, and ethical business
  • Flexible schedule to accommodate store needs, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

Preferred:

  • Experience with consultation-based customer service models
  • Strong problem-solving skills to address issues that arise in day-to-day operations
  • Experience working in a team environment
  • Experience working in skincare or cosmetics
  • Experience in cross cultural collaboration and DEIB or social justice training
  • Fluency in Spanish, French, or other languages

description:
Designs and executes adversarial testing to identify how fraudsters and other bad actors may exploit Adobe’s externally facing products, APIs, customer journeys, and fraud controls. Uses software engineering, automation, data analysis, and adversarial techniques to recreate real-world attacks, test defenses, and identify control gaps.

Partners with Fraud Prevention, Product, Engineering, and Security to translate findings into stronger defenses and retests mitigations to validate their effectiveness against evolving fraud and abuse techniques.

What you’ll do

  • Conduct adversarial testing of Adobe’s externally facing products, services, APIs, and fraud controls to identify how they may be exploited by fraudsters and other bad actors.

  • Recreate real-world fraud and abuse attacks to understand attack paths, identify control gaps, and determine how defenses can be circumvented.

  • Design and build automated testing tools and scripts using APIs, Python or similar languages to simulate fraud and abuse scenarios at scale.

  • Develop creative test scenarios across account creation, identity, payments, entitlements, APIs, and other customer and product experiences.

  • Test new and existing fraud controls to determine their effectiveness and identify opportunities to strengthen detection and prevention.

  • Retest mitigations to validate that identified attack paths have been effectively addressed and identify potential alternative methods of circumvention.

  • Document attack methodologies, findings, and recommendations and help build repeatable adversarial testing capabilities.

  • Stay current on emerging fraud, abuse, automation, and AI-enabled attack techniques and apply those learnings to Adobe’s products and defenses.

  • Strong software engineering or technical automation skills, with proficiency in Python or a similar scripting/programming language.

description:

Job Description

Enable data-driven engineering resource allocation and strategic capacity planning across the R&D organisation. This role provides the Resource Planning team and senior management with accurate, actionable analytics on engineering resource utilization, demand forecasting, and project feasibility analysis. The role is critical to ensuring optimal allocation of engineering talent to high-priority projects on the roadmap.

SCOPE AND SCALE:

  • Analysis across ~80-150+ engineers in the PCP R&D engineering resource base
  • Portfolio-level visibility across 10-25+ concurrent projects
  • Support for capital and resource budgeting decisions
  • Integration with enterprise resource planning and project management tools

Resource Database and Tool Management

Maintain and continuously update the resource allocation database and dedicated resource management tool, ensuring accuracy of engineer skills, availability, project assignments, and planned capacity. Develop and maintain data validation procedures and automated integrity checks.

Scenario Analysis and Planning Support

Conduct scenario analysis to evaluate feasibility of new projects against available engineering capacity. Model multiple resource allocation scenarios and support what-if analysis for strategic decisions on project prioritization and roadmap adjustments.

Capacity Planning and Demand Forecasting

Analyzecurrent and projected resource utilization across projects. Identify capacity gaps, bottlenecks, and resource constraints by skill set. Develop capacity forecasts for6-12 monthhorizons to support staffing and recruitment planning decisions.

Data Analysis and Reporting

Extract, transform, andanalyzecomplex resource data from multiple sources. Create dashboards and automated reporting for stakeholder visibility. Produce regular reports on resource utilization, project allocation, and KPIs. Develop data-driven insights and recommendations for senior management.

Cost and Resource Estimation

Support project cost estimation based on resource allocation models.Analyzecost implications of different resource allocation strategies. Provide cost-benefit analysis for make-vs-buy and outsourcing decisions.

Continuous Improvement and Framework Development

Maintain and enhance the resource analysis and management framework in collaboration with the Resource Planning team. Implement process improvements and efficiency gains in resource tracking and analysis. Evaluate and recommend enhancements to resource management tools and systems.

Stakeholder Collaboration and Communication

Liaise with R&D Managers, Programme/Design Controllers, and Leadership to understand resource planning needs. Present findings and recommendations to senior management. Support resource allocation decisions through clear data storytelling. Work with Finance and HR on resource budget and headcount planning.

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Resource forecasts and capacity plans align with actual outcomes within <5% variance
  • Resource database reflects real-time project status with >95% data accuracy
  • Resource managers and senior leadership use analytical outputs in >80% of resource allocation decisions
  • Automation of recurring reports and analyses reduces manual effort by >30% year-on-year
  • Analysis and recommendations lead to measurable improvements in resource utilization and project delivery
  • Ad-hoc analytical requests completed within agreed SLAs (typically 5-10 working days)

Qualifications

  • 4-7 years' experience in data analysis, business analytics, resource planning, or related quantitative roles
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, data consolidation, and macros
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar data visualization and analytics tools
  • Intermediate SQL skills or equivalent ability to extract and transform data
  • Experience with Python or R for data processing and analysis
  • Understanding of project and resource management concepts and practices
  • Ability toanalyzelarge, complex datasets and identify patterns, trends, and anomalies
  • Strong written and verbal communication in English; ability to communicate clearly with senior management
  • Excellent interpersonal skills; ability to build relationships with cross-functional teams
  • Detail-oriented; able to maintain data integrity and follow processes consistently
  • Resilient and proactive; comfortable with ambiguity and capable of persistent problem-solving

title: Group Product Design Manager, Systems
description:
The opportunity

Do you see the design system as the engine that lets an entire design org move faster? In this role you’ll lead the team that turns craft into shared, reusable building blocks — the libraries, tokens, and components every other design team depends on, and the bridge that carries that work into code. When this team does its job well, every surface ships faster and our products feel like one Adobe.

As Group Design Manager, Systems, you’ll lead both sides of the practice: the design side — component libraries, tokens, specs, guidelines, and accessibility — and the creative-technology side — Storybook, engineering handoff, plugins, and foundations. You’ll set the strategy, grow the team, and drive adoption and education so the system is understood and used across the org, not just maintained.

Working closely with product management, engineering, and research, you’ll provide design direction, raise the quality bar, and connect the team’s work to the business decisions it’s meant to inform. You’ll turn a high-craft group into a force multiplier for everyone who builds on top of the system.

What you’ll do

  • Vision & strategy: Define and drive the direction for the design system across design and creative technology, and tie every initiative to the business or product decision it’s meant to inform.

  • Decision quality: For every initiative, clearly articulate the audience and behavior shift you’re targeting, the user value, the assertion the work tests, the metric that will move your confidence, and the decision the work informs.

  • Quality bar: Set and protect a clear standard of quality — across whether the work is useful, usable, and modern — and help the team know what level each piece of work needs to reach, from bare minimum to exceptional.

  • Team leadership & building: Act as a player-coach: delegate audit, spec, and token work across the team so delivery isn’t bottlenecked on any one person, and grow designers and technologists through coaching and clear ownership.

  • Execution & delivery: Own the design-to-code bridge end to end, keeping tokens, components, and specs moving cleanly from design into engineering, and holding the team to its schedules and quality.

  • Adoption & advocacy: Drive adoption and education across surfaces, and make the system’s value visible to leadership through clear narratives and a regular communication cadence.

  • Collaboration & influence: Partner with product management, engineering, and research on strategy, priorities, and staffing, and bring stakeholders along through high-stakes decisions.

What you’ll need to succeed

  • 8+ years in design, including experience leading and growing teams — ideally in design systems, platform design, or a closely related space.

  • You live at the intersection of design and code: equally comfortable in Figma and a code editor, and able to translate designs into production-quality UI — or reverse-engineer code to inform design.

  • Strong front-end skills (TypeScript, React, CSS, animation) and the judgment to know what’s feasible, scalable, and performant.

  • A deep eye for craft and detail — you know what it takes to get a product from 90% to 100%, and you hold a pixel-perfect quality bar across implementation and interactions.

  • You think in systems and build reusable, maintainable component libraries — with tokens, variables, and accessibility baked in — that let the whole team ship faster.

  • You move fast, prototyping ideas in hours rather than days to validate concepts before full build.

  • You’re excited about AI and want to help define new interaction paradigms.

  • trategy and product sense: you connect design craft to measurable business and customer impact, reason in assertions, evidence, and trade-offs, and frame problems before jumping to solutions.

  • A collaborative, people-first leadership style — coaching designers and engineers, influencing senior partners with clear narratives, and creating shared ownership of outcomes.

  • Nice to have: experience with developer tools or technical products, native or cross-platform UI (e.g., Electron), and an understanding of code editors and IDEs.

Why Adobe Design Systems

  • Sit at the leverage point of the whole design org — your team’s work compounds across every surface.

  • Shape the design-to-code foundation behind Adobe’s next-generation web experience.

  • Build and grow a high-craft team with real appetite for new tools and new ways of working.
