title: Learning Facilitator
description:
**Why Join JVS?**

JVS is a nonprofit working to close opportunity gaps in employment by supporting jobseekers with the skills and confidence to secure quality careers with family-sustaining wages. Grounded in core values of repairing the world and focused on helping our program participants achieve economic mobility, we believe everyone deserves access to training and the chance for a good job. JVS develops training programs in close partnership with employers in high growth sectors, offering high quality jobs.

Building on decades of experience and success, JVS is a data-driven organization that takes a whole systems approach to addressing employment and economic equity. Through our direct service programs, employer engagement and policy change, JVS is working toward a future where everyone has access to quality education and training programs that lead to high quality employment and economic mobility.

**The Role**

The Learning Facilitator is responsible for enabling and supporting the learning process utilizing best practices in online education. This position will prepare, guide, and support a wide range of learners along a predominately asynchronous learning path. The Learning Facilitator will create a positive learning environment, help learners make meaning and supplement learning with resources to achieve learning objectives while constantly applying a DEI lens to their role/tasks. The Learning Facilitator will also coordinate relevant logistics and manage necessary technology tools to ensure a smooth learning process.

**Scope**

Manage Learners and Ensure Progress

- Facilitate multiple cohorts concurrently, with different start and end dates, on various foundational workforce topics and job readiness skills.
- Support learners with various barriers and learning levels while constantly applying a DEI lens to ensure progress is made for each learner.
- Coordinate with Participant Success Coaches to ensure learner experience is positive.
- Track and respond to each cohort’s timeline, progress, and needs.
- Provide formative and summative feedback on classroom assignments and activities.
- Integrate real-world career examples and professional expertise into course discussions and assignments to aide in the practical application of course principles.
- Partner with Subject Matter Experts to offer meaningful feedback and input to participants.
- Resolve learner issues, as they arise, on time.
- Monitor participant progress and success; engage participants who are not meeting expectations and understand learner needs; inform appropriate staff members in a timely manner.
- Work 1:1 with participants who may need additional support; provide coaching as appropriate and inform appropriate staff members to support learner.
- Ensure all participants in the Job Search Readiness curriculum develop a professional resume.
- Facilitate resume preparation to enhance participants' chances of successful placement and work-based learning opportunities.
- Contribute to the creation and enhancement of current and relevant curriculum content.
- Provide ongoing input and support to ensure the curriculum remains up-to-date and effective.

Asynchronous Engagement

- Provide regular and substantive interaction between participants and learning facilitator via learning management system (LMS). Respond to learners within 24 hours.
- Encourage active learning and engage learners through LMS via discussion forums, chats, feedback areas; actively participate in discussion boards or equivalent activities to foster community and interaction.
- Analyze LMS data to determine if participants are meeting goals, engaging in content, and/or need additional support.
- Manage participant learning and progress; communicate with learners who are not meeting expectations to motivate them and help them successfully complete courses.
- Utilize technology to support participant interaction with the content, facilitator and other participants.

Synchronous Facilitation:

- Facilitate live sessions using video conferencing tools.
- Facilitate and schedule learning events through LMS to promote connection between content and real-life application such as coordinating guest speakers, practice labs, critical thinking activities, etc.
- Contextualize learning, create community, and address importance between content learned and identified goals.

**Qualifications**

- Experience teaching online; strong working knowledge of virtual facilitation, principle and techniques.
- Experience in the use of Learning Management System to facilitate learning.
- Deep knowledge of participant learning behaviors and how to engage and support a wide range of learners both synchronously and asynchronously, holding a strong lens of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI).
- Strong strategies to promote learning and motivate participants with varying backgrounds and barriers in an online learning environment.
- Track record of delivering unique and creative learning experiences to support a wide range of learners.
- Data-drive approach to evaluating and measuring learning experiences
- The ability to work successfully and remain curious during times of ambiguity—a willingness to iterate.
- A willingness to be flexible while seamlessly toggling between big picture and small details.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey meaning concisely.
- Proven time-management skills and the ability to work independently.
- Excellent organizational skills and ability to juggle multiple priorities with competing deadlines and varying timelines.
- A strong work ethic, coupled with self-motivation and personal responsibility.
- The ability to be highly communicative, timely, and reflective.
- Highly proficient skills in using the Internet, e-mail, and a variety of computer applications.
- Strong understanding of how to operate and troubleshoot standard office equipment that may include computers and associated peripherals.

**What We Offer**

- Annual Salary: $73,500 - $78,500


- 100% covered medical and dental plans for the employee


- Accrued sixteen (16) days of Vacation + accrued ten (10) days of Paid Sick Leave


- Paid federal and Jewish holidays


- 3% 403(b) retirement contribution match and 3% non-elective contribution


- Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA


- Pet Insurance Discounts


- Employee Assistance Program


- Professional development opportunities and $500 Work-From-Home stipend


- The expectation for this role is to work in our San Francisco office and/or worksites on a hybrid work schedule; JVS does not provide relocation packages

title: IT Security Coordinator
description:
IT Security Coordinator

Facility: Trenton

Job Overview:

The IT Security Coordinator is responsible for maintaining the integrity and confidentiality of the organization's data. This role involves coordinating the implementation of the company’s information security and risk management policies, procedures, and controls. The IT Security Coordinator will work closely with various departments to ensure that security protocols are integrated into all facets of IT operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development and enforcement of security policies, procedures, and standards that meet industry practices and regulatory requirements, including compliance with the Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC).
  • Manage the security architecture for the company, ensuring that it supports the overall business objectives and minimizes risks.
  • Develop and implement a strategic security roadmap for all IT infrastructure, applications, and data across multiple sites.
  • Conduct regular security assessments and audits across all facilities, ensuring timely remediation of identified vulnerabilities and compliance with CMMC standards.
  • Oversee incident response planning as well as the investigation and resolution of security breaches.
  • Mentor the IT team, providing guidance on various security technologies and practices.
  • Collaborate with other department leaders to align security protocols with business processes.
  • Manage the budget for the information security department, including forecasting, resource allocation, and cost optimization.
  • Occasional travel to our manufacturing sites across North America will be required.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in an IT security role.
  • Strong understanding of network infrastructure and database security.
  • Knowledge of risk assessment tools, technologies, and methods.
  • Experience designing secure networks, systems, and application architectures.
  • Knowledge of disaster recovery, computer forensic tools, technologies, and methods.
  • Experience with security systems, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, anti-virus software, authentication systems, log management, content filtering, etc.
  • Professional certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CISM) is preferable.

Skills:

title: Algorithmic Trading Developer
description:
Are you an experienced developer with a strong interest in algorithmic trading, quantitative systems, and high-performance software development? Does building and improving trading algorithms in the energy market sound exciting to you? Then you might be our new Algorithmic Trading Developer.

As part of Nitor’s algorithmic trading team, you’ll work with developing and refining our algorithmic trading strategies and framework. Working closely with experienced quants and our Head of Algorithmic Solutions, you’ll help drive ideas from research to production and contribute to robust, high-performing trading solutions.

The algorithmic trading team is a small and driven team responsible for automated trading strategies at Nitor. We focus on automating strategies for traders as well as developing our own autonomous trading strategies. We’re looking for a driven developer with a strong quantitative mindset and a high execution drive to join us.

You’ll work across the full algo stack – from strategy development and backtesting to execution and performance optimization – always close to the market and with direct impact on trading results. You’ll join a highly specialized environment where ideas move quickly from research to production, and where developers work closely with traders and live market decisions.

Your responsibilities will include

  • Design, implement, and deploy algorithmic trading strategies in close collaboration with traders and quants
  • Backtest, analyze, and validate strategies to assess performance and robustness
  • Optimize execution, performance, and reliability of our live trading setup
  • Contribute to the development of tools and infrastructure supporting strategy research and live trading
  • Apply quantitative methods and data-driven approaches to improve trading performance
  • Maintain and improve our internal framework for strategy development, testing, and monitoring
  • Contribute to code quality and best practices across the team
  • Stay up to date on market trends, trading techniques, and relevant technologies

What we’re looking for

  • A Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or similar
  • Experience working with algorithmic trading systems, quantitative strategies, or high-performance applications
  • Strong software engineering skills and experience developing efficient, reliable, and production-ready solutions in Python, C++, and/or C#
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills combined with a high execution drive
  • Ability to take ownership and drive solutions from idea to production
  • Interest in financial markets and trading, with curiosity for how quantitative strategies perform in live environments
  • Experience with algorithmic trading in continuous markets, market making, machine learning on tick data, or energy trading is highly relevant for the role

What we offer

  • A young, dynamic, ambitious and fun work environment
  • Extensive opportunities for personal development and career growth. You will be given responsibility from day one and receive close sparring with other experienced colleagues
  • The opportunity to contribute and make your mark on the team’s development
  • A competitive salary package
  • A fun and social work environment with regular team events and social activities throughout the year. We also offer weekly sports activities to strengthen team spirit, including our Nitor running club.
  • Delicious lunch arrangement with food from Meyers in our own canteen
  • Brand new office facilities located in the heart of Aarhus, right next to Dokk1 and Letbanen

Please note that we review applications on a rolling basis and may close the position early if we find the right candidate.

About Nitor Energy

Nitor Energy is a fast-growing energy trading company, that has swiftly transitioned from start-up to scale-up within just a few years. We’re experiencing rapid growth, offering limitless opportunities for learning and development. We’re proud of who we are and excited about what we’re building for the future together. Our employees thrive on challenges and are motivated by the potential that lies ahead.

Our unique culture integrates traders, coders, and analysts into cohesive teams, creating a well-rounded approach to our success. We believe in a balanced work-life dynamic and foster a vibrant, engaging atmosphere where our employees can excel in every aspect.

title: Core Pet Sitter / Dog Walker – Warwick Territory (AM & PM Shifts)
description:
Core Pet Sitter / Dog Walker – Warwick / Cranston RI Territory (AM & PM Shifts)

Service Area: Warwick & Cranston RI with occasional travel to bordering areas of Providence & West Warwick RI.

You

* Prior professional animal care experience

* Reliable, detail-oriented, and committed to exceptional pet care

* Comfortable working independently with dogs, cats, and other small animals

* Looking for a long-term position with a professional pet care company

Us

Furry Fellas Pet Service has proudly served Rhode Island since 2006. We’re committed to exceptional pet care, professionalism, reliability, and supporting our employees so they can focus on caring for pets.

We are currently hiring both an AM Shift and PM Shift Core Pet Sitter / Dog Walker for this territory.

What Will My Schedule Look Like?

Each territory is covered by a dedicated AM Shift sitter and PM Shift sitter who work together as a team.

Each sitter is assigned a consistent weekly schedule that includes:

* Three Regular Days

* Two Extended Coverage Days

* Two Consecutive Days Off every week

You’ll have the same schedule each week, making it easy to plan appointments, family time, vacations, and other commitments.

AM Shift

Regular Days

* Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday

* 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM

Extended Coverage Days

* Sunday & Monday

* Available between 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM

Days Off

* Friday & Saturday

PM Shift

Regular Days

* Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday

* 1:00 PM – 9:00 PM

Extended Coverage Days

* Friday & Saturday

* Available between 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM

Days Off

* Sunday & Monday

Please Note: Extended Coverage Days mean you’re available to accept visits throughout our service hours if clients are scheduled. This does not mean you’ll be working continuously from 7:00 AM until 9:00 PM. Your daily schedule will vary based on client bookings, route density, and seasonal demand.

Visit Arrival Windows

Most visits are scheduled within a designated two-hour arrival window rather than at an exact appointment time.

Visits are grouped into the following arrival windows:

* Morning: 7:00 AM – 10:00 AM

* Mid-Day: 11:00 AM – 3:00 PM

* Evening: 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM

* Night/Bedtime: 7:00 PM – 8:00 PM (arrive by 8:00 PM to finish by 9:00 PM)

* Flextime: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM (cats and other small pets only)

* Optional Overnights: 8:00 PM – 5:00 AM

For example, a morning visit may be scheduled within a two-hour arrival window such as 7:00–9:00 AM or 8:00–10:00 AM.

On busy days, you’ll typically complete 2–4 visits during most arrival windows, with weekday mid-day windows often including 3–5 visits. Breaks throughout the day are common depending on your route and client schedule.

What Does a Pet Sitting & Dog Walking Visit Look Like?

Visits are generally 15–60 minutes long (30 minutes is most common). Mileage is paid while traveling between client visits.

Before every visit, you’ll review each pet’s care notes and household instructions in our client management system and carefully follow each pet’s individualized care routine.

Responsibilities Include

* Walking and exercising dogs

* Letting dogs out for bathroom breaks

* Feeding pets and refreshing water

* Administering medications (when applicable)

* Providing cat care and small animal care

* Scooping litter boxes and cleaning pet areas

* Providing exceptional care, love and attention while clients are at work or away from home

* Following detailed client care instructions and documenting visits within our client management system

* Traveling throughout your assigned territory to care for pets in clients’ homes

* Taking photos and sending a visit summary after every visit

* Bringing in mail and newspapers

* Watering indoor and outdoor plants

* Checking the home for any concerns

* Completing any additional household tasks included with our services

Requirements

* Must be at least 18 years of age

* Prior professional animal care experience

* Reliable vehicle, valid driver’s license and proof of auto insurance

* Smartphone with reliable internet access

* Daily access to email and the internet

* Comfortable using mobile apps for scheduling, communication and visit documentation

* Able to pass a criminal background check

* Excellent attention to detail, communication and customer service skills

* Reliable, punctual and dependable

* Comfortable working independently and managing your daily schedule

* Comfortable walking dogs outdoors year-round in various weather conditions

* Able to safely handle dogs of various sizes, breeds, temperaments and energy levels

What We Mean by Professional Animal Care Experience

Professional animal care experience means caring for animals in a professional, volunteer or educational setting.

Examples include:

* Professional pet sitting or dog walking

* Veterinary hospital or veterinary clinic

* Animal shelter or rescue organization

* Dog daycare or boarding facility

* Pet grooming salon

* Dog training

* Veterinary technician or veterinary assistant

* Animal care technician

* Veterinary, animal science or related internship/externship

* Horse barns, equine facilities or farm animal care

* Wildlife rehabilitation or wildlife care

* Zoo, aquarium or similar professional animal care experience

Compensation & Hours

Position Type: W-2 Employee (not an independent contractor)

Per-Visit Compensation

* 15-minute visits: $9.00

* 20-minute visits: $10.00

* 30-minute visits: $10.50

* 45-minute visits: $12.00–$13.50

* 60-minute visits: $16.00–$18.00

Mileage is paid while traveling between client visits.

Please Note: This position is paid per visit, not by the hour. The hourly pay range shown on job boards is required by the job board and does not reflect how this position is compensated.

During training, your schedule will start gradually while you learn our procedures, become familiar with your territory, and build relationships with your clients.

As your route grows, additional clients will be added to your schedule. Our goal for this Providence territory is to build Core Pet Sitters / Dog Walkers to approximately 20–30+ hours per week, based on client demand, route density, and seasonal fluctuations.

Based on actual payroll records, established Pet Care Professionals have averaged approximately $18–$20+/hour in total compensation. Actual earnings vary based on route density, visit length, visit mix, gratuities, mileage reimbursement, holiday assignments, overnight services, certifications, experience, and client demand.

Benefits

* Paid mileage between client visits

* 100% of tips

* Paid training and meetings

* Paid certifications and continuing education

* Reimbursement for Pet First Aid certification (if not previously completed before hire)

* Additional pay available for advanced certifications, including the equivalent of +$1 per visit for Certified Veterinary Technicians, Certified Dog Trainers, and Fear Free Certified Professionals

* We pay Workers’ Compensation, Unemployment Insurance, and payment of the employer portion of Social Security and Medicare taxes.

* We handle client acquisition, scheduling, billing, marketing, and office support so you can focus on providing exceptional pet care.

* Employee discounts

* Opportunities for advancement as the company continues to grow

* Consistent weekly schedule with two consecutive days off

* Assigned local territory to minimize travel

* Opportunity to build long-term client relationships

To Apply

Visit www.furryfellaspetsitting.com/about-us/employment to submit an application.

We’re looking for compassionate, dependable professionals who treat every pet and every client’s home with the same care and respect they would expect for their own.

Veterinary technicians, veterinary assistants, dog trainers, pet groomers, kennel technicians, dog daycare professionals, animal shelter and rescue staff, pre-veterinary students, and others with professional animal care experience are encouraged to apply.

title: AI Engineer 4
description:
We build the agentic AI platform that Adobe teams use to get real work done — OneAI, our unified intelligence layer, along with the reusable skills, agents, and dashboards that run on top of it. You'll design and ship autonomous agents that connect to enterprise data (Databricks, Jira, Confluence, Slack, SharePoint) and turn natural-language questions into trustworthy, cited answers.

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to grow. You'll own components end to end — from prototype to production — and see them adopted across business units. If you enjoy making AI systems that are genuinely reliable, well-governed, and fast, you'll fit in well here.

What you'll do

  • Build and productionize reusable agentic components — skills, orchestration workflows, and tool-calling integrations — that plug into OneAI's intelligence layer (Neo4j + pgvector + Databricks + Claude).
  • Take AI models and agents from prototype to production, and keep them healthy once they're live.
  • Improve how agents reason: prompt design, memory and context management, retrieval quality, and multi-step tool use.
  • Tune for latency, reliability, and cost so the platform holds up as more teams rely on it.
  • Partner with product managers and data engineers to shape what we build, and share what you learn with the team.
  • Help raise the bar on evaluation — measure solve rates and accuracy, and use what you find to make the agents better.

What you'll bring

  • Around 3+ years building AI/ML or backend systems, including some experience running LLM-powered services in production.
  • Strong fundamentals in Python and REST APIs.
  • Familiarity with modern AI tooling — frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex, and vector databases.
  • A habit of measuring quality and iterating, rather than shipping and hoping.
  • Comfort working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

Nice to have

  • Experience with event streaming (Kafka, Flink, or Kinesis) and data pipelines (Spark or Databricks).

Nestled on Chicago’s Magnificent Mile, you’ll work in a dynamic setting offering inspiring views, modern amenities and a commitment to “doing well, and doing good.” If you’re passionate about hospitality and ready to elevate your career in a role where your purpose matters, let’s create unforgettable moments together.

title: Die Maintenance
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive 2nd shift Die Maintenance Technician to join our manufacturing team. In this vital role, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing, and optimizing die tools and equipment used in metal stamping, plastics injection molding, and other precision manufacturing processes. Your expertise will ensure that production runs smoothly, efficiently, and safely by performing detailed inspections, troubleshooting issues, and implementing improvements. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work with advanced machinery and cutting-edge fabrication techniques in a dynamic environment dedicated to quality and innovation.

Duties

  • Perform routine inspections, troubleshooting, and repairs on dies used in die cast equipment.
  • Operate precision measuring instruments including calipers, micrometers, and other precision tools to ensure die components meet strict tolerances.
  • Read and interpret schematics, technical drawings (GD&T), and mechanical diagrams to facilitate accurate repairs or modifications.
  • Utilize hand tools, welding equipment and fabrication tools, and stamping presses to assemble or repair die components with precision.
  • Maintain detailed records of maintenance activities, schematics updates, and repair logs for quality assurance purposes.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing teams to optimize tooling performance and implement process improvements that enhance productivity.

Experience

  • Proven experience in die maintenance or tooling repair within a manufacturing environment involving stamping presses or plastics injection molding machines.
  • Familiarity with GD&T standards for precise measurement and quality control of die parts.
  • Skilled in the use of precision measuring instruments including calipers, micrometers, micrometers, and other measurement tools.
  • Mechanical knowledge related to fabrication, assembly, welding techniques TIG) , tooling design, and machine setup.
  • Ability to read schematics and electrical diagrams for troubleshooting electrical components of dies or machinery.
  • Experience working with aluminum die cast molding processes is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving skills combined with excellent attention to detail in a fast-paced manufacturing setting. Join us if you’re passionate about maintaining high standards of quality through expert die maintenance! We value innovation, precision craftsmanship, and continuous improvement—empowering you to grow your skills while contributing to our manufacturing excellence.

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

title: Workday Financials Consultants (All Levels)
description:
Purpose of the Role

In this role, you will support Atratus’ Workday delivery capability across areas such as Workday Financials, CLM, Adaptive Planning, Procurement, Expenses, Projects, Reporting, Integrations, and Security. Not all of them, some of them, and have an opportunity to unlearn to learn something you have never done before.

In this role, you will work with the rest of the Atratus crew and client teams to help deliver practical outcomes for clients. You will support configuration, testing, documentation, issue resolution, workshops, reporting, client materials, and day-to-day delivery activity.

In this role, you are not expected to know everything. You are expected to be hands-on, reliable, curious, eager, organised, and willing to learn quickly.

In this role, you will also be exposed to how Atratus applies AI, automation, data, and governance around Workday and other enterprise platforms. You do not need to be an AI expert, but you should be interested in learning how AI can improve business processes, reduce manual work, and support better client outcomes.

At Atratus, partnership is not a rank. It is a mindset. It reflects in our bands, grades and role expectations as well. Therefore, for this role, that means taking ownership of your work, doing what you say you will do, helping the team, and caring about the quality of the outcome.

Primary Responsibilities

Service Delivery

In this role, you will support the delivery of Workday, Digital and AI services across client engagements. You will assist with:

  • Supporting Workday and AI configuration activities, ensuring changes are documented, tested, and aligned to client requirements.

  • Helping prepare and complete testing activities, including test scripts, test evidence, defect tracking, and follow-up actions.

  • Reviewing data, investigating issues, and helping identify where errors, gaps, or inconsistencies may exist.

  • Documenting business processes, configuration decisions, meeting outcomes, and delivery actions in a clear and structured way.

  • Capturing client meeting notes, actions, risks, decisions, and dependencies so the team can maintain delivery momentum.

  • Supporting Workday release, stabilisation, and optimisation activities by helping assess impacts, prepare materials, and track required actions.

  • Preparing delivery artefacts, client materials, reports, packs, and handover notes that are clear, accurate, and useful.

  • Supporting the Atratus crew in workshops, playback sessions, solution design discussions, and client delivery activities.

  • You will be expected to complete assigned tasks properly, ask for help early, and keep work moving.

Workday Functional Knowledge

In this role, you will continue to build your Workday knowledge across one or more areas, including:

  • Workday Financials, including the core processes, controls, reporting, and operational activities that support finance teams.

  • Contract Lifecycle Management, including how contracts are created, managed, governed, and connected to business processes.

  • Adaptive Planning, including planning, forecasting, reporting, and how finance teams use data to support better decisions.

  • Procurement, including supplier processes, purchasing activity, approvals, and downstream financial impacts.

  • Expenses, including employee expense processes, approvals, controls, and reporting requirements.

  • Projects, including how project costs, budgets, approvals, and reporting are managed within Workday.

  • Reporting, including how information is structured, extracted, reviewed, and presented to support business decisions.

  • Security, including how access, roles, permissions, and controls support safe and appropriate system use.

  • Integrations, including how Workday connects with other systems and why integration quality matters to business operations.

  • Business processes, including how work flows through the system, where approvals occur, and how configuration supports client outcomes.

  • You do not need to know all of these. You will be expected to build depth over time and apply what you learn in real client work.

AI, Automation and Learning

In this role, you will be exposed to Atratus’ work across AI, automation, data, and governance. You will support the crew by:

  • Learning how AI can be applied to business processes, especially where work is manual, repetitive, slow, or difficult to control.

  • Helping identify tasks, processes, or reporting activities that could be improved through automation or better use of data.

  • Supporting AI-related discovery by helping document current processes, pain points, user needs, and improvement opportunities.

  • Learning how Workday data, workflows, controls, and reporting can connect with AI use cases inside and outside the Workday ecosystem.

  • Staying curious about new tools, new ways of working, and better delivery methods that could improve client outcomes.

  • You are not expected to lead AI work. You are expected to be interested, willing to learn, and open to applying new knowledge.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 6 months: You are contributing confidently to client engagements, supporting testing, documentation, configuration, and issue resolution with less supervision. You are building stronger Workday knowledge in the selected area.

  • Within 12 months: You are independently owning defined workstreams within engagements, helping onboard newer consultants, and contributing to repeatable delivery approaches and service assets based on real client experience.

  • Beyond 12 months: You are recognised internally as a dependable Consultant who consistently translates intent into outcomes, supports client trust, and demonstrates readiness to take on broader leadership responsibilities over time.

Working Style and Culture Fit

  • You know the Workday craft and are willing to roll up your sleeves to learn to balance it with commerce for business impact.

  • You are devoted to Workday, yet fluent in the language of value, outcomes, and trust.

  • You move seamlessly between integration detail and boardroom vision, never losing the thread of the story.

  • You thrive where others hesitate, turning ambiguity into momentum and shaping playbooks that scale.

  • You grow extraordinary teams by giving others a hand to rise, shaping talent that thrives, leads, and elevates the whole. You see your growth in the growth of others.

  • Above all, you embody the Atratus spirit: disciplined, purposeful, and relentless in pursuit of better.

title: Rooftop Gardens Program Coordinator (56681)
description:
YSS is looking for someone who sees potential—in people, in plants, and in what’s possible to join us as our Rooftop Gardens Coordinator!

This is more than a job in urban agriculture. It’s an opportunity to combine sustainable growing, workforce development, and youth empowerment in a program designed to help young adults build skills, confidence, and pathways to thriving futures.

Reporting to the Director of Lived Experience Programs, as the Rooftop Gardens Coordinator, you’ll lead the daily operations of our innovative Rooftop Gardens Program, overseeing hydroponic and greenhouse growing while helping young adults grow their own potential along the way.

You’ll work alongside Participants ages 18–24, many with lived experience in foster care or the juvenile justice system, as they build job-readiness skills, explore career opportunities, and work toward greater stability and independence.

What you'll do...

  • Lead Program Operations: Oversee the daily maintenance, growing, harvesting, and operation of hydroponic and greenhouse systems.
  • Grow Participant Potential: Supervise, mentor, and support young adults throughout a six-month workforce development program focused on job readiness, financial literacy, and housing stability.

  • Help Build the Cohort: Support outreach, marketing, and recruitment efforts to attract strong and diverse groups of Participants.
  • Showcase the Program: Coordinate and participate in special events, community activities, and internal meetings that highlight the program and its impact.

title: AI Solutions Architect, Business Process Optimization
description:
The Opportunity

Want to help an entire organization get real value from AI? Adobe is hiring an AI Solutions Architect to lead how we strategize, enable, build, and scale AI.

This role sits at the intersection of enablement, architecture, hands-on experimentation, governance and delivery. You will help identify high-value AI opportunities, design the full system around AI models, build prototypes and reference implementations, guide implementation, and help solutions move beyond demos into scalable, reliable use.

You will also help Adobe make informed AI decisions by researching current AI trends, releases, features, platforms, and products generally available in the market. You will partner with AI-focused teams across Adobe, mentor others, challenge assumptions, and translate AI advancements into practical recommendations for what Adobe should use, how we should use it, and where we should be cautious.

What you'll do

  • Advisory & Consulting
    • Consult on AI initiatives from idea to adoption, making clear calls on what to pursue, defer, or drop and connecting teams so solutions get shared rather than rebuilt.
    • Act as an internal consultant and constructive challenger, helping leaders pick the right path (including when better data, automation, or process change beats AI) and evaluate value, feasibility, security, privacy, scalability, cost, UX, governance, and maintainability.
  • Enablement, Coaching & Adoption
    • Coach developers and program managers to work more effectively with AI: prompting and reusable skills, agent harnesses, and AI-assisted design and coding.
    • Lead the Finance AI Ambassador program, workshops, office hours, and a community of practice that raise AI literacy.
    • Drive broader adoption through enablement programs, mentoring, training, and practical guidance for engineers, PMs, analysts, and business partners.
  • Solution Design & Engineering Collaboration
    • Support design, prototype, build, and help deliver AI-enabled solutions for business, product, customer, and operational needs across Adobe.
    • Architect the full system around AI models: tools, retrieval, memory, orchestration, APIs, evaluation, observability, and integrations, so solutions hold up in production, not just in demos.
    • Support building working prototypes, proofs of concept, reference implementations, and reusable patterns other teams can adapt and deliver.
    • Support implementing AI workflows, assistant-style and agentic experiences, automations, function calling, tool use, MCP-style integrations, retrieval-based systems, and multi-step orchestration.
    • Collaborate with engineering teams to validate approaches, review designs, troubleshoot, and guide solutions toward scalable, secure, reliable, maintainable delivery.
    • Design evaluations and measure output quality, reliability, latency, cost, usability, risk, adoption, and post-launch business impact.
  • Governance & Responsible AI
    • Keep AI responsible and reliable with sensitive financial data: privacy, controls, auditability, and human review, in partnership with security, legal, and audit.
    • Partner with business partners, data leaders, security, legal, and development teams on an AI-ready data foundation to move ideas from discovery through POC, implementation, testing, adoption, and iteration.
  • Research & Strategy
    • Research emerging AI models, platforms, releases, frameworks, and market trends, and translate findings into practical recommendations on what to use, how, and where to be cautious.
    • Build relationships with AI-focused teams, platform groups, product partners, and technical leaders across Adobe to stay aligned with internal AI strategy, approved capabilities, and emerging opportunities.

What you need to succeed

·Responsible-AI judgment: awareness of privacy, security, risk, and governance, with extra care for Finance controls.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, Product Management, or related concentration. MBA or equivalent experience preferred.
  • Experience: Minimum 6+ years in business solution architecture, product management, and/or technical customer success with a strong understanding of architecture design principles, cloud native patterns, business process optimization and/or AI development.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Demonstrated experience with business applications powered by AI and familiarity with:
      • Knowledge graphs, vector databases, and language models
      • AI Integration patterns
      • Agentic AI protocols
      • Experience using popular AI tools: Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Glean, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and tools within the Adobe portfolio.
      • Ability to effectively build AI prompts, chatbots and agents.
    • Ability to develop architecture diagrams, capability modeling, and value stream mapping.
    • Strong data analytics and visualization skills with large datasets, with experience in Excel, Power BI, and Tableau.
  • Leadership Skills: Proven track record of leading, inspiring, and aligning cross-functional teams around new technologies and workflows.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent communicator, with experience presenting to C-level executives and facilitating training for diverse audiences.
  • Product-Centric Approach: Able to shape technical solutions for business impact, and comfortable owning problems end-to-end from discovery to deployment. Delivers durable solutions but can quickly prototype when needed.

description:

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! The opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Cloud Security Engineer to help define, build, and scale Adobe's cloud security capabilities across AWS, Azure, GCP, and private cloud environments.

This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic leadership. The successful candidate will be responsible for owning and evolving one or more cloud security domains, identifying and prioritizing risks, developing long-term roadmaps, driving cross-functional initiatives, influencing partner teams, and delivering measurable security outcomes across Adobe.

This is not a heads-down implementation role. While hands-on technical work, automation, prototyping, and software development will be part of the job, success in this role will depend equally on the ability to build partnerships, drive alignment, lead initiatives, and execute effectively within a large and complex enterprise environment.

The ideal candidate can assess complex cloud environments, identify systemic risks, create practical solutions, influence technical direction, and successfully drive security improvements from concept through adoption.

What you'll Do

Own and Evolve Cloud Security Capabilities

  • Serve as the long-term owner of one or more cloud security domains, such as cloud infrastructure security, cloud logging, identity and access management, cloud threat detection, security automation, or other strategic cloud security functions.

  • Define and drive multi-quarter roadmaps aligned with Adobe's business and security objectives.

  • Identify systemic risks and prioritize investments based on business impact, risk reduction, engineering effort, and operational realities.

Drive Cloud Security Strategy and Architecture

  • Assess and improve cloud security architectures across AWS, Azure, GCP, and private cloud environments.

  • Evaluate identity and access management, data protection controls, logging strategy, and secure cloud configurations.

  • Develop pragmatic security strategies that balance security requirements with business needs, scalability, developer experience, and operational constraints.

  • Influence technical direction and architectural decisions across multiple engineering organizations.

Lead Cross-Functional Security Initiatives

  • Translate ambiguous security challenges into actionable roadmaps, projects, and prioritized workstreams.

  • Drive complex initiatives from concept through delivery while coordinating stakeholders across engineering, infrastructure, platform, and security teams.

  • Build trusted relationships across Adobe and influence outcomes without direct authority.

  • Represent Security Engineering as a collaborative partner and trusted advisor.

Improve Cloud Detection, Visibility, and Response

  • Lead efforts to improve cloud-native threat detection and security monitoring capabilities.

  • Meaningfully contribute to Adobe's cloud logging strategy, including visibility, detection coverage, operational effectiveness, and cost management.

  • Partner with detection engineering, incident response, and platform teams to improve security outcomes across Adobe's cloud environments.

Build and Scale Security Automation

  • Develop prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and automation to improve security visibility, detection, compliance, and operational efficiency.

  • Build tools and workflows that continuously identify cloud security risks and misconfigurations.

  • Advance Adobe's infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code capabilities to improve scalability and consistency.

  • Improve automation throughout security operations, deployment pipelines, testing, and security tooling.

Mentor and Lead Through Influence

  • Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance across Security Engineering.

  • Mentor engineers and help raise the technical effectiveness of the broader organization.

  • Promote security best practices and help drive a culture of continuous improvement.

  • Act as a force multiplier by improving processes, programs, and teams beyond your immediate area of ownership.

What you need to succeed

Technical Expertise

  • Significant experience securing cloud environments in Azure, AWS, GCP, or a combination of major cloud providers.

  • Deep understanding of cloud security architecture, identity and access management, logging, threat detection, governance, and cloud-native security services.

  • Experience securing modern cloud workloads, including Kubernetes platforms, containerized applications, CI/CD pipelines, and serverless technologies.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform and CloudFormation.

  • Experience building automation using languages such as Python, Go, Rust, or similar technologies.

  • Strong understanding of software development, cloud infrastructure, and security engineering principles.

  • Knowledge of security tooling, operating systems, networking, and distributed systems.

Program Ownership and Execution

  • Demonstrated success owning and driving complex security or engineering initiatives from strategy through execution.

  • Experience developing roadmaps, establishing priorities, and balancing competing business and security objectives.

  • Ability to break large, ambiguous problems into actionable plans and measurable outcomes.

  • Strong decision-making and prioritization skills in complex environments.

Leadership and Collaboration

  • Proven ability to influence technical direction without formal authority.

  • Experience building trusted relationships across engineering, platform, operations, and security teams.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a large, complex, and highly collaborative environment.

Personal Attributes

  • Ownership mentality with strong accountability for outcomes.

  • Strategic thinker who can balance short-term execution with long-term vision.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and making decisions with incomplete information.

  • Curious, adaptable, and continuously learning.

title: Senior Business Consultant - Content Supply Chain
description:
The CSC Business Consultant leads customers through business transformation as they adopt Adobe’s Content Supply Chain solutions. You will help customers improve how content is planned, created, managed, and delivered by defining business requirements, future-state workflows, operating models, and adoption strategies.

This role combines strong business consulting with hands-on solution delivery. You will connect business goals to platform capabilities, configure solutions, and build and validate workflows and integrations across Workfront, AEM Assets, and connected CSC tools. You will independently deliver standard configurations and moderately complex automations, partnering with Technical Consultants and architects on advanced integrations, custom development, security, and solution architecture.

What You Will Do

Customer Strategy and Process Design

  • Lead discovery workshops to understand current processes, pain points, stakeholder needs, and business priorities across the content lifecycle.
  • Use industry knowledge and CSC experience to recommend future-state workflows, operating models, and implementation priorities.
  • Translate customer goals into business requirements, process maps, user stories, and acceptance criteria; partner with technical teams to confirm feasibility and implementation alignment.

Content Strategy and Governance

  • Define organizational taxonomy, metadata standards, asset lifecycle rules, and governance aligned with customer needs and relevant industry practices.
  • Design intake processes, roles and responsibilities, approval paths, and asset management use cases spanning Workfront and AEM Assets.
  • Define how metadata moves between systems, document field mappings and ownership, and validate that configurations support the intended business process.

Change Management and Adoption

  • Assess organizational readiness and support stakeholder alignment, communication planning, and adoption strategies.
  • Create and deliver role-based training, playbooks, standard operating procedures, and process documentation.
  • Lead business UAT planning and customer walkthroughs, validate results against acceptance criteria, and support knowledge transfer and post-go-live self-sufficiency.

Practical Solution Delivery

  • Independently configure and test forms, templates, approval workflows, reports, metadata structures, and permissions within agreed solution standards.
  • Build and maintain moderately complex Fusion workflows using branching, field mappings, data transformations, API calls, and error handling; validate connected processes end to end.
  • Troubleshoot configuration and integration issues using execution logs, API responses, and data validation; resolve issues within scope and escalate architectural or code-level problems with clear findings.

Program Execution and Value Realization

  • Manage scope, risks, dependencies, and decisions with Project Managers and Engagement Leads; communicate roadblocks and tradeoffs early.
  • Establish baseline measures and KPIs with customers, track business outcomes, and deliver executive readouts on progress, adoption, and value.
  • Support sales and scoping discussions by clarifying business needs, expected outcomes, delivery assumptions, and implementation considerations.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 7+ years in business consulting, business analysis, marketing operations, or related transformation roles.
  • Strong understanding of marketing workflows, content production lifecycles, and enterprise content or asset management.
  • Strong working knowledge of Adobe’s Content Supply Chain ecosystem, including Workfront, AEM Assets, and Fusion, with hands-on implementation experience in at least one core platform.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous needs into structured workflows, requirements, acceptance criteria, and practical platform recommendations.
  • Practical experience with REST APIs, JSON, field mappings, and data transformations; able to inspect requests and responses, work with established authentication methods, and test system-to-system data flows.
  • Hands-on experience building and troubleshooting multi-step automations in Fusion or a comparable integration platform, including conditional logic and error handling; able to deliver independently within defined architecture and security standards.
  • Strong facilitation, presentation, documentation, and executive communication skills; experience navigating organizational change and stakeholder alignment.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience delivering production Workfront Fusion integrations and supporting monitoring, recovery, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Experience implementing metadata or taxonomy standards across connected platforms, or working with and other CSC tools.
  • Experience using AI-powered tools to support discovery, documentation, workflow analysis, or delivery efficiency.

Success Looks Like

  • Customers have a clear future-state operating model and adopt workflows tied to measurable business outcomes.
  • Business requirements translate into well-tested configurations and maintainable integrations, with clear documentation and reliable handoffs between systems and teams.
  • Stakeholders understand their roles and next steps, and can sustain the solution after go-live.
  • Risks are surfaced early, commitments are met, and documentation supports ongoing governance and improvement.

title: Finance Lead - Strategy & Analytics
description:
The Opportunity

Join the Adobe Finance team and help define the future of how Finance operates, decides, and scales. This is not a traditional FP&A role. You will operate at the intersection of Finance, Strategy, and AI, crafting how a modern, data‑ and AI‑native Finance organization works. Your role includes defining and applying AI-enabled tools and contemporary data infrastructures such as LLMs, Databricks, and SQL/Python. These efforts will help improve scale, speed, insight quality, and decision advantage. Rather than automating legacy processes, you will help re‑architect workflows and decision frameworks, partnering on cross‑functional teams to build next‑generation Finance capabilities. If you are passionate about sophisticated modeling, complex data, and using AI to transform decision‑making—not just processes—this role puts you at the forefront of the industry.

What You Will Do

  • Drive Scalable, AI‑Forward FP&A: redesign core FP&A workflows using intelligent technologies and sophisticated data infrastructures to reduce manual effort, accelerate insight generation, and unlock new analytical capabilities.
  • Navigate complex data ecosystems from multiple sources like CRM, ERP, billing, and product usage. Identify, prioritize, and develop AI and advanced analytics use cases. These use cases deliver measurable business value within Finance and broader enterprise decision-making.
  • AI Change Agent: Serve as a leader with a point of view and change agent, helping Finance evolve from reporting‑centric to decision‑centric operating models.
  • Partner with Senior Leadership: Act as a trusted finance partner to Product and Sales teams. Bridge long-term strategy with near-term execution. Represent Finance AI priorities in cross-functional forums and with executive leadership. Clearly communicate progress, risks, tradeoffs, and strategic direction.

What You Need to Be Successful

  • 7+ years of experience in FP&A, Strategic Finance, Financial Analytics, or related roles; enterprise software experience strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Data Analysis, or a closely related area; MBA or advanced degree a plus.
  • Demonstrated experience transforming Finance workflows using AI‑enabled tools or advanced analytics platforms (e.g., LLMs, Databricks, custom analytics solutions).
  • Hands‑on experience manipulating large datasets using SQL and/or Python; experience with modern data platforms a strong plus.

title: Core Pet Sitter / Dog Walker – East Greenwich Territory (AM & PM Shifts)
description:
Core Pet Sitter / Dog Walker – East Greenwich / North Kingstown RI Territory (AM & PM Shifts)

You

* Prior professional animal care experience

* Reliable, detail-oriented, and committed to exceptional pet care

* Comfortable working independently with dogs, cats, and other small animals

* Looking for a long-term position with a professional pet care company

Us

Furry Fellas Pet Service has proudly served Rhode Island since 2006. We’re committed to exceptional pet care, professionalism, reliability, and supporting our employees so they can focus on caring for pets.

We are currently hiring both an AM Shift and PM Shift Core Pet Sitter / Dog Walker for this territory.

What Will My Schedule Look Like?

Each territory is covered by a dedicated AM Shift sitter and PM Shift sitter who work together as a team.

Each sitter is assigned a consistent weekly schedule that includes:

* Three Regular Days

* Two Extended Coverage Days

* Two Consecutive Days Off every week

You’ll have the same schedule each week, making it easy to plan appointments, family time, vacations, and other commitments.

AM Shift

Regular Days

* Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday

* 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM

Extended Coverage Days

* Sunday & Monday

* Available between 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM

Days Off

* Friday & Saturday

PM Shift

Regular Days

* Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday

* 1:00 PM – 9:00 PM

Extended Coverage Days

* Friday & Saturday

* Available between 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM

Days Off

* Sunday & Monday

Please Note: Extended Coverage Days mean you’re available to accept visits throughout our service hours if clients are scheduled. This does not mean you’ll be working continuously from 7:00 AM until 9:00 PM. Your daily schedule will vary based on client bookings, route density, and seasonal demand.

Visit Arrival Windows

Most visits are scheduled within a designated two-hour arrival window rather than at an exact appointment time.

Visits are grouped into the following arrival windows:

* Morning: 7:00 AM – 10:00 AM

* Mid-Day: 11:00 AM – 3:00 PM

* Evening: 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM

* Night/Bedtime: 7:00 PM – 8:00 PM (arrive by 8:00 PM to finish by 9:00 PM)

* Flextime: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM (cats and other small pets only)

* Optional Overnights: 8:00 PM – 5:00 AM

For example, a morning visit may be scheduled within a two-hour arrival window such as 7:00–9:00 AM or 8:00–10:00 AM.

On busy days, you’ll typically complete 2–4 visits during most arrival windows, with weekday mid-day windows often including 3–5 visits. Breaks throughout the day are common depending on your route and client schedule.

What Does a Pet Sitting & Dog Walking Visit Look Like?

Visits are generally 15–60 minutes long (30 minutes is most common). Mileage is paid while traveling between client visits.

Before every visit, you’ll review each pet’s care notes and household instructions in our client management system and carefully follow each pet’s individualized care routine.

Responsibilities Include

* Walking and exercising dogs

* Letting dogs out for bathroom breaks

* Feeding pets and refreshing water

* Administering medications (when applicable)

* Providing cat care and small animal care

* Scooping litter boxes and cleaning pet areas

* Providing exceptional care, love and attention while clients are at work or away from home

* Following detailed client care instructions and documenting visits within our client management system

* Traveling throughout your assigned territory to care for pets in clients’ homes

* Taking photos and sending a visit summary after every visit

* Bringing in mail and newspapers

* Watering indoor and outdoor plants

* Checking the home for any concerns

* Completing any additional household tasks included with our services

Requirements

* Must be at least 18 years of age

* Prior professional animal care experience

* Reliable vehicle, valid driver’s license and proof of auto insurance

* Smartphone with reliable internet access

* Daily access to email and the internet

* Comfortable using mobile apps for scheduling, communication and visit documentation

* Able to pass a criminal background check

* Excellent attention to detail, communication and customer service skills

* Reliable, punctual and dependable

* Comfortable working independently and managing your daily schedule

* Comfortable walking dogs outdoors year-round in various weather conditions

* Able to safely handle dogs of various sizes, breeds, temperaments and energy levels

What We Mean by Professional Animal Care Experience

Professional animal care experience means caring for animals in a professional, volunteer or educational setting.

Examples include:

* Professional pet sitting or dog walking

* Veterinary hospital or veterinary clinic

* Animal shelter or rescue organization

* Dog daycare or boarding facility

* Pet grooming salon

* Dog training

* Veterinary technician or veterinary assistant

* Animal care technician

* Veterinary, animal science or related internship/externship

* Horse barns, equine facilities or farm animal care

* Wildlife rehabilitation or wildlife care

* Zoo, aquarium or similar professional animal care experience

Compensation & Hours

Position Type: W-2 Employee (not an independent contractor)

Per-Visit Compensation

* 15-minute visits: $9.00

* 20-minute visits: $10.00

* 30-minute visits: $10.50

* 45-minute visits: $12.00–$13.50

* 60-minute visits: $16.00–$18.00

Mileage is paid while traveling between client visits.

Please Note: This position is paid per visit, not by the hour. The hourly pay range shown on job boards is required by the job board and does not reflect how this position is compensated.

During training, your schedule will start gradually while you learn our procedures, become familiar with your territory, and build relationships with your clients.

As your route grows, additional clients will be added to your schedule. Our goal for this Providence territory is to build Core Pet Sitters / Dog Walkers to approximately 20–25+ hours per week, based on client demand, route density, and seasonal fluctuations.

Based on actual payroll records, established Pet Care Professionals have averaged approximately $18–$20+/hour in total compensation. Actual earnings vary based on route density, visit length, visit mix, gratuities, mileage reimbursement, holiday assignments, overnight services, certifications, experience, and client demand.

Benefits

* Paid mileage between client visits

* 100% of tips

* Paid training and meetings

* Paid certifications and continuing education

* Reimbursement for Pet First Aid certification (if not previously completed before hire)

* Additional pay available for advanced certifications, including the equivalent of +$1 per visit for Certified Veterinary Technicians, Certified Dog Trainers, and Fear Free Certified Professionals

* We pay Workers’ Compensation, Unemployment Insurance, and payment of the employer portion of Social Security and Medicare taxes.

* We handle client acquisition, scheduling, billing, marketing, and office support so you can focus on providing exceptional pet care.

* Employee discounts

* Opportunities for advancement as the company continues to grow

* Consistent weekly schedule with two consecutive days off

* Assigned local territory to minimize travel

* Opportunity to build long-term client relationships

To Apply

Visit www.furryfellaspetsitting.com/about-us/employment to submit an application.

We’re looking for compassionate, dependable professionals who treat every pet and every client’s home with the same care and respect they would expect for their own.

Veterinary technicians, veterinary assistants, dog trainers, pet groomers, kennel technicians, dog daycare professionals, animal shelter and rescue staff, pre-veterinary students, and others with professional animal care experience are encouraged to apply.

title: Project Manager
description:
Location:UK wide, hybrid

Salary:£38,000 - £48,000

### About the role

**Job level: 8**

Project Managers are at the heart of multidisciplinary teams at Manifesto. The role  facilitates agile project ceremonies, drives clarity on team roles and responsibilities, and helps teams prioritise the right work at the right time. You ensure that clients are engaged and excited about the outcomes, with projects delivered on time and within budget.

As a Project Manager you will utilise Manifesto’s ways of working to deliver a range of projects and continuous improvement initiatives. Working across sectors such as charity, membership, visitor attractions, and commercial, playing  a crucial role in bringing teams together, aligning their efforts, and driving success.

Project managers will know when to challenge, when to listen, and how to build strong relationships with clients and colleagues alike. You act as the glue that holds a team together, ensuring alignment around a shared vision while providing clarity for individual contributions.

This role also contributes to Manifesto’s active Community of Practice, bringing and sharing knowledge with peers. Working closely with the leadership team to ensure your project teams are well-resourced and supported. Depending on the project's complexity—regarding requirements, stakeholders, timelines, and dependencies—your work will vary across straightforward to medium-complexity initiatives. This role is billable at 80%.

#### Responsibilities

##### Project delivery

- Manage and oversee day-to-day project and continuous improvement initiatives using agreed methodologies, approaches, and frameworks.
- Maintain accurate and timely documentation and reporting to provide transparency.
- Proactively manage project overburns to ensure stability and alignment with profit forecasts.
- Ensure seamless onboarding and offboarding of projects, supporting smooth transitions.

##### Client engagement

- Develop a deep understanding of client organisations and identify opportunities to improve customer and supporter experiences.
- Build and nurture strong client relationships through regular engagement and on-site meetings.
- Work closely with Client Services and project teams to deliver cohesive and impactful solutions.
- Contribute to new business opportunities, including proposals, pitches, and content development.

##### Team collaboration and leadership

- Manage rhythms and rituals for multidisciplinary design teams, ensuring effective collaboration and communication.
- Provide servant leadership to ensure teams work well together and clarify roles and responsibilities.
- Inspire teams with a positive approach, encouraging creativity and innovation in all aspects of delivery.
- Mentor and coach junior project managers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
- Contribute actively to Manifesto’s Community of Practice, promoting knowledge sharing and collaboration.

##### Continuous improvement

- Adopt a mindset of continuous improvement and optimisation across all areas of project delivery.
- Deepen your knowledge of delivery methodologies, including Agile, Lean, and user-centred design.
- Contribute to governance and reporting forums, offering insights to improve ways of working.
- Produce marketing content through thought leadership, blogs, and social media to promote Manifesto’s work.

#### Dimensions

##### Budget

N/A

##### Headcount

N/A

##### Resource complexity and nature of work teams

- Delivering projects that meet or exceed agreed KPIs, including time, budget, scope, quality, and client satisfaction.
- Contributing to commercial success by ensuring profitability and supporting revenue forecasts.

##### Problem solving responsibility and complexity

Proactively identifying and resolving risks and issues to maintain project success.

##### Change management requirements

- Keep everyone in the loop and get them on board early.

Understand how changes affect people and processes, and be ready for any pushback.
- Run sessions and coach teams to help them adapt smoothly.
- Check how ready people are for change and tweak plans if needed.
- Share what works (and what doesn’t) with the team.

##### Internal/external interactions

- Head of Project Management
- Senior Project Manager
- Senior leaders in manifesto
- Project managers, Operations team, designers, developers, client service teams, growth team
- Communities of Practice
- Clients

##### Strategic timeframe working towards

1-3 year business plan

### About you

#### Professional **knowledge and experience**

##### Experience

- Some track record of planning, managing, and delivering projects within time and budget constraints. Ideally, within an agency setting.
- Demonstrable knowledge of delivery methodologies and frameworks, including user-centred design, Agile, Lean practices, and the software delivery lifecycle.
- Experience managing multiple projects and deadlines concurrently.
- Strong stakeholder management skills across a wide range of sectors and organisational levels.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams and build awareness across broader audiences.
- Proven ability to help teams plan and prioritise work effectively, understanding necessary trade-offs.
- Comfortable in a servant leadership role, ensuring teams are cohesive and clear on their objectives.

##### Desirable experience

- Experience in delivering change within large, complex environments using Agile methodologies
- Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Trello, or other project management platforms.
- Knowledge of trends and innovations in digital transformation and project management.

##### Technical skills

- Agile (Scrum, Kanban)
- Lean practices
- User-centered design frameworks
- Software delivery lifecycle understanding
- Managing multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
- Running Agile ceremonies (stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives)
- Risk and issue management
- Project documentation and reporting
- Jira, Trello, or equivalent project management tools
- Collaboration tools (e.g. Confluence, Slack, Microsoft Teams)
- Facilitating team communication and alignment
- Managing client relationships and expectations
- Supporting proposal and pitch development
- Leading and coaching teams through change
- Assessing change readiness and adapting plans accordingly
- Monitoring project budgets and profitability
- Aligning delivery with business revenue goals

##### Behaviours

- Collaborative and adaptable takes full ownership of project delivery while fostering clear communication and strong relationships with clients and teams.
- Proactive in problem-solving and risk management, with a client-focused approach.
- Demonstrates resilience under pressure and a commitment to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing. Inspires positivity and teamwork to drive successful project outcomes
- Embodies Manifesto’s values, championing purpose-driven work and fostering a positive team culture.

##### PACT values

**Purpose -** The beating heart of our organisation—the impact we make on people, places, and the planet. Purpose is our driving force and at the core of our organisation.

**Accountability -** As we apply flexibility, pace and growth through our self-organisation, we are accountable* to all of our stakeholders.

**Craft -** Craft highlights our dedication to bringing precision, problem-solving, and creativity to our work, both with our clients and internally.

**Togetherness -**Togetherness is ‘how’ we work - it captures the energy, fun, and user-centred approach that we embrace. It signifies the collaborative spirit we bring to our work, including people at every level and creating a sense of belonging to our teams

### About us

#### manifesto

We are the digital experience agency for changemakers. We are committed to delivering purposeful and positive impact for people, planet and society, in restless pursuit of a better world.

We take pride in creating award-winning digital experiences, products and services that are measurably ethical,  inclusive, accessible, sustainable and joyful.

Our changemaker clients include UNICEF UK, Breast Cancer Now, The Trussell Trust, Woodgreen, The Royal Academy of Arts, Zoological Society London, Historic Environment Scotland and Fauna & Flora.

Part of the TPXimpact group - a Certified B Corporation™, we are a team of 130 digital product leaders, creative designers, user experience designers, engagement specialists, software engineers and experience strategists.

title: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
This job is with London Business School, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly.

Help shape how engineering teams build, deploy and operate technology at London Business School.

The Role

London Business School is looking for a Senior Azure DevOps Engineer to strengthen our engineering capability and help us mature the way we build, deploy and operate technology across a varied technology estate.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who combines deep technical expertise with ownership, judgement and the ability to influence across multiple engineering and delivery teams.

You won't simply be handed a backlog of DevOps tasks. We're looking for someone who can assess where we are today, identify the areas that will make the biggest difference, recommend practical improvements and then take those improvements through to implementation and adoption.

Working closely with engineering teams, Architecture, Cyber Security, Delivery and operational support colleagues, you will help make our technology delivery more automated, secure, reliable and predictable.

Main Responsibilities

You will take senior technical ownership across our DevOps capability, including:

  • Designing, implementing and improving Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, reusable YAML templates and deployment controls.

  • Driving greater adoption of Infrastructure as Code, using technologies such as Terraform.

  • Improving automation across build, release, environment provisioning and operational processes.

  • Developing and evolving practical DevOps standards, patterns and reusable engineering approaches.

  • Helping teams improve release quality, deployment reliability, rollback capability and operational readiness.

  • Strengthening monitoring, logging, alerting and observability across applications and platforms.

  • Embedding security into pipelines and cloud infrastructure, including secrets management, identity controls and automated security checks.

  • Identifying technical debt, manual processes and recurring operational issues and turning them into prioritised improvement opportunities.

  • Working across multiple teams to resolve dependencies and differing levels of DevOps maturity.

  • Coaching and enabling engineers so that good DevOps practice becomes embedded across our teams rather than dependent on one individual.

  • Translating agreed engineering priorities into a pragmatic, phased DevOps improvement roadmap and driving delivery against it.

Who We Are Looking For

You'll be an experienced DevOps or cloud engineer who is comfortable operating with a high degree of independence.

Alongside strong hands-on Azure expertise, you'll be able to demonstrate:

  • Strong experience with Azure and Azure DevOps.

  • Deep understanding of CI/CD and experience designing scalable deployment pipelines.

  • Strong practical experience with Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform.

  • Experience implementing effective monitoring, logging and alerting.

  • Good understanding of Git, branching strategies and modern release and deployment approaches.

  • Experience embedding security and governance into cloud and pipeline configurations.

  • The ability to take ambiguous technical problems from discovery through recommendation, implementation and adoption.

  • Strong judgement when balancing delivery priorities, operational risk and longer-term engineering improvement.

  • The confidence to challenge existing approaches constructively and recommend better alternatives.

  • Experience influencing engineering standards and securing adoption across multiple teams.

  • A collaborative approach and the ability to coach and enable other engineers.

  • Azure DevOps Engineer Expert certification, or equivalent demonstrable experience, would be highly valued.

Benefits You Can Enjoy

  • Generous annual leave of 27 days plus extra days between Christmas and New Year

  • USS pension, 14.5% employer contribution (in return for employee enrolment and contribution)

  • Free onsite gym and swimming pool

  • Amazing range of professional development to support your career path

  • Enhanced cycle to work scheme

  • Wellbeing offering to support your physical, mental and financial health

At London Business School, we support Smart Working - a hybrid approach designed to help you achieve a healthy work-life balance while delivering the best outcomes for your role and the needs of our customers. All roles require a minimum of two days on campus each week to foster a vibrant, collaborative community.


For this role specifically, you will be expected to be on campus 3 days per week.

We operate with 'core hours' - 10:00-15:00 - to maximise opportunities for connection and collaboration across teams during the working day. Outside of these hours, you may still be required for meetings or collaboration based on your role and customer needs. Additionally, we offer Protected Time - a flexible, one-hour slot, within the working week dedicated to your learning and development, wellbeing, or focused, quiet work

Why London Business School?

London Business School; a global and vibrant business community based in three of the world's most dynamic cities, London, Dubai and Riyadh. It's where extraordinary minds and diverse perspectives connect, to have a profound impact on the way the world does business and the way business impacts the world. We offer best in class hybrid learning to our students and participants, whilst creating a flexible, supportive and dynamic working environment for our people to excel in, whatever their location.

Our commitment to driving inclusion and belonging

We are a globally reaching institution, committed to creating tangible and sustainable change in driving inclusion & belonging within our School, education and society at large. We are dedicated to creating an environment where everyone in our community feels they belong and thrive. This is a key school priority, and we want everyone who joins LBS to feel respected, welcomed, and heard.
