title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
description:
The Opportunity

Join Adobe’s Brand AI Services team and help define the future of AI-powered creativity. We are building multimodal and agentic AI systems that enable marketers and creative professionals to ideate, create, understand, and transform content through intelligent AI-powered workflows.

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will design and deliver production-grade generative and agentic AI systems that power Adobe Firefly AI Assistant and experiences across Creative Cloud, Adobe Express, GenStudio, and more.

You’ll work at the intersection of computer vision, generative AI, multimodal learning, and agentic AI, building systems that understand creative intent, reason across multimodal content, use tools, and orchestrate complex creative workflows. This is a high-impact role focused on building the next generation of AI experiences for millions of creative professionals.

Come create the future with us!

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of multimodal and generative AI systems spanning vision, language, and other modalities.
  • Build and productionize generative AI models and systems, including transformers, diffusion models, LLMs, and vision-language models (VLMs), for content creation, understanding, and transformation.
  • Develop and build agentic AI systems that can reason, use tools, interact with models and services, and complete complex multi-step creative workflows.
  • Build intelligent capabilities for Firefly AI Assistant and Creative Cloud workflows, helping creative professionals move from intent and ideas to high-quality creative outcomes.
  • Develop scalable services and APIs that integrate AI and machine learning capabilities into Adobe products.
  • Drive the end-to-end ML lifecycle, including problem formulation, modeling, experimentation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Partner with engineering, product, design, and research teams to translate customer needs into effective ML solutions.
  • Improve the performance, scalability, reliability, and quality of AI systems operating in high-traffic production environments.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and help raise the engineering and machine learning bar across the team.
  • Identify new opportunities to apply generative and agentic AI to real-world challenges for creative professionals and enterprise customers.

What You Need to Succeed

  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production.
  • Hands-on experience designing and building agentic AI systems, including areas such as tool use, agent orchestration, multi-step workflows, planning and reasoning, retrieval, memory, or human-in-the-loop systems.
  • Experience with agent interoperability and tool integration, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), function/tool calling, or similar frameworks and protocols.
  • Expertise in computer vision, generative AI, and/or multimodal machine learning, with hands-on experience using modern architectures such as transformers, diffusion models, LLMs, or VLMs.
  • Solid foundation in probability, statistics, machine learning, and model evaluation.
  • Proficiency in Python and experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch.
  • Experience designing and building scalable APIs, distributed services, or production ML infrastructure.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, testing, code quality, and code reviews.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure and containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools and workflows, including systems such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or similar tools, and experience using them for development, experimentation, or productivity.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building production agentic AI platforms or multi-agent systems, including agent evaluation, observability, reliability, or safety.
  • Experience with multimodal learning across video, audio, or 3D data.
  • Background in video understanding or generation, temporal modeling, or streaming ML systems.
  • Experience fine-tuning, adapting, or optimizing large-scale foundation models.
  • Knowledge of AI evaluation, safety, and responsible AI practices.
  • Experience with agent frameworks, orchestration platforms, retrieval systems, or enterprise knowledge integration.
  • Experience building AI-powered tools or workflows for creative professionals, content creation, or creative applications.
  • Contributions to research, open-source projects, or applied machine learning innovation.

title: Core Agent Engineer
description:
The Opportunity

Adobe is reimagining the future of creativity — where generative AI, intelligent agents, and human imagination work hand in hand. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, Agentic Product, you will be a key technical contributor for Adobe's up-and-coming AI-native experience that brings generative models, creative intelligence, and decades of differentiated Adobe capabilities together for hundreds of millions of creators. You will own hands-on buildout of the agent across the full stack and across Adobe's target platforms, from desktop and mobile to web and embedded surfaces. You will help reshape the way the team works in the age of agentic engineering. And you will be getting in on the ground floor to help shape the team and its practices.

This is a rare opportunity to build the engineering foundations of Adobe's soon-to-be most visible AI product — from model integration and agentic reasoning patterns, to production infrastructure and cross-platform delivery. The right person brings deep, hands-on full-stack expertise, proven experience shipping agentic systems, a genuine enthusiasm for transforming how engineering itself is done with AI tools like Claude Code and Codex, and the craft to write production-quality code that holds up over time.

What you'll do

  • Own full-stack implementation across Adobe's Agentic Product — from LLM integration and agentic reasoning layers, to API surfaces, client runtimes, and platform-specific delivery on desktop, mobile, and web.

  • Contribute to the production buildout of the agent: translating prototype-quality capabilities into robust, scalable, maintainable systems that meet Adobe's quality and reliability bar for a large, diverse audience.

  • Drive hands-on implementation of high-leverage components — including model orchestration, tool use, multi-step task execution, context and memory management, and agent evaluation infrastructure.

  • Champion the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices — using tools like Claude Code, Codex, and emerging agentic development platforms to accelerate implementation, raise code quality, and fundamentally change how the team ships. Model new workflows where AI is a first-class collaborator in the development process.

  • Contribute to developer experience: tooling, local development loops, CI/CD ergonomics, and the scaffolding that lets a team move fast and confidently in a fast-moving AI product environment.

  • Stay current with the model capabilities ecosystem, evaluating new LLM approaches and frameworks, and contributing recommendations on when and how to adopt them.

  • Help build and maintain the evaluation and quality framework for agent behavior — the evals, benchmarks, and systematic feedback loops that allow the team to measure progress and catch regressions as capabilities evolve.

  • Partner with Engineering and Product leadership to translate product ambitions into technically grounded delivery — surfacing constraints early, proposing implementation options, and ensuring scope is set based on accurate technical understanding.

  • Collaborate across Adobe's platform, infrastructure, data, and security teams to ensure the Agentic Product is built on a foundation that supports guardrails, data protection, observability, and the operational requirements of a product at Adobe's scale.

  • Raise the bar for peers on the team by generating excellent code, driving high-signal code review processes, and sharing technical knowledge in agentic engineering.

What you'll need to succeed

  • Solid, hands-on experience with large language models — including practical fluency with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, context window management, retrieval-augmented generation, and the operational realities of running LLM-backed systems in production.

  • Experience building and shipping agentic systems: tool use, multi-step reasoning, agent orchestration frameworks, memory and context persistence, and the failure modes that emerge at each layer.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering tools — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar — and a track record of integrating these into real development workflows. Enthusiasm for pushing the boundary of what AI-augmented engineering can look like at the frontier.

  • Full-stack engineering depth sufficient to contribute across the agent's entire surface area — including backend services, client SDKs, and platform-specific integration patterns for Adobe's target platforms.

  • Strong engineering craft: readable, well-structured, production-quality code; opinionated views on testing, local dev ergonomics, and the scaffolding that helps a team stay productive as a codebase grows.

  • Clear communication skills — able to discuss technical tradeoffs with PM leads and senior technical stakeholders, flag issues early, and collaborate effectively across disciplines.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where the underlying models, frameworks, and user expectations are all rapidly evolving — strong enough foundations to move fast without building on sand.

  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with product, design, platform, and security teams in the context of shipping user-facing AI products.

  • Familiarity with the quality, trust, and reliability requirements of shipping AI features to a large consumer and enterprise audience, including responsible AI considerations specific to generative and agentic systems.

title: Junior Partner
description:
Sanabria & Associates, PLLC is a fast-growing and highly respected law firm with offices throughout Maryland, Virginia, and Florida. We are currently seeking an experienced Immigration Attorney to join our team in one of our Maryland or Florida offices.


The ideal candidate will have a strong background in immigration law, demonstrated experience managing and mentoring attorneys, and a proven ability to oversee a diverse caseload in a fast-paced legal environment. We are looking for a motivated professional who is an excellent communicator, collaborative team member, effective leader, and self-starter. Candidates must possess strong business acumen, outstanding organizational skills, and the ability to thrive in a high-volume, growth-oriented practice.


The selected attorney will be responsible for handling a substantial immigration caseload, maintaining day-to-day client relationships, managing and mentoring a team of attorneys, meeting critical deadlines, and actively participating as a member of the firm’s leadership team. The ability to manage multiple priorities, oversee complex matters, provide effective leadership, and deliver exceptional client service is essential. This position will report directly to the Partner Board.


We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Immigration Attorney to step into the role of Junior Partner and join our firm. This is an exciting opportunity for a legal professional looking to take the next step in their career, contribute to a dynamic team, and help clients navigate complex immigration processes. The successful candidate will serve as a key member of the firm’s leadership team, providing strategic direction, leading attorneys, strengthening client relationships, and driving the firm’s continued growth and success.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead and oversee a diverse portfolio of immigration matters, including humanitarian relief, removal defense, family-based petitions, asylum, Special Immigrant Juvenile Status (SIJS), U Visas, VAWA petitions, waivers, adjustment of status, consular processing, cancellation of removal, permanent residency, citizenship, and other forms of immigration relief
  • Develop, direct, and oversee legal strategies for complex immigration matters from initial consultation through final resolution, ensuring high-quality representation and effective client advocacy
  • Conduct consultations with prospective clients, evaluate potential immigration relief options, assess case viability and risk, and provide strategic legal recommendations
  • Manage a high-volume caseload while maintaining oversight of case strategy, quality, workflow, and compliance with all court, agency, and filing deadlines
  • Represent clients before Immigration Courts, USCIS, EOIR, ICE, and other government agencies, including master calendar hearings, individual hearings, asylum interviews, adjustment interviews, and other immigration proceedings
  • Review, prepare, and approve applications, petitions, motions, briefs, appeals, waivers, legal memoranda, and other immigration filings, ensuring accuracy, legal sufficiency, and adherence to firm standards
  • Conduct and oversee legal research involving complex or evolving immigration issues and provide strategic guidance on significant legal developments
  • Lead, supervise, mentor, and develop attorneys providing substantive legal guidance, performance feedback, training, and oversight to maintain high standards of legal work and client service
  • Serve as a subject matter expert and escalation point for attorneys and staff handling complex, sensitive, or high-risk immigration matters
  • Maintain strong client relationships by providing clear strategic guidance, setting expectations, communicating significant case developments, and ensuring a consistently high level of client service
  • Develop and maintain productive professional relationships with clients, government agencies, community organizations, referral partners, and other external stakeholders

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Why Join JVS?**

JVS is a nonprofit working to close opportunity gaps in employment by supporting jobseekers with the skills and confidence to secure quality careers with family-sustaining wages. Grounded in core values of repairing the world and focused on helping our program participants achieve economic mobility, we believe everyone deserves access to training and the chance for a good job. JVS develops training programs in close partnership with employers in high growth sectors, offering high quality jobs.

Building on decades of experience and success, JVS is a data-driven organization that takes a whole systems approach to addressing employment and economic equity. Through our direct service programs, employer engagement and policy change, JVS is working toward a future where everyone has access to quality education and training programs that lead to high quality employment and economic mobility.

**The Role**

The Data Analyst is a core member of JVS's Evaluation and Impact team, responsible for transforming program data into clear, credible, and actionable evidence. This role leads routine and ad hoc reporting, conducts quantitative analyses that answer organizational learning questions, and supports the data infrastructure work required to build JVS's evidence base over time.

The Data Analyst works closely with the Evaluation and Impact team to ensure that data from Salesforce and other systems is accurate, well-organized, and analysis-ready. A key function of this role is supporting JVS's Evidence-Building Roadmap (EBR) — particularly activities related to outcome metrics refinement, data quality, real-time reporting, and internal program evaluation.

This role reports to the Manager of Data Systems and Analytics and works in close collaboration with the Director of Evaluation and Impact, program teams, and the Salesforce and Integration Administrator.

**Scope**

**Reporting & Data Analysis (primary function — approximately 60–65% of role)**

- Pull, clean, and prepare data from Salesforce and other systems to produce regular program performance reports for internal teams and external stakeholders.
- Conduct analyses to answer questions on the organizational learning agenda, including participant outcomes, program completion, retention, and equity, disaggregating by race, gender, and other participant characteristics.
- Design and iterate on Power BI dashboards and Salesforce reports, determining what program questions each dashboard should answer, which indicators matter, and whether outputs accurately reflect program reality — working with the rest of the Evaluation and Impact team and Salesforce and Integration Administrator to implement technical changes as needed.
- Validate the accuracy and program relevance of real-time reporting infrastructure as it is built out, ensuring dashboards reflect the right indicators and are usable by program staff.
- Produce data briefs, one-pagers, and narrative summaries that translate analytical findings into accessible, decision-relevant language for non-technical audiences.
- Respond to ad hoc data requests from program, development, finance, and leadership teams with accuracy and timeliness.
- Conduct living wage analysis, marketing referral source analysis, and other recurring analytical projects as assigned.

**Data Quality & G** **overnance****(approximately 15% of role)**

- Run regular data quality audits by pulling and analyzing Salesforce data to identify errors, gaps, inconsistencies, and missing values — documenting findings and bringing issues to the Salesforce and Integration Administrator for system-level resolution.
- Contribute to data quality and quality assurance protocols by stress-testing reporting outputs, surfacing patterns of data entry error, recommending changes to data collection practices from an analytical standpoint, and identify opportunities for improvement to current systems and operations.
- Own the analytical definition layer of data governance: develop and maintain data dictionaries, reporting definitions, and dataset documentation so that analytical outputs are reproducible, clearly sourced, and accessible to the broader team.
- Support encounters QA and monthly database review processes, focusing on whether data patterns make sense programmatically — flagging anomalies that may indicate data entry issues or process gaps.

**Evidence-Building & Evaluation Support (approximately 10–15% of role)**

- Support the refinement of outcome metrics and quality indicators by assessing whether proposed measures are analytically sound, measurable with available data, and aligned with JVS's Theory of Change — in coordination with the Evaluation and Impact team and the Salesforce and Integration Administrator.
- Contribute to the development and testing of lines of sight — measurable connections between program activities and participant outcomes — by analyzing existing data to test whether hypothesized relationships hold.
- Clean, structure, and document datasets for use by the Evaluation and Impact team in internal evaluations, external research partnerships, and funder reporting — working from raw exports prepared by the Salesforce and Integration Administrator.
- Support internal program outcome evaluation activities, including data preparation, analysis, and contributing to dissemination of findings (EBR Year 4, supporting role).
- Contribute to the organizational learning agenda by presenting data findings in program review meetings, staff learning sessions, and team check-ins.

**Project Support (approximately 10–15% of role)**

- Support dashboard review and revamp initiatives by assessing whether existing dashboards answer the right program questions, validating data source accuracy, and recommending content and design improvements — in coordination with the Salesforce and Integration Administrator who leads the technical build.
- Assist with retention data and dashboard validation, and support the retention survey revamp process.
- Contribute to data source inventory and governance review, helping ensure the team has a clear picture of what data exists, where it lives, and how it is used analytically.
- Support the living wage analysis and other analytical projects as capacity allows.
- Contribute to the PDSA process by preparing data summaries that support iterative program improvement cycles.

**Qualifications**

**Minimum Qualifications**

- Bachelor’s degree in public policy, sociology, data science, economics, social work, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.
- Minimum 4–5 years of professional experience in data analysis, reporting, or performance measurement, with demonstrated ability to work with complex datasets and produce high-quality outputs independently.
- Experience pulling, cleaning, and analyzing data from a CRM or database system, preferably Salesforce; advanced Excel skills for data cleaning, analysis, and reporting required.
- Experience with data documentation practices, including data dictionaries, reporting definitions, and data quality audit processes.
- Experience designing and iterating on dashboards and reports in Power BI or equivalent BI tool, with a focus on making data accessible and actionable for non-technical users.
- Experience using AI-assisted tools (such as Microsoft Copilot or similar technologies) to improve productivity, documentation, analysis, or reporting workflows.
- Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with genuine curiosity about what program data reveals and what it may obscure.
- Ability to understand how program workflows, operational processes, reporting requirements, and participant experiences connect across systems.
- Excellent attention to detail and strong data documentation habits; ability to manage multiple reporting cycles, ad hoc requests, and project deadlines simultaneously.
- Demonstrated ability to independently investigate problems and move work forward.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills; collaborative working style.
- Commitment to equity and interest in analyzing data through an equity lens, including disaggregating outcomes by participant demographics. Alignment with JVS's mission of equitable economic mobility and commitment to the communities JVS serves.

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience with Salesforce.
- Experience with R, Python, or Stata; proficiency in SQL or strong willingness to develop SQL skills on the job.
- Familiarity with evaluation frameworks, including logic models, theory of change, outcome metrics, or performance measurement systems.
- Familiarity with workforce development program data, including WIOA reporting, EDD wage records, or similar labor market data sources.

**What We Offer**

- Annual Salary: $88,000 - $95,500
- 100% covered medical and dental plans for the employee
- Accrued sixteen (16) days of Vacation + accrued ten (10) days of Paid Sick Leave
- Paid federal and Jewish holidays
- 3% 403(b) retirement contribution match and 3% non-elective contribution
- Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
- Pet Insurance Discounts
- Employee Assistance Program
- Professional development opportunities and $500 Work-From-Home stipend
- The expectation for this role is to work in our San Francisco office and/or worksites on a hybrid work schedule; JVS does not provide relocation packages
- 4 Day Work Week

Please let us know if you need accommodations or auxiliary aids for the interview process._

We are engaging Senior Backend Engineers to participate in an advanced project for a customer, focused on creating sophisticated Reinforcement Learning Environments for AI model training and evaluation. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

As an expert, you will create Reinforcement Learning Environments that test an AI model’s ability to design, deploy, troubleshoot, secure, scale, and recover production-grade cloud infrastructure. You will develop realistic scenarios involving distributed systems, networking, IAM, queues, durable storage, observability, rolling deployments, and disaster recovery, then build reproducible environments, deterministic validation tests, golden reference solutions, and intentionally defective variants.

  1. Design, develop, and implement realistic cloud infrastructure environments to evaluate AI model proficiency in systems design, deployment, and troubleshooting.

  3. Develop deterministic validation tests and golden reference solutions to ensure the reliability and accuracy of reinforcement learning environments.
  4. Produce intentionally defective variants and failure scenarios to rigorously test AI model responses and recovery strategies.
  5. Document the architecture, edge cases, and operational flows for all developed environments, ensuring clarity and reproducibility for future use.
  6. Collaborate with technical leads and project participants to iteratively refine environment specifications and acceptance criteria.
  7. Apply DevOps and infrastructure automation practices to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions for cloud-based systems evaluation.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Proven expertise with backend programming languages, such as C++, Python, Rust, GoLang, JAVA, or JavaScript.
  2. Strong practical experience with DevOps, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and automation tools.
  3. Demonstrated ability to architect, scale, and secure distributed systems in production-grade environments.
  4. Deep understanding of networking, IAM, queues, durable storage, and disaster recovery concepts.

The Opportunity

We are in search of an experienced Senior AI/ML Engineer to develop and broaden fraud and abuse detection systems. You will improve ML techniques in anomaly detection, user/device risk analysis, identity and service abuse, and evolving AI abuse scenarios.

This is a hands-on role spanning ML, data, and backend systems, with opportunities to apply LLMs, AI agents, and modern ML techniques to strengthen detection. You will own solutions end to end — from signals and modeling through production deployment and real-time decisioning. Join us in crafting best in class fraud detection systems that will make a significant impact!

title: Head of Strategy
description:
Thank you for considering Oklo. We are hiring a Head of Strategy to build and lead our corporate Strategy function.

Position Description

Oklo is seeking a Head of Strategy to serve as the senior leader of the company’s corporate strategy function. Reporting to the Chief Strategy Officer, you will shape Oklo’s enterprise strategy, lead the Strategy team, and help the company make and execute its most consequential decisions.

The function is designed to be proactive and high leverage: identifying emerging opportunities and risks, developing independent points of view, and deploying a focused team against the company’s highest-priority questions and initiatives. You will set the function’s agenda and standards, determine where Strategy resources can have the greatest impact, and lead work from early thesis development through executive decision, execution, and handoff.

You will work directly with the founders, CFO, and business-unit leaders, bringing forward original recommendations, constructively challenging assumptions, and leading the Strategy function’s contribution to executive and Board decisions. You will be accountable for the quality of company-level strategy, the effectiveness of the Strategy function, and the impact of the initiatives it leads.

Specific responsibilities include:

  • Build and lead the corporate strategy function. Design the function's operating model; hire, develop, and manage talent; allocate resources; and own the standards, quality, and results of the team.
  • Own enterprise strategy. Lead the development and refinement of Oklo's long-range strategy, including portfolio choices, priority markets, business models, growth platforms, and the allocation of leadership attention and company resources.
  • Set a proactive strategic agenda. Identify important opportunities, risks, and unanswered questions before they are formally assigned. Sponsor the right analysis and recommend what the company should pursue, defer, reshape, or decline.
  • Lead strategic planning and performance reviews. Own the Strategy team's delivery of annual and multi-year planning, objectives and key results, scorecards, and initiative reviews.
  • Shape major corporate choices. Support the strategic evaluation of partnerships, creative capital initiatives, acquisitions, new ventures, international opportunities, and structural options in collaboration with the relevant business units and functional owners.
  • Own the strategic-initiative portfolio. Establish objectives, accountable leaders, milestones, decision points, and review mechanisms. Recommend when to advance, resource, redirect, stop, or hand off work.
  • Advise executive leadership and the Board. Bring independent, evidence-based recommendations; challenge assumptions constructively; frame alternatives and tradeoffs; and lead consequential strategic discussions.
  • Personally lead selected high-stakes initiatives. Take direct responsibility for a small number of the company's most important initiatives through decision, launch, transaction, or a clear operational handoff.
  • Integrate strategy across the company. Partner with Finance, Corporate Development, Strategic Partnerships, Legal, Government Affairs, international teams, technical and regulatory leaders, and business units so company-level choices remain coherent through execution.
  • Build company-wide strategy capability. Establish rigorous methods for business cases, decision memos, portfolio reviews, and strategic planning, and coach colleagues to improve the quality and speed of decision-making.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Senior leadership experience. Substantial experience leading corporate strategy, general management, business building, or a comparable enterprise mandate, with a record of shaping company direction and driving implementation.
  • Functional and people leadership. Demonstrated success building high-performing teams, setting an agenda, developing talent, managing performance, and delivering results through others.
  • Executive and Board judgment. Experience advising founders, senior executives, or Boards on consequential choices and creating alignment around difficult decisions.
  • Commercial and financial depth. Strong judgment across business models, partnerships, capital requirements, growth opportunities, portfolio choices, and resource tradeoffs.
  • Cross-functional execution. A record of leading complex initiatives across functions and business units without relying solely on direct reporting authority.
  • Exceptional communication. Excellent writing, synthesis, and executive communication, with the credibility to challenge assumptions and represent the company with senior counterparties.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience building a Strategy function or leading strategy across multiple businesses in a growing, capital-intensive, or regulated company.
  • Experience with industrial or technology partnerships, capital formation, international initiatives, acquisitions, or new ventures.
  • Experience leading executive and Board strategy work and establishing effective company planning and accountability processes.

Competencies

  • Takes ownership of the function's agenda, people, standards, and results.
  • Brings independent judgment and imagination, grounded in evidence and commercial discipline.
  • Develops strong teams, builds alignment, and makes difficult tradeoffs explicit.
  • Welcomes constructive disagreement and combines senior leadership with hands-on work.

Who you are:

You want to own a meaningful part of a company's direction and build the team that makes it actionable. You bring an agenda, not just an answer to someone else's question. You can challenge an executive, align business leaders, develop talented colleagues, and take responsibility for what happens next.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Significant travel for executive working sessions, team collaboration, and selected engagements may be required. Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $275,000–$350,000.

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

We are looking for a Data Scientist to help us answer questions like these. We study customer behavior, test new experiences, and measure how Adobe.com contributes to Firefly adoption, engagement, and business results.

We share what we learn with Product, Marketing, Finance, Product Analytics, Engineering, and GTM so teams can make better decisions.

We also use AI and automation to reduce repetitive reporting and give analysts more time to investigate new questions. Join us and help shape how customers discover and adopt Firefly through Adobe.com!

About the Role

This is a hands-on individual contributor role responsible for leading web analytics and measurement initiatives for Adobe Firefly on Adobe.com. You will identify which web experiences influence Firefly discovery, adoption, and customer value.

You will work directly with clickstream and experimentation data, investigate questions that may not have an established analytical approach, and explain what the findings mean for the business. The role focuses on Adobe.com behavior and uses downstream customer, product, and business outcomes to evaluate the impact of web experiences.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze how customers discover and engage with Firefly through Adobe.com. Identify performance drivers, journey friction, and changes that could improve acquisition, engagement, and conversion.
  • Answer complex business questions using Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics, SQL, statistical analysis, and relevant customer, product, and business data.
  • Work with Product, Marketing, GTM, and analytics teams to develop hypotheses, shape experiments, analyze A/B tests, and turn the results into decisions.
  • Partner with team members to define critical metrics, cohorts, success criteria, and measurement approaches. Develop new approaches when direct attribution is limited or established measures do not yet exist.
  • Interpret weekly performance, investigate material changes, and respond quickly when the business needs analytical support. Present findings that inform Adobe.com priorities and decisions related to Firefly.
  • Turn successful analyses and experiments into repeatable frameworks and playbooks. Work with analytics engineering and platform teams to improve automation, reporting, and self-service

​What You Need to Succeed

A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience—is required.

  • 5+ years of experience in growth analytics, web analytics, experimentation, data science, decision science, or a related field.
  • Experience analyzing customer journeys, conversion funnels, and large clickstream datasets using Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics, or a comparable platform.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience using Python, R, or similar tools for statistical analysis and modeling.
  • Experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, along with the judgment to work with incomplete data and questions without an established solution.
  • Ability to identify important questions, synthesize findings, communicate with senior leaders, and help teams turn analysis into decisions.

Experience with web-to-product adoption, cross-surface customer journeys, causal inference, incrementality measurement, or generative AI products is helpful but not required.

If you enjoy finding answers in complex data and helping teams decide what to do next, we’d like to hear from you!


About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.


Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.


Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.


Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.


AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:
Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.


At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. The U.S. pay range for this position is $109,000 - $200,700 annually. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process. In California, the pay range for this position is $138,600 - $200,700

description:

Job Summary:

This position is located in West Memphis, TN - As an CCT M&R Tech, you will maintain and repair intermodal equipment ( CCT- containers, chassis and trailers) in order to meet the equipment demands of our customers in accordance with the core values of the company and in a way that he/she achieves the established goals for operational performance and safety while building customer loyalty. This position is required to be on-site daily in the West Memphis, TN Yard location.


Summary:
This person's objective is to maintain and repair intermodal equipment ( CCT- containers, chassis and trailers) in order to meet the equipment demands of our customers in accordance with the core values of the company and in a way that he/she achieves the established goals for operational performance and safety while building customer loyalty.

Responsibilities:
- Must be able to perform all repairs listed on the FHWA ( Federal Highway Administration)
- Inspect equipment to determine best work plan procedure
- Removes, replaces or rebuilds damaged or malfunctioning parts
- Understands and repairs electrical systems, air systems, brakes, tires, etc.
- Perform welding and riveting
- Helps unload/unpack tires and parts maintains organization of inventory
- Maintains a clean and safe working environment that complies with environmental - -guidelines and policies. -Ensures repairs are completed according to customer's established criteria -Works with auditors to determine amount and type of repairs needed

Accountabilities:
- Repairs are completed correctly and economically as assigned
- Completed work on equipment meets or exceeds safety compliance
- Documents all repairs work orders
- Meets established productivity measures
- Reports any irregularities to management
- Keeps the shop/ yard area and company vehicles and assets in clean and orderly -conditions
- Works well with other mechanics to perform as a team -Perform other duties as assigned

Competencies and Requirements :
- Ability to lift over 50lbs
- Owns complete set of tools
- Ability and Knowledge to use power or pneumatic tools
- Work in adverse weather conditions - Performs work independently - Problems solving and diagnostics skills - Ability and agility to work in all areas of shop/ yard

Though not all encompassing, below is a list of required and recommended tools to perform the functions of the role;

Hand tools

  • Ratchet and socket set: A set with both metric and SAE sizes is essential for handling various nuts and bolts.
  • Combination wrenches: Get a set in both metric and SAE sizes.
  • Pliers: A set including needle-nose, slip-joint
  • Screwdrivers: A set with both Phillips and flathead bits is a must.
  • Allen wrenches: A set in both metric and SAE sizes for hexagonal fasteners.
  • Pry bar: A medium-length pry bar is a good starting point for leverage.
  • Vice grips: Also known as locking pliers, these are useful for many tasks, like holding parts in place.
  • Hammer: A ball peen hammer, dead blow hammer, mallet
  • Hook and pick set: Useful for pulling O-rings, disconnecting small hoses, and cleaning hard-to-reach areas.
  • Wire brush: A small one is helpful for cleaning terminals and other parts.

Safety and troubleshooting tools

  • Mechanic's gloves: To protect your hands.
  • Digital multimeter: For diagnosing electrical issues.
  • Telescoping magnet: Indispensable for retrieving dropped nuts, bolts, and other small metal parts in hard-to-reach places.
  • Magnetic parts tray: Keeps small parts from getting lost.

Optional but useful tools

  • Breaker bar: For extra leverage when a standard ratchet isn't enough to loosen a stubborn nut.
  • Impact driver: A powerful tool for driving screws and bolts.
  • Cordless drill: Useful for drilling holes and driving fasteners.

If you have the skills and experience required for this position, we encourage you to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace.

  • Offering a competitive salary (based on experience).
  • Competitive commission plan.
  • Benefits include PTO, Paid Holidays, medical, dental, visions, company paid Life and Long-term disability, and additional options.
  • Company offers a 401(k) program and company match for eligible employees.
  • Opportunities for career advancement and continued professional development.
  • A dynamic, exciting, and mission-driven work environment.



Equal Opportunity Statement:

U.S. Multimodal is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we are committed to fostering a safe and friendly workplace. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

title: Part II Architectural Assistant
description:
##### **We are seeking a Part II Architectural Assistant to join our Edinburgh studio.**

We’re looking for a qualified Part II Architectural Assistant to help us design a better every day – one where buildings genuinely serve the needs of the people who use them. If you’re a highly talented designer who’s looking for their next exciting challenge in our Edinburgh team, this could be the role for you.

At ADP, you’ll have the opportunity to develop your skills in a chosen sector or as an all-rounder, working with our cross-practice specialists in sectors including residential, commercial, healthcare and education design. You’ll also be able to work on projects that truly benefit their communities, from large laboratory buildings to mixed-use developments, sensitive refurbishments to envelope-pushing new builds, £100m high-profile schemes to local grassroots projects. Recent highlights include the transformation of an Art Deco Debenhams store into the University of Gloucestershire’s city campus and delivering our award-winning GP Surgery in Hackney, The Portico.

With seven studios across the UK, Cyprus and India and 60 years history, we work collaboratively to deliver buildings that make a real difference. We design around the principles of sustainability, belonging and engagement, rethinking the built environment to create a better future. Our recent awards include Architect of the Year at the OxProp Awards, Best Student/Pupil Experience Project at the Learning Places Scotland Awards and the AJ Architecture Award for Best Health and Wellbeing Project.

ADP is an employee-owned practice meaning that all staff have a say in how the business is run, and everyone benefits from its success. We know that a healthy work-life balance is key and in addition to other benefits all staff work a 9-day working fortnight.

We’re an equal opportunities employer and a gold-standard investor in people, reflecting our belief that it takes a people-centred practice to create people-centred architecture.

Diversity is at the heart of our success, and we welcome applications from underrepresented groups.

##### **Start Date: ASAP**

##### **The Role**

- Producing strong effective designs with appropriate competent technical solutions that align with our vision.
- Taking responsibility for the production, coordination and integrity of project specific  information.
- Taking responsibility for all project specific quality management tasks.
- Ensuring that all work is prepared in accordance with the practice’s BIM standards and protocols.
- Having a clear understanding of ADP’s scope of services for projects and being aware of applicable change control processes.
- Regularly reviewing the design against the project brief and participate in design reviews.
- Ensuring that service is delivered in accordance with the quality management system.
- Maintaining a clear understanding of the RIBA Plan of Work.
- Maintaining a clear understanding of the current legislation, regulations and standards.
- Maintaining suitable knowledge of sector specific regulations and legislation.

##### **How to Apply**

If you’re interested in joining our team, please submit your CV, portfolio and a cover letter to [careers@adp-architecture.com](mailto:careers@adp-architecture.com) with ‘Part 2 Edinburgh’ in the subject line. Attachments should be in PDF format and no larger than 5MB in size.

title: Recruitment Lead
description:
### Unifrog’s mission

We’re on a mission to level the playing field when it comes to young people finding and applying for their next step after school. We're achieving this by bringing all the available information into one single, impartial, user-friendly platform that helps students to make the best choices, and submit the strongest applications. We also empower teachers and counsellors to manage the progression process effectively.

Our outlook is global - we work with schools and universities all over the world, from the US to New Zealand, and from Italy to Hong Kong. We want to make it so that young people can compare every opportunity taught in English, wherever it is in the world, and have all the support they need to make successful applications.

We have a clear social purpose, and we’re hugely ambitious. We already work with over half of UK secondary schools, and more than a thousand international schools. We are growing rapidly in terms of the number of our customers, in terms of how much they use our platform, and in terms of the breadth of products we offer (check out this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J7S3wWFKm-o) to hear more about the Unifrog platform).

Our team is at the heart of our business and it is integral to our success. We work hard to foster a culture of openness, happiness and innovation, and we commit to helping every individual learn and grow so that they can reach their full potential. We want to hire talented people, whatever their background. If you are excited by our mission and are ready to work hard, please don’t hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We believe in the power of diversity. If you are from an ethnic minority background, we would like to strongly encourage you to apply. In advance of applying if you have any questions about working at Unifrog, please contact [recruitment@unifrog.org](mailto:recruitment@unifrog.org).

### People and culture at Unifrog

You’ll be joining Unifrog at an exciting time. We now have 2 million students using the platform each year, we work with over 5,000 schools, universities, and employers, and we have 120 people on the team. We’re super proud of the supportive culture we’ve fostered over that time.

As a People team, we support that culture by: trusting our team; removing roadblocks and encouraging autonomy; making an effort to understand everyone’s different wants and needs and using that information to tailor what we offer; and caring about each team member while creating processes that allow them to work at their best. If this fits with your view of what a People team should do, we’d love to hear from you.

### What you’ll do

As Recruitment Lead, your key role is to attract and appoint a diverse range of outstanding applicants. To that end, you’ll continue to develop our recruitment ethos: to set candidates up for success through a fair and inclusive process, while testing skills and capability over experience. As a small team, each People team member also has the opportunity to be involved in other areas beyond their core role. This role has a specific focus on developing and maintaining our excellent Unifrog perks and benefits and, alongside support from the team, providing a fantastic experience at our office HQ in Hoxton, London.

Your main responsibilities:

**Recruitment (~70% of the role, varying week to week)**

- Lead recruitment end-to-end, ensuring a high-quality, fair, and consistent candidate experience.


- Work with hiring managers to design job descriptions, interview processes, and scoring guidelines.


- Post our live roles on the relevant job boards (e.g. Escape the City, LinkedIn).

- Manage our Applicant Tracking System (ATS), review applications, update candidates, and schedule interviews. We’re in the process of switching our ATS, and you’ll play a leading role in setting up and developing this.


- Lead interview panels and support with phone interviews and tasks.


- Manage offers, including offer calls and contracts.


- Write regular whole-company updates to keep the team informed about new joiners and new roles, alongside reminders about key Unifrog updates.


- Lead on projects to improve recruitment, including creating guidance on [AI use in recruitment](https://www.unifrog.org/blog/ai-and-recruitment-at-unifrog), interview best practice, and the [candidate hub](https://www.unifrog.org/jobs#candidate-hub).

- Manage the visa application process and provide support to employees requiring visa sponsorship.

- Monitor and manage our Recruitment inbox, being the first point of contact for queries from candidates.


- Work with the rest of the People team on the onboarding process, which is currently led by our People Assistant.


**Unifrog perks and benefits (~20% of the role)**

- Gather team feedback and data about current and potential new benefits.

- Use this information to improve existing benefits and introduce new ones.


- Manage the rollout of new benefits. Recent examples include interest-free loans from Unifrog and a co-working allowance for all remote team members.


- Administer current benefits, such as SimplyHealth, life insurance, and health insurance for our Hong Kong office.


**Office support (~10% of the role)**

- With support from the team, take the lead on organising our modest London office space, making sure that the layout supports team needs and wellbeing.

- Re-stock and check our equipment, tech, and supplies.


- Be a point of contact for external staff (e.g. building managers) for all our offices, in London, Edinburgh, and Hong Kong.


**Equity, diversity, and inclusion (EDI)**

At Unifrog, everyone is responsible for creating an equitable and inclusive place to work. In addition, each person on the People team also has specific EDI responsibilities which link to their role, and is given training and coaching to support them with this.

- Make sure our recruitment processes are equitable and inclusive. E.g. create and uphold guidelines to support consistency during interview panels; review our job descriptions to make sure they’re inclusive, accessible, and reflective of the role and skills needed.

- Review anonymised demographic data from our candidate pool to understand trends and improve our processes.


### Working together

You’ll work closely with our current People team, including our two People Leads, People Assistant, Internal Communications and Events Lead, Head of People Operations, and People and Operations Director.

You’ll have regular contact with people across all of our teams. You’ll need to build great professional relationships with team members to deliver an excellent recruitment process.

You’ll be line-managed by the People and Operations Director.

### What we’re looking for

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to build great professional relationships.

- Excellent attention to detail, especially when creating JDs or rolling out new benefits.

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

- Ability to coach, challenge, and guide team members involved in hiring.

- Ability to convert hiring data into actionable insights.

- Experience of managing multiple and competing priorities.

- Experience of using an Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and ideally designing recruitment processes (including application and interview questions, and scoring guidelines).

- Ability to work both as part of a team and independently, and happy to ask for support when it’s needed.

- Strong reflection skills and a proactive attitude, demonstrating the ability to learn and adjust based on feedback. For example, moving beyond active job applicants to proactively identify talent pools and changing our approach based on what works.


### Benefits

On [our jobs page](http://www.unifrog.org/jobs) you’ll find a full list of the benefits we offer our team. Here’s a snapshot:

- **Mission focused** Join one of [Escape the City’s top 1% employers](https://app.escapethecity.org/top-1-percent-employer) and help transform careers and destinations for students.

- **Be part of a growing company** Become part of a committed, dynamic, and growing company. We want to build our team for the long term: if you do well, we will do our best to make sure you want to stay at the company for a long time.

- **Grow individually** Professional development is important at Unifrog. You will define your own 6-month objectives and will be supported by your line manager and the rest of the team to achieve them. You will have an annual training allowance to spend on what you need to grow and progress.

- **Have impact** Influence the company’s direction: we love to promote great ideas, wherever they come from.


### Key details

- £38,000 - £42,000 per year dependent on experience (Grade B).


- Full time.


- Split your time between home and our office in Hoxton, London (a minimum of 2 days per week).


- 28 days paid holiday per year (plus bank holidays).


- Working hours are 8:30am to 4:30pm, or 9:00am to 5:00pm Monday to Thursday, and 8.30am to 4:00pm or 9:00am to 4:30pm on Friday.


- Start date: as soon as possible, though we will be flexible for the right candidates.

- We can only consider candidates who have the right to work in the UK.


### Application process

- Deadline: **10:00am (BST) on Monday 12th October 2026**.

- We may need to close applications early if we receive a lot of interest. As long as you’ve already started applying, we’ll give you 48 hours’ notice of the deadline changing - so if you’re thinking of applying, please start an application so we can keep you updated.

- Stage 1: Application form (~1 hour) ✍️

- Visit our website to upload your CV and complete the questions below. Please note that we do not review CVs at this stage of the application process, so please be as specific as possible about your experience.

- With reference to examples of your recent experience, what would make you an excellent candidate for this role? (250 words)

- Tell us about a time you improved a recruitment or People process using feedback or data. What changed? (250 words)

- Tell us about a time you disagreed with a hiring manager about a recruitment decision. How did you reach a resolution? (250 words)

- Stage 2: Phone interview (15 minutes) 📲

- Stage 3: Video call interview (1 hour) 🖥️

- Standard Q&A from a panel of three, including questions about your experiences and how these relate to the role, and scenario questions based on common situations you might face (plus time for your questions).

- Phone interviews will be held throughout the application window. Video call interviews will be held **w/c 19th October 2026**.

- Your answers are an opportunity to let us know more about your motivations and experience. While we understand that candidates might want to use AI to improve parts of their application, we strongly encourage you to write your answers independently.


- Please note, we compare all answers to an AI generated answer. Where we suspect AI has been used to write the majority of the answer, this will be taken into consideration when scoring. You can find more details and our [full policy on AI in applications here](https://www.unifrog.org/blog/249).


**Inclusion and diversity at Unifrog**

- **How we communicate**

- Within the company we try to foster a culture of innovation, and a happy working environment, both because this is the right thing to do, and because we think this results in the most effective team. To this end we believe in open communication, celebrating successes, supporting each other, not being afraid to be wrong or to fail, and promoting good ideas wherever they come from.

- **Embedded EDI**

- As a platform that supports teachers and students from a huge variety of backgrounds it’s important that our team and leadership reflects this diversity. This is something we are actively working towards and prioritising. We embed diversity, equity and inclusion across everything we do, continually evaluating policies and practices to make sure they are inclusive and equitable.

- To make sure everyone’s voice is heard and people have the opportunities to learn to be better allies in the workplace, we encourage the team to share what they’re celebrating, facilitate training and group discussions, and seek regular feedback about what more the company could do to help people feel included.

- **Recruitment processes**

- To ensure that our recruitment process is consistent and fair, we anonymise your application and therefore do not see your name, personal, educational or professional background. We also randomise the order of responses so that it’s less likely that a candidate is advantaged or disadvantaged by where their answers appear compared to other candidates.

title: Senior Creative Producer
description:
Senior Creative Producer

Our Company

Empowering everyone to create.

Adobe empowers everyone, everywhere to imagine, create, and bring any digital experience to life. From creators and students to small businesses, global enterprises, and nonprofit organizations, customers choose Adobe products to create, collaborate, grow their businesses, and build remarkable experiences.

We're looking for curious, ambitious makers who want to help define world-class creativity in this new era. We believe the craft is more essential than ever while AI should help people create more, explore more, and unlock new possibilities while keeping creators at the center of the creative process.

Adobe is amplifying human ingenuity with AI.

Our Team

Adobe Creative is Adobe’s in-house brand-creative engine, developing the ideas, campaigns, and assets that power Adobe’s brand and business. We are part of the broader Content & Creative (“C&C”) organization. We work alongside Adobe Content, which focuses on publishing and audience development through owned, earned, and partner channels; an Experiences team, which oversees Adobe’s real-world moments; and shared service teams spanning Video, Talent, Partnerships, and Production.

Together, C&C commissions and produces work while equipping teams across Adobe’s Global Marketing Organization and the company to create, adapt, and distribute high-quality work with greater speed and consistency.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Creative Producer who will manage large scale campaigns across a pod, overseeing multiple workstreams and coordinate with a wide team of internal collaborators.

The ideal candidate has experience managing complex creative campaigns and high volume work. They are energized by improving the production workflow itself, not just the individual outputs.

You will partner closely with the Director of Production and Executive Producer on capacity planning, vendor governance, and workflow architecture across Adobe's portfolio, translating Adobe Creative production standards into practice for your team.

What You’ll Do

  • Work inside a fast-paced team, leading all aspects of the creation of assets that will launch at a global scale.

  • Own creative campaign lifecycle from end to end: project intake, creating timelines, creative reviews and approvals, and cross-functional coordination across every stage of creative development.

  • Support the creative team by prioritizing tasks, tracking feedback, and mitigating roadblocks to keep the team moving.

  • Act as the bridge between internal teams and agencies, communicating details clearly throughout the production process so everyone stays aligned from briefing to delivery.

title: Lead Software Engineer - Umbraco
description:
Location:UK wide - hybrid

Salary:£55,000-£62,000

### About the role

As Lead Engineer you will provide senior technical leadership on our Umbraco platforms, working alongside engineers, QA analysts and project managers to deliver high quality work on time and to budget.

We are looking for genuine Umbraco expertise rather than broad CMS familiarity: someone who knows the platform properly, has taken sites through major version upgrades, understands Umbraco Cloud and its constraints, and can make architectural decisions that hold up over the life of a long-term retainer.

You will join an existing Umbraco practice and work as part of a small group of technical leads, sharing responsibility for standards, architectural direction and the technical health of the platforms we look after. Our Umbraco clients are charities, non-profits and membership organisations, and the platforms we build for them carry donation journeys, supporter data and services people rely on. Much of the work is continuous improvement on established platforms rather than greenfield build, which means the technical decisions you make will be lived with for years by the teams that follow you.

You will lead architecture and technical planning on the projects you are responsible for, uphold quality through code review and standards, and develop the engineers around you. This role does not carry line management or resourcing responsibility, that sits with the Engineering Manager. Your focus is technical leadership and delivery quality.

#### **Key responsibilities**

##### **You provide senior technical leadership on the Umbraco platforms you are responsible for**

- You are a senior technical authority on Umbraco, setting and upholding standards for how we build, extend and maintain client platforms.
- You make architectural decisions appropriate to the client's budget, team and long-term maintenance capability, not to the most interesting technical option available.
- You plan and lead major Umbraco version upgrades, assessing package and integration compatibility before committing to a path.
- You maintain a clear view of the technical health of the platforms you support, and surface risk before it becomes a problem.
- You make sensible decisions about hosting, environments and deployment on Umbraco Cloud and equivalent platforms.
- You contribute to shared Umbraco standards and practice across the business, working with other technical leads rather than in isolation.

##### **You define the technical approach for solutions and plan their delivery**

- You consult with principal engineers and contribute to high level architecture during the Foundations phase of a project, specifying which technologies will be used and how they connect together.
- You provide broad plans for technical delivery, identifying the main themes, their approximate sizes, levels of risk and the order they will be delivered in.
- You produce estimates that state clearly what is in scope, what is out of scope and what assumptions the numbers rest on.
- You manage client expectations about the process of agile delivery and what they should expect to see at the end of each sprint.

##### **You lead the delivery of high quality software on time and to budget**

- You ensure your project team members are fully engaged and participating in all aspects of the project during evolutionary development.
- You ensure the ceremonies of your agile project happen at the right time with the right people present, including stand-ups, backlog refinement, timebox planning, code reviews and retrospectives.
- You ensure your team delivers the work they have committed to by the agreed deadline.
- You uphold quality through code review, and hold the line on standards when delivery pressure argues against it.
- You apply particular rigour to anything touching donation journeys, payment integrations or supporter data, where the cost of a defect is measured in lost income and lost trust.
- You ensure your team collaborates well at all times, that problems are discussed early and raised to the project lead and client as necessary.

##### **You manage the technical and support relationships with your clients**

- You are the senior technical point of contact for the clients you support, able to explain technical decisions and constraints to non-technical stakeholders clearly.
- You lead the technical response when things go wrong on your accounts, establishing what has happened and directing the fix.
- You ensure your clients are supported by the appropriate team members, working with engineering managers so the right profile of engineer is available.
- You ensure the smooth operation of support boards, unblocking technical team members and resolving issues.
- You provide the technical continuity that long-term retainer clients depend on, holding the context that would otherwise be lost between people.

##### **You support the growth of the engineering team and promote quality software engineering**

- You develop the engineers around you, particularly those growing their Umbraco capability, through pairing, review and structured mentorship.
- You show passion for keeping on top of current tools, standards and trends, including the Umbraco roadmap and AI-assisted engineering practice.
- You actively contribute ideas for the growth of the engineering team.
- You collaborate with principal engineers and the engineering leadership to deliver on departmental goals.
- You produce relevant content on software engineering and agile delivery to raise the profile of the department.

### About you

#### **Professional knowledge and experience**

- **Deep Umbraco expertise.** Extensive hands-on experience building, extending and maintaining Umbraco platforms in production, including recent major versions. This is the defining requirement of the role.
- **Strong .NET and C# capability.** Confident writing clean, maintainable, object-oriented code and reviewing the work of others to the same standard.
- **Upgrade and migration experience.** Proven experience planning and delivering major Umbraco version upgrades, including assessing package compatibility and managing risk on live sites.
- **Long-term platform ownership**. Experience maintaining and evolving established platforms over years rather than delivering and moving on, with an understanding of how technical debt accumulates and how to manage it down.
- **Integrations and APIs.** Proficiency designing and implementing APIs and integrations within complex digital ecosystems, including CRM, payment and marketing platforms.
- **Database and data management.** Strong expertise in database design and efficient querying in the context of web applications.
- **Cloud and deployment.** Practical experience with cloud platforms and managed hosting, particularly Azure and Umbraco Cloud, and with CI/CD pipelines and environment management.
- **Front-end capability.** Adept at building responsive, accessible interfaces, with a component-based approach that supports consistency and reuse.
- **Accessibility.** Deep commitment to and experience of building to WCAG standards, which matters particularly for the diverse audiences our charity clients serve.
- **Security.** Proven ability to apply security best practice throughout the development lifecycle, safeguarding supporter and donor data.

- **Technical leadership.** Proven leadership in agile delivery, with a focus on quality outcomes and collaborative teams. Excels at mentorship and technical direction without line management responsibility.

- **Client-facing confidence.** Exceptional problem solving and the ability to manage technical client relationships directly.


#### **Technical skills**

##### **Essential**

- Deep, demonstrable Umbraco expertise across recent major versions, including content modelling, custom development and package ecosystem
- Strong .NET and C#, with a solid grasp of modern .NET practice
- Umbraco Cloud, or equivalent managed hosting experience, including environment strategy and deployment workflow
- Major version upgrade planning and delivery on live platforms
- API design and consumption, REST and GraphQL, including third-party integrations
- SQL Server and efficient data querying in a web application context
- Modern front-end development, including component-based approaches and responsive UI
- Accessibility standards and practice, WCAG 2.2 and above
- Security by design, particularly around personal data and payment journeys
- Git, branching strategy, code review and CI/CD pipelines

##### **Desirable**

- Azure services, particularly Functions, App Services and supporting infrastructure
- Headless or decoupled Umbraco, and API-first delivery
- Modern front-end frameworks such as React or Next.js
- Experience with donation or payment platforms
- Working knowledge of other CMS platforms, particularly Drupal and Wordpress
- AI-assisted engineering practice or agentic tooling
- Experience in the charity, non-profit or membership sector

#### **Behaviours**

- You are someone the team turns to on Umbraco questions, and you answer in a way that leaves them more capable rather than more dependent.
- You manage challenging situations effectively and defuse issues before they escalate.
- You guide and support other team members, particularly those less experienced, and are helpful in onboarding new starters.
- You proactively seek and give timely, actionable feedback that improves the contribution of those around you.
- You escalate problems that have a wider scope than your team, and support them through to a conclusion.
- You work confidently and persist when faced with uncertainty, pulling in support from around the company where needed.
- You promote good practice and current trends in your discipline, deepening the knowledge of those around you.
- You lead teams and clients confidently and hold relationships with important stakeholders.
- You influence the strategic direction of projects and are comfortable on large, complex work.
- You are a trusted problem solver, capable of leading the resolution of incidents relating to your area of expertise.
- You hold the line on quality when delivery pressure argues against it, and can explain why in terms a client understands.
- You support our inclusive environment and ESG commitments, and embody Manifesto's values.

### About us

#### **manifesto**

We are the digital experience agency for changemakers. We are committed to delivering purposeful and positive  impact for people, planet and society, in restless pursuit of a better world.

We take pride in creating award-winning digital experiences, products and services that are measurably ethical,  inclusive, accessible, sustainable and joyful.

Our changemaker clients include UNICEF UK, Breast Cancer Now, Trussell, Woodgreen, The Royal Academy of Arts, Zoological Society London, Historic Environment Scotland and Fauna & Flora.

Part of the TPXimpact group - a Certified B Corporation™, we are a team of 130 digital product leaders, creative designers, user experience designers, engagement specialists, software engineers and experience strategists.

#### **TPXimpact**

TPXimpact is a digital transformation company, and Certified B Corporation™, on a mission to build a future where people, places and the planet are supported to thrive. Combining vast expertise in human-centred design, data, experience and technology, we help the public, private and third sectors with their digital transformation journey, delivering high quality solutions that improve services, experiences and outcomes. We’re passionate people who work in close collaboration with our clients to create sustainable solutions ready for an ever-evolving world.

**We are committed to having a positive impact on the clients and the communities we serve. We actively encourage applications from all genders, ethnicities, disabled people, members of the LGBTQIA+ community, and those from lower socio-economic backgrounds.**

**Don’t meet 100% of the criteria? We still want to hear from you. Please let us know if you require any adjustments during the recruitment process.**

title: Sr. Applied AI Engineer
description:
The Opportunity

The GTM Agentic AI Operations team is leading the shift to an Agentic operating model for Adobe GTM and Sales. This function is the orchestration layer that operationalizes strategy into end to end Agentic AI workflows that compress planning cycles from months to weeks, launch more personalized campaigns across every route to market, and streamline manual tasks so sellers can focus on talking to customers. We are building an always-on Agentic operating layer that connects strategy, data, and frontline execution for the Digital Media business.

The Applied AI Engineering Pillar

As a Sr. Applied AI Engineer you will drive efficiency and excellence in sales operations building scalable and robust AI agents and workflows to streamline the sales cycle. You will partner with Sales ops, Campaign specialists, Product managers, and Data/Analytics engineers to solve problems and remove bottlenecks using the latest tech in AI and agents.

  • Build, tune, and refine AI agents to drive the digitization and streamlining of sales operational tasks
