description:
Adobe's Reliability Engineering team is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to help build and operate large-scale products like Adobe Document Cloud. Adobe Document Cloud is the complete solution for creating, editing, sharing, signing, and managing documents and PDFs across desktop, web, and mobile. Bringing together Adobe Acrobat, Acrobat Sign, and a suite of cloud-based PDF and document services, Document Cloud lets people and organizations turn manual, paper-based processes into fast, secure, connected digital workflows — from any device, anywhere.


We are passionate about what we do and are looking for experienced, motivated people to join a hardworking team. We believe in diversity and encourage all to apply. You have a track record as a Senior Site Reliability Engineer or eager to build a career in large-scale SaaS businesses, and a strong desire to implement initiatives and systems to improve reliability, availability, security, and privacy. You are familiar with DevOps and other agile methods. You thrive solving problems in real-time under pressure.

  • Build amazing things that matter. You'll work on a critical growth initiative, solving problems for engineers and customers.
  • Grow. Sharpen your skills, use innovative technology, and collaborate with your peers.
  • Collaborate. You'll love working in an environment that values collaboration.

What You'll Do

  • Ensure the highest level of uptime and Quality of Service (QoS) to Adobe's customers through operational excellence
  • Help with defining service level objectives (SLOs) and service level indicators (SLIs) to represent and measure service quality
  • Embed with product teams (physically and/or virtually) to develop tight-knit collaboration/partnership
  • Identify areas to improve service resiliency through techniques such as performance/load testing, code review, and Chaos engineering
  • Support and maintain globally distributed multi-cloud (public and/or private) environments including AWS and Azure
  • Automate common, repeatable tasks at a large scale to reduce toil
  • Apply AI/ML and generative-AI techniques to reliability engineering — anomaly detection, predictive alerting, automated root-cause analysis, and log/metric correlation — and build AI-enabled automation and agents that reduce toil and accelerate incident response
  • Solve performance and stability issues using a wide variety of tools
  • Participate in an on-call rotation as required
  • Determine the root cause for all production level incidents and write corresponding high-quality RCA reports
  • Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge across teams; may serve as a technical lead on reliability initiatives
  • Promote the DevOps/SRE mentality

  • 5-7 years of experience in SRE or related field
  • Deep understanding of both software engineering and technical operations
  • Expertise with container orchestration engines such as Kubernetes (EKS, AKS) and Elastic Cloud on Kubernetes (ECK)

  • Programming skills, particularly with Python, Java, Ruby, various scripting languages
  • AI/ML skills for modern SRE, including:
    • Hands-on experience with AIOps — applying machine learning to observability, alerting, and automated remediation
    • Experience using AI coding assistants such as Claude and Claude Code, and building AI agents to automate runbooks, ChatOps, incident response, and other operational workflows

Connecticut State Community College (CT State) was launched on July 1, 2023, through the consolidation of Connecticut’s 12 community colleges. For more information about CT State Community College and the campus please visit Home - CT State

Laboratory Assistants collaborate with faculty and program staff to promote student success in a structured and supportive learning environment.

The Laboratory Assistant is also involved in the setup, maintenance, and operation of lab equipment and materials, including preparing lab stations, organizing supplies, and ensuring a safe laboratory environment for student use.

  • Supervising student lab assistants employed by the department by providing training and work direction
  • Dispose of all chemical waste, per Chemical Hygiene Plan and Department of Public Health.
  • Ability to lift 30+ pounds

Associate’s degree in a related field

title: Senior Data Privacy Engineer(MJ003967)
description:
Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.

Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.

We have six Customer Service Centres for Trip.com , established in Japan, Korea, the UK, Thailand, Malaysia, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 35 different languages.

This role sits within the Group's Information Security department, where Europe is one of the regions under the highest regulatory pressure globally. As the local privacy compliance capabilities in Europe are still being developed, this position will serve as a key bridge between the European team and the headquarters, focused on translating regulatory requirements into executable compliance solutions.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

  • Conduct privacy intelligence research and risk analysis, working with local legal teams to track European privacy regulatory developments, identify potential compliance risks, and recommend improvements.
  • Lead European compliance programmes requiring close coordination with HQ Product and Engineering teams, focusing on GDPR implementation and technical solutions, such as DSR systems and GDPR compliance transformation.
  • Translate European legal requirements into clear technical requirements that HQ teams can understand and implement.
  • Lead the Euro privacy certification project, coordinate external audit processes, and drive the ongoing operation of the privacy management system within the GDPR framework.
  • Support GDPR-related data subject complaints and data subject rights (DSR) requests, ensuring timely and compliant resolution.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration across time zones and languages, ensuring compliance requirements are implemented at a system level.
  • Provide day-to-day compliance guidance, including risk assessments, vendor reviews, and cross-border data transfer assessments for European business units.

What you'll Need to Succeed:

  • 5+ years of experience in data privacy or compliance.
  • Strong understanding of GDPR fundamentals, including DSRs, cross-border data transfers and DPIAs.
  • Solid experience in GDPR implementation or privacy solution design.
  • Experience collaborating with Product and Engineering teams, with the ability to translate legal requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • Willingness to be based in Europe long term.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Nice to Have:

  • CIPP/E or CIPM certification.
  • Familiarity with certification frameworks such as Europrivacy, ISO 27001 and ISO 27701.
  • Hands-on experience developing compliance programmes within a multinational organisation.

Why Trip.com Group

As a world leading company in travel industry, we provide a platform for our talent to unleash their power, make a global impact, and achieve a successful career. As an international team, we're dedicated to create a space where open communication and mutual respect is encouraged. At Trip.com Group, we are here to support you in and out of the workplace, enabling you to explore and embrace more possibilities and pursue a dream life.

What’s more?

title: Graphics Designer/Art Director 4
description:
Senior Multidisciplinary Designer

Adobe Creative

Our Company

Empowering everyone to create.

Adobe empowers everyone, everywhere to imagine, create and bring digital experiences to life. From creators and students to small businesses, global enterprises and nonprofit organizations, customers choose Adobe products to create, collaborate, grow, and build remarkable experiences.

We are looking for curious, ambitious makers who want to help define world-class creativity in this new era. We believe the craft is more essential than ever while AI should help people create more, explore more, and unlock new possibilities while keeping creators at the center of the creative process.

Adobe is amplifying human ingenuity with AI.

Our Team

Adobe Creative is Adobe’s in-house brand-creative engine, developing the ideas, campaigns, and assets that power Adobe’s brand and business. We are part of the broader Content & Creative (“C&C”) organization. We work alongside Adobe Content, which focuses on publishing and audience development through owned, earned, and partner channels; an Experiences team, which oversees Adobe’s real-world moments; and shared service teams spanning Video, Talent, Partnerships, and Production.

Together, C&C commissions and produces work while equipping teams across Adobe’s Global Marketing Organization and the company to create, adapt, and distribute high-quality work with greater speed and consistency.

The Opportunity

Adobe makes the tools the world uses to create. Our own design work should set the standard for what those tools make possible. Adobe Creative is looking for an exceptional Senior Multidisciplinary Designer to create beautifully crafted, culturally relevant work across Adobe Creative’s output.

You will work across campaigns, multi-platform design, product storytelling, motion and live experiences, moving confidently between early visual exploration, design development and polished final execution.

Working alongside Design leaders, Creative Directors, Art Directors, Copywriters, Strategists and Product partners, you will help turn ideas into distinctive visual expressions that feel recognizably Adobe without becoming repetitive or formulaic.

You will combine exceptional design craft with curiosity for emerging technology. You will use Creative Cloud, Firefly and AI-enabled workflows to explore more widely, prototype more quickly and make stronger work without compromising taste, originality or human judgment.

You are a maker first. You care deeply about typography, image-making, composition, and the details that make an idea feel fully resolved.

What You’ll Do

Design Across the Work

  • Create high-quality design across campaigns, multi-platform design, product storytelling, and live experiences.

  • Develop work from early concept and visual exploration through design development and final execution.

  • Apply exceptional craft across typography, image-making, layout, composition and art direction.

  • Work across high-velocity everyday output and highly crafted flagship work.

  • Adapt strong ideas across channels and formats without losing their intelligence or visual impact.

  • Create work that feels connected and recognizably Adobe while remaining fresh, distinctive and culturally relevant.

Turn Ideas into Visual Worlds

  • Partner with Creative Directors, Design Directors and Art Directors to develop visual territories and creative systems.

  • Translate campaign and creative ideas into compelling art direction and design expression.

  • Collaborate with Copywriters to develop visual and verbal ideas as one connected creative system.

  • Create mood boards, prototypes, and design studies that help teams explore and align early.

  • Know when to explore broadly and when to refine toward a clear, production-ready solution.

  • Bring a strong visual point of view while remaining open to collaboration and critique.

Build Scalable Creative Systems

  • Create modular frameworks, templates and reusable design tools that support speed without losing craft.

  • Help translate Adobe’s brand system into distinctive creative expression across real work.

  • Test how design ideas perform across channels, formats and audience needs.

  • Find opportunities to improve tools and workflows based on real creative applications.

  • Balance systematic thinking with experimentation, surprise and flexibility.

  • Document design thinking clearly so others can apply it effectively.

Advance AI-Native Design

  • Use Creative Cloud, Firefly and emerging generative tools throughout concepting, prototyping and production.

  • Use AI-enabled workflows to expand visual exploration and accelerate iteration without lowering the standard.

  • Apply human judgment, taste and craft to all AI-assisted work.

  • Help define where AI can support scale and where human authorship and intervention remain essential.

  • Test emerging Adobe capabilities through real creative work and share useful feedback with Product teams.

  • Apply responsible AI practices, including provenance, creator rights and Content Credentials.

Collaborate and Deliver

  • Work closely with Creative Directors, Art Directors, Copywriters, Motion Designers, Strategists, Producers, Product and Product Marketing.

  • Present work clearly, explain design decisions, and respond constructively to feedback.

  • Partner with Production to carry ideas into execution while protecting their creative intent.

  • Collaborate with photographers, illustrators, artists, studios, and specialist partners when required.

  • Maintain a high design standard through fast timelines, multiple workstreams, and changing priorities.

  • Take ownership of your work while contributing generously to the ideas and development of the wider team.

What You Need to Succeed

  • You consider yourself a maker first. AI fluency is how you work, not a skill you are developing.

  • 6+ years of experience in design, art direction, or multidisciplinary creative practice.

  • A standout portfolio demonstrating exceptional design craft across multi-platform campaigns and product storytelling.

  • Deep expertise in typography, layout, image-making, and visual composition.

  • Strong fluency across digital, motion, and emerging design practices.

  • Strong conceptual thinking and the ability to carry an idea from exploration through final execution.

  • Experience working across both high-velocity creative and highly crafted flagship work.

  • Experience applying brand systems in ways that feel distinctive and alive.

  • Strong systems thinking and experience creating modular frameworks, templates or reusable creative tools.

  • Fluency with Adobe Creative Cloud, Firefly and AI-enabled visual workflows.

  • A clear perspective on how generative AI changes visual exploration, authorship and production.

  • Experience working within multidisciplinary teams and collaborating with Copy, Motion, Strategy and Production.

  • Strong presentation, communication, and collaboration skills.

  • A genuine and current understanding of culture, design, art, technology and emerging visual practices.

  • The ability to balance speed, experimentation, and craft.

  • A maker attitude, curiosity and a commitment to continuously improving the work.


About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.


Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

title: Senior / Staff Full-stack Engineer
description:
About Electricity Maps

Electricity Maps is a VC-backed climate and energy tech start-up building the world's most comprehensive electricity data platform. We provide real-time, historical, and forecasted data on electricity systems worldwide - covering generation mix, electricity prices, carbon intensity, and renewable share.

Our data powers decisions across sustainability and energy markets: from companies like Google and Cisco optimising compute workloads and reporting emissions, to energy market participants using our forecasts to inform trading strategies and asset optimisation. We're a small, technical team based in Copenhagen, working at the intersection of energy, AI, climate change, and data.

About the role

You’ll work in the product team responsible for exposing our data to the world and you will help people and companies consume our data: Via our API, our map or whatever makes sense next.

We believe in engineers owning product decisions. Engineers scope the problem, build it and evolve it based on feedback from customers, colleagues and users. Those decisions usually aren't mapped out before you start on them so you're figuring out the shape of the problem and the best solution as you unpack it.

You’ll be part of a small engineering team with 3 other full-stack engineers. No two days look the same. Most of your energy goes into building and figuring out solutions, with bug fixes and other tasks mixed in.

What you'll do

  • Build and ship across the stack (we’re using TypeScript for 95% of the product surface).

  • Own the systems that touch customers directly, from how we onboard, guide and support them to how we serve data in the API they integrate with.

  • Decide what to build in collaboration with leadership, sales, marketing and data teams.

  • Care about your solutions being actually used and understand what matters to our users: dig deeper in analytics, join commercial conversations, be curious.

  • Push on new ways customers can interact with our data. Maybe new API capabilities, new functionality in the map or something else.

  • Dig into bugs and edge cases.

What you won't do

  • Ship something and never find out if anyone uses it.

  • Wait around for permission to fix something you can see is broken.

  • Spend more time in alignment meetings than building.

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience shipping full-stack features in production and scaling them.

  • Early-stage tech company / product experience.

  • Product mindset, meaning that you build with the user in mind and have strong, defensible opinions on what "good" looks like; in code, in product, in process.

  • Comfortable with data-heavy products, where edge cases and correctness can play a big part.

  • Founder mentality, meaning that you are excited about building new products and taking them from an early stage to something users rely on. You spend time across the organization to deepen your knowledge and learn how users interact with the product to build things that are used.

Our stack

Relevant to this role: TypeScript, Node.js, React, GCP. The ideal candidate has worked in or close to these systems.

The details

Location: Copenhagen (office first, with flexibility)

Type: Full-time

Compensation: Competitive salary + stock options

Benefits: 6 weeks vacation, health insurance, annual company offsite, lunch and snacks at the office

title: Payments & Commercial Abuse Analyst
description:
The Payments & Commercial Abuse Analyst identifies, investigates, and mitigates fraud, abuse, and monetization risks across Adobe's commerce ecosystem. Through data-driven investigations, payment risk analysis, abuse detection, and cross-functional partnerships, the team uncovers emerging threats, develops scalable mitigations, and delivers actionable intelligence that protects revenue, reduces customer friction, and strengthens trust in Adobe products and services.

Key Responsibilities & Areas of Impact - The responsibilities below represent the primary areas of focus for this role and may evolve alongside emerging risks, business priorities, and organizational needs.

  • Payments Risk & Commercial Abuse Investigations

  • Investigate complex payment fraud, monetization abuse, account misuse, and commercial abuse schemes impacting Adobe's commerce ecosystem, including unauthorized resale activity, synthetic identity abuse, payment instrument abuse, chargeback fraud, refund abuse, and the unauthorized use, distribution, or commercialization of Adobe products and services.

  • Analyze transactions, customer behaviors, payment activity, subscription usage, account relationships, and associated signals to identify suspicious patterns, assess risk exposure, determine root cause, and recommend mitigation, enforcement, or policy actions.

  • Evaluate escalations, emerging threat patterns, and high-risk activity to develop risk assessments and response recommendations.

  • Analytics, Intelligence & Detection Development

  • Utilize SQL, analytical tools, and investigative methodologies to identify trends, uncover fraud patterns, validate hypotheses, and generate actionable intelligence.

  • Translate investigative findings into scalable detection strategies, risk signals, decisioning logic, and operational controls that reduce fraud while minimizing friction for legitimate customers.

  • Partner with Data Science, Engineering, and AI teams to define abuse indicators, improve model performance, and enhance detection capabilities through investigator-driven insights and feedback loops.

  • Produce intelligence assessments, trend analyses, and strategic insights on emerging abuse patterns, monetization risks, and evolving fraud trends across Adobe's commerce ecosystem.

  • Commerce Risk Strategy & Optimization

  • Balance fraud prevention objectives with customer experience considerations when evaluating controls, policies, detection strategies, and enforcement actions.

  • Provide recommendations to strengthen payment risk controls, fraud mitigation strategies, automation opportunities, and long-term commerce risk initiatives while balancing customer experience and business objectives.

  • Collaborate with Product, Commerce, Risk, Customer Support, Trust & Safety, and Engineering teams to address emerging threats, improve platform resilience, and drive sustainable risk reduction strategies.

Qualifications & Core Competencies:

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex investigative findings, payment risk data, and abuse trends into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify patterns, assess risk, and transform complex data into meaningful insights that drive informed decision-making.

  • Experience using SQL/SPL and data analysis techniques to support investigations, validate hypotheses, identify trends, and generate actionable intelligence.

  • A naturally inquisitive and investigative mindset, with a passion for understanding how malicious actors exploit commerce systems, products, and business processes.

  • Strong understanding of payment and commerce risk concepts, including chargebacks, friendly fraud, account abuse, refund abuse, affiliate abuse, subscription fraud, identity risk, monetization abuse, and common payment ecosystem risks.

  • Experience identifying risk signals, anomalous behaviors, and abuse patterns and translating findings into scalable detection, mitigation, or enforcement strategies.

  • Creative and strategic problem-solving capabilities, including the ability to anticipate emerging risks and develop innovative, scalable solutions.

  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities and adapt quickly in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  • Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable operating with ambiguity while working independently and collaboratively across cross-functional teams.

  • Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and commitment to delivering thorough, accurate, and high-confidence investigative outcomes.

  • Experience in payments risk, commerce fraud, fraud investigations, abuse prevention, trust and safety operations, fraud analytics, cybersecurity investigations, threat intelligence, or enterprise risk management is preferred.

  • Familiarity with machine learning concepts, risk models, AI-driven abuse trends, or the application of AI and automation to fraud detection and investigative workflows is a plus.

  • Ability to balance fraud prevention objectives with customer experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes when evaluating risk mitigation strategies.

The Role

This is an AI-native fullstack engineering role building the company's human data platforms. You'll own features end-to-end, from backend services and data pipelines to the frontends our experts use every day.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
We're looking for an ambitious, self-driven Senior Backend Developer to join our engineering team. You'll work primarily with TypeScript and AWS serverless technologies, with occasional work in our React/Next.js frontend. A growing part of our platform is integrating with enterprise customers and external systems, so you'll design and own APIs and integrations that need to hold up under real-world use.

This is a high-impact role with end-to-end ownership, from requirements to a production-ready solution, and a chance to contribute meaningfully to the green transition.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Taking features from design through implementation and into production
  • Building and operating event-driven, distributed systems - async processing, retries, failure handling, idempotency
  • Designing APIs and integrations for enterprise and external systems - stable contracts, versioning, auth, error handling, backwards compatibility
  • Working in and improving our existing codebase - refactoring, automated testing, managing technical debt
  • Occasional frontend work in React/TypeScript

Your Experience

  • 3 to 5+ years of professional software development, with substantial recent experience in TypeScript/Node.js and AWS serverless or event-driven architectures
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS services - Lambda, DynamoDB, queues, event buses, API services, infrastructure as code
  • Experience with NoSQL data modelling and production data systems
  • Good understanding of authentication, authorization and application security
  • Experience operating production systems - debugging, monitoring, safely deploying changes
  • Comfortable with Git-based workflows and CI/CD
  • Some React/TypeScript experience, and willingness to make occasional frontend changes

What We Expect at Senior Level

You can independently take a feature or technical problem from requirements to a production-ready solution. You're comfortable navigating unfamiliar code, understanding the blast radius of a change, and making pragmatic calls between delivery speed, reliability and maintainability.

You think carefully about system boundaries and integration contracts, understanding that APIs used by customers and external systems need to evolve safely and behave predictably when either side fails. You understand rollback, backwards compatibility, failure modes and safe deployment for systems handling production data.

You communicate trade-offs clearly and take responsibility for the quality of what you ship.

You're comfortable using AI-assisted development tools as part of your day-to-day work, and curious about how they can improve how software is designed, built, tested and maintained - not just for code generation, but for understanding unfamiliar code, planning changes, testing, reviewing, debugging and documentation. At the same time, you apply strong engineering judgement: you treat AI-generated output as a draft to review and validate, and you remain responsible for the correctness and security of what you ship.

Nice to Have

  • Enterprise integrations - SSO/federated identity, webhooks, customer-facing APIs
  • AWS CDK or similar IaC tooling
  • DynamoDB single-table or composite-key modelling
  • IoT, connected devices, telemetry or high-volume event processing
  • Multi-tenant SaaS platforms
  • Energy tech, EV charging, batteries, solar or energy management
  • Data platforms, analytics or data lakes
  • ISO 27001 or NIS2 experience
  • Next.js

You don't need experience with every technology in our stack. We value strong fundamentals and the ability to learn unfamiliar domains fast.

What Is It Like to Work at FLEXECHARGE?

  • Our office sits in Frederiksberg - bright, comfortable, and a genuinely nice place to spend your workday
  • You're covered with pension contributions
  • Lunch is on-site, delicious, and genuinely healthy and nutritious
  • We like each other's company outside of work too, so think Friday bars, plus company team events and team buildings on a team level
  • Opportunities for individual development

Our Interview Process

Here's roughly what happens once we've had a look at your application:

  • A first conversation, about 30 minutes, you'll talk with our recruiter, get a feel for the role, ask whatever's on your mind, and we'll both get a sense of whether this is worth pursuing further
  • Time with the team - a conversation with Artur, our Head of Engineering, and Robert, our CTO
  • A technical stage - one or more interviews with the team, which may include a case exercise and follow-up discussions. These can take place remotely or at our office.
  • A conversation with Max, our CEO, alongside someone else from the team

Hiring carefully matters to us - we want to get to know you properly, and we want you to get a real feel for us too. If there's anything we can do to make the process work better for you, tell us.

We'd love to hear from you.

Location & Practical Details

This is an on-site role based in Copenhagen.

Only candidates currently located in Copenhagen, or those who clearly state in their application that they plan to relocate, will be considered.

Please note:

  • We do not offer visa sponsorship for this role
  • We do not offer relocation services

Data Privacy (GDPR)

Applications for this role are processed exclusively through The Hub (thehub.io), our recruitment platform, in accordance with their privacy policy and applicable GDPR requirements. FLEXECHARGE does not process or store candidate data in any of its own internal systems. Your data will be handled confidentially and used only for this recruitment process.

title: Salesforce and Integration Administrator
description:
**Why Join JVS?**

JVS is a nonprofit working to close opportunity gaps in employment by supporting jobseekers with the skills and confidence to secure quality careers with family-sustaining wages. Grounded in core values of repairing the world and focused on helping our program participants achieve economic mobility, we believe everyone deserves access to training and the chance for a good job. JVS develops training programs in close partnership with employers in high growth sectors, offering high quality jobs.

Building on decades of experience and success, JVS is a data-driven organization that takes a whole systems approach to addressing employment and economic equity. Through our direct service programs, employer engagement and policy change, JVS is working toward a future where everyone has access to quality education and training programs that lead to high quality employment and economic mobility.

**Job Summary**

The Salesforce and Integration Administrator is responsible for the administration, security, optimization, and continuous improvement of the organization's Salesforce platform. Working in conjunction with the Director of Technology and the Evaluation and Impact team, this role ensures Salesforce effectively supports program delivery, participant services, reporting, and organizational decision-making.

The position manages Salesforce user access and security, business process automation, data integrity, and integration between Salesforce and other enterprise systems. A key function of this role is ensuring that JVS's data infrastructure supports the organization's Evidence-Building Roadmap (EBR) including data system refinement, real-time reporting, and data quality protocols that enable rigorous internal evaluation and, ultimately, external evaluation readiness. This role collaborates closely with program, evaluation and impact, operations, finance, and technology teams to enhance system functionality, improve operational efficiency, and support organizational technology initiatives.

This role reports to the Director of Technology, with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the Director of Evaluation and Impact.

**Responsibilities**

**Salesforce Administration, Security & Governance**

- Serve as the primary Salesforce administrator, managing system configuration, customization, maintenance, security, and ongoing optimization.


- Create and maintain Salesforce components including custom objects, fields, record types, validation rules, flows, reports, dashboards, profiles, permission sets, and role hierarchies.


- Manage user provisioning, access controls, security settings, and periodic access reviews.


- Monitor platform performance, user adoption, and system health while maintaining documentation, governance standards, and best practices.


- Work closely with the Director of Technology to support platform enhancements and technology initiatives.


- Work closely with the Director of Evaluation and Impact and the Manager of Data Systems and Analytics to ensure Salesforce configuration and data architecture align with program reporting needs and evaluation frameworks.


**Integration & Automation**

- Lead and support integration between Salesforce and third-party applications, including participant portals, LMS platforms, financial systems, and other enterprise applications.


- Support API-based integrations, data synchronization, and data exchange processes while maintaining integration documentation.


- Design and maintain Salesforce Flows and automation solutions that improve efficiency, streamline business processes, and support AI and workflow optimization initiatives.


- Collaborate with internal teams, consultants, and vendors to implement, troubleshoot, and enhance integrations and automation solutions.


**Data Management, Reporting & Analytics**

- Ensure the accuracy, integrity, quality, and security of Salesforce data, serving as the primary owner of data quality standards and validation protocols.


- Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and data visualizations that support program management, operational decision-making, and funder reporting.


- Support data migration, data validation, data cleansing, and reporting initiatives, including preparation of analysis-ready datasets for use by the Evaluation & Impact team and external research partners.


- Support the development and execution of data quality and quality assurance protocols — including automated validation, data audits, and error reporting — to meet program and evaluation needs


- Contribute to the codification and finalization of real-time data reporting infrastructure, including dashboards that provide program staff with actionable, up-to-date outcome data


- Respond to data and reporting requests from program, development, finance, and leadership teams with accuracy and timeliness.


- Make recommendations to improve data collection practices, reporting processes, and data integrity across the organization.


**User Support, Training & Vendor Coordination**

- Serve as the primary point of contact for Salesforce-related support requests, troubleshooting, and user assistance.


- Develop training materials, conduct user training, and promote Salesforce best practices and adoption.


- Work with consultants, software vendors, and implementation partners on system enhancements, upgrades, and projects.


- Coordinate vendor relationships and support technology initiatives that improve organizational efficiency and service delivery.


**Qualifications**

**Minimum Qualifications**

- Salesforce Administrator Certification or equivalent hands-on Salesforce Administrator experience.


- 5–7 years of Salesforce administration experience, including configuration, security, integrations, automation, reporting, and user support.


- Experience managing Salesforce user access, governance, and security.


- Experience supporting integrations using APIs, middleware platforms, or integration tools.


- Experience with data migration, data quality management, and system implementation projects.


- Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into Salesforce solutions.


- Demonstrated experience developing reports, dashboards, and data visualizations that support program or organizational decision-making


- Experience managing Salesforce data quality, including validation rules, data audits, and data governance practices.


- Experience collaborating with program, evaluation, or research teams to translate program frameworks into data collection and reporting systems.


- Strong knowledge of Salesforce Lightning Platform administration and Salesforce Flow.


- Understanding of Salesforce security architecture, data governance, and integration technologies.


- Knowledge of APIs, middleware platforms, and data synchronization processes.


- Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.


- Ability to manage multiple priorities, collaborate with diverse stakeholders, and maintain confidentiality.


- Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff across program, evaluation, and leadership teams.


- Collaborative working style with ability to serve as a partner — not just a technical resource


- Commitment to continuous learning, excellent customer service, and support of JVS's mission and values.


**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience with Power BI and Microsoft 365.


- Additional Salesforce certifications related to administration, business analysis, or integration.


- Experience working in a nonprofit, workforce development, education, or social services environment.


- Experience with Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud.


- Familiarity with evaluation frameworks, including logic models, theory of change, outcome metrics, or performance measurement systems.


- Experience supporting external research partnerships or preparing datasets for evaluation studies.


- Experience working with consultants, software vendors, and implementation partners.


**What We Offer**

- Annual Salary: $98,500 - $108,500


- 100% covered medical and dental plans for the employee


- Accrued sixteen (16) days of Vacation + accrued ten (10) days of Paid Sick Leave


- Paid federal and Jewish holidays

- Pet Insurance Discounts

- The expectation for this role is to work in our San Francisco office and/or worksites on a hybrid work schedule; JVS does not provide relocation packages

title: Workforce Management Lead, US
description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

Neko Health is expanding into the US market, and this role is being created to make sure staffing, shift structures, and labor resources keep pace with that growth without compromising service levels or cost efficiency.

This is first and foremost a strategic, data-driven role. The Workforce Management Lead will analyze and understand Neko's labour performance and measuring end to end — from raw operational data through to the strategic staffing and cost decisions that data should drive — and will explore AI-enabled ways to structure and organize the workforce, rather than defaulting to manual or legacy scheduling methods. This role is also expected to contribute to day-to-day rota scheduling support.

What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

Strategic labour analytics (lead priority)

  • Explore AI-enabled approaches to structuring and organizing the workforce — e.g., using AI/ML methods to improve shift-pattern design, coverage modeling, or forecasting accuracy — rather than relying solely on manual or legacy methods.

Data & systems build

  • Work with HR, Operations, and Medical Operations to manage absenteeism, overtime, and productivity gaps, using the labour-analytics work above to inform those conversations.

Day-to-day: rota scheduling support

  • Support shift bid processes and shift rotations to optimize coverage and employee satisfaction.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven experience of building a workforce forecasting model, staffing tool, or scheduling dashboard from scratch — not only configured or operated one built by another team or vendor.

  • Experience applying AI or machine-learning methods to workforce planning, forecasting, or scheduling problems.

  • Has owned workforce planning and labour-metrics analysis across multiple sites

  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data tools (e.g., Excel, Tableau, SQL) and workforce planning systems.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Preferred Experience

  • Background in any shift-based, multi-site industry (e.g., retail, logistics/warehousing, aviation, , hospitality, manufacturing) is valued as much as healthcare experience.

ADP is a purpose-led practice, with sector expertise delivered though our local studios.

title: Applied AI Scientist(m/f/d)
description:
About us

NET CHECK GmbH was founded in 1999 with the aim of improving the quality of communication networks. Since then, NET CHECK has developed into the leading partner of network operators and infrastructure providers of mobile and fixed networks of all technologies. Its core competencies include international network benchmarking (comparative measurements) as well as network planning and fault analysis. NET CHECK has one of Germany's largest crowdsourcing platforms, which generates over 144 million data points every day. Our commitment to quality and security has earned us the trust of scientific and government institutions.
NET CHECK is headquartered in Berlin and is part of the NC GROUP, an owner-managed group of companies with a total of over 180 employees at five locations in Germany and one in Belgrade, Serbia.

Job Summary: We build AI platforms that transform complex telecom network data—including drive tests, voice quality, broadband diagnostics, and signaling analysis—into clear, actionable insights.
We are looking for an Applied AI Scientist who combines strong analytical thinking with practical engineering skills. You will model complex problems, develop and prototype ML and agentic AI solutions, and turn them into reliable, production-ready tools for real users while applying the latest developments in AI.


Responsibilities

  • Design and build agentic AI systems and RAG pipelines that can reason over technical documentation and live network data.
  • Take ownership of testing and evaluation by developing evaluation datasets, metrics, and benchmarks for accuracy, retrieval quality, latency, and cost. Ensure system quality can be measured reliably and regressions are identified before reaching users.
  • Develop and continuously improve our evaluation and observability practices, including offline and online evaluations, LLM-as-a-judge approaches where appropriate, regression testing, and quality dashboards for agentic AI and RAG systems.
  • Turn data science insights into production-ready solutions, covering the full process from data analysis and modeling to well-tested, maintainable AI tools, including operationalization and MLOps.
  • Develop and enhance machine learning models for classification, anomaly detection, root-cause analysis, and related use cases, and integrate them into the platform.
  • Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code, actively contributing to high engineering standards across the team.
  • Research and experiment with new AI models, methods, and technologies, turning promising approaches into practical features and production solutions.
  • Work closely with engineers, data specialists, and domain experts to develop effective solutions for real-world telecom challenges.


Your profile

  • PhD in a quantitative discipline such as Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Computational Chemistry/Biology, or a related natural science, with strong hands-on experience in mathematical and computational modeling.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience developing software or machine learning systems in an industry or research environment, alongside or following your studies.
  • Hands-on experience with AI agents and RAG, including building and implementing LLM-powered systems in practice.
  • Strong background in data science and machine learning, with experience using tools and frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM, and deep learning frameworks.
  • Strong software engineering and programming skills, particularly in Python, with a focus on clean, well-structured, tested, and maintainable code.
  • Good understanding of the design and development of agentic AI systems, including orchestration, tools, memory, evaluation, and guardrails.
  • A strong research mindset and enthusiasm for keeping up with developments in AI and translating new approaches into practical solutions.
  • Fluent English, combined with strong communication, collaboration, and teamwork skills.
  • Experience productionizing ML solutions in the cloud, preferably AWS (e.g. Bedrock, ECS, S3), using modern AI and LLM tooling such as LangGraph, Chroma, FAISS, LangSmith, or Langfuse, including LLM evaluation, observability, prompt engineering, and cost and latency optimization is a plus.
  • Exposure to telecom, networking, signal processing, or other data-rich technical domains is a plus.


We Offer

  • Employment Type: Full-Time, indefinite term.
  • Opportunity to shape AI strategy in a fast-growing organization with access to state-of-the-art AI tools, infrastructure, and research opportunities
  • Flexible working hours.
  • 28 vacation days.
  • Health & Sports Subsidy: Sports membership subsidy.
  • Public Transportation Subsidy: Monthly subsidy for a Germany-wide ticket.
  • Bicycle leasing via JobRad.
  • Regular Team Events.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Adobe is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Adobe Risk Platform (ARP) team. ARP is Adobe's centralized, adaptive system for detecting, preventing, and mitigating fraud and abuse across products and services — protecting surfaces like Commerce, Stock, and Firefly with real-time risk decisions, without degrading the customer experience.

In this position, you will help build and develop machine learning models to identify fraudulent activity, detect abusive account behavior, and protect the experience of hundreds of millions of users. You'll work across the model lifecycle from raw behavioral data and feature engineering, to model training, deployment, and monitoring alongside senior engineers on the team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Help build and train ML models covering various fraud and abuse areas. These include financial transaction fraud, device-related deception, and account and identity abuse. The goal is a unified, continuously-updated trust and risk score.
  • Contribute to feature engineering across transaction, device, and behavioral event data.
  • Build and maintain feature pipelines on Databricks and Spark, transforming raw transaction and device event data into high-quality model inputs.
  • Help translate prototypes into production ML systems, working with senior engineers on scalability, reliability, and observability.
  • Support MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, and production monitoring.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data science, product, and platform teams to understand fraud and abuse patterns across Adobe's surfaces.
  • Stay ahead of advances in ML/AI, particularly in fraud detection and behavioral modeling, and bring relevant ideas to the team.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 3+ years of professional experience building and deploying ML solutions, or equivalent experience through internships, research, or personal projects.
  • Solid programming skills in Python, with hands-on experience in PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, or similar frameworks.
  • Working understanding of the ML lifecycle — from data collection through deployment and monitoring.
  • Eagerness to learn model optimization, inference efficiency, and production system integration, with support from senior engineers on the team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Coursework, projects, or professional experience in any of: payment fraud, device fingerprinting, account takeover detection, anomaly detection, or graph-based modeling.

  • Understand needs around data protection and privacy compliance in our products, services and platforms.
  • Translate customer, business, and legal needs into clear requirements and engage with engineering teams to deliver outstanding solutions users trust with their data.
  • Help build features, capabilities, and tools composed to keep user and company data protected while offering transparency around how our company processes data.
  • Collaborate with experience design teams driving the creation of mockups and review user interface designs to help ensure all privacy controls are implemented in accordance with privacy policies and requirements.
  • Build, document and communicate key use cases as the basis for comprehensive, end-to-end features and user acceptance testing for privacy requirements and solutions.
  • Build privacy success metrics/criteria and supervise performance
  • Partner with legal to assist in the review of privacy impact assessments for different platforms, products, tools, and services.
  • Prepare and deliver presentations for higher-level management including Directors, VPs and Senior Leaders with progress, risks and opportunities for privacy-focused capabilities and processes.
  • Act as an advocate and evangelist for privacy and data protection, leading internal training and building awareness.

What is Needed to Succeed

  • 5+ years of relevant product management experience in either commercial or well-defined internal-facing products.
  • Understanding of technical environments, market dynamics and trends.
  • Solid understanding and hands-on experience with AI technologies, models, tools, and applied agentic use cases.
  • Solid understanding of data platforms (e.g., data lakes and data farms), privacy enhancement technologies, and various industry frameworks geared around data privacy (e.g., IAB TCF, Global Privacy Platform, etc.)
  • Strong product management thinking with a dedication to nail the “What and Why” before jumping into solutioning.
  • Proven track record in highly cross-functional projects, working with product and technical teams with multiple priorities.
  • Business-savvy teammate who can think out of the box, with a keen ability for switching between tactical execution to critical thinking!
  • Persistent appetite to learn quickly with a highly curious, problem-solving focused mind.
  • Exceptional communication skills with a phenomenal sense of humor and dedication to integrity.
  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in a quantitative field, electrical engineering, computer science or equivalent
  • Certified Information Privacy Technology credential is a plus.
